name: US ABA routing number
doc: Datatype for 'US ABA routing number' (aba) from rules in context 'finances'.

name: American Banking Association (ABA) routing number
doc: In the United States, an ABA routing transit number (ABA RTN) is a nine-digit code printed on the bottom of checks to identify the financial institution on which it was drawn.

doc: Australian ABN (Australian Business Number) by known name identifier

doc: Academic degree title

patterns.name: Academic degree (Russian)
patterns.doc: Academic degree title in Russian.

name: Academic and professional title
doc: Title written before a person's name that shows an academic degree, an academic rank or a professional status, such as Dr, Prof. or Eur Ing. Degrees and qualifications written after the name, such as PhD, are name suffixes (namesuffix).

holder of the academic rank of professor
engineer registered as a European Engineer

ru.name: Академическое или профессиональное звание перед именем

name: Access token
doc: Bearer token that grants access to an API on behalf of a user or an application, such as an OAuth 2.0 access or refresh token or a personal access token. Formats differ by service.

name: Singapore ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) number by known name
doc: Singapore ACRA (Accounting and Corporate Regulatory Authority) number by known name identifier

name: Andorran tax registration number (NRT)
doc: Número de Registre Tributari, the identifier that the Andorran tax administration gives to natural and legal persons. It has eight characters: a letter for the kind of taxpayer, six digits and a control letter. The parts are often separated by hyphens.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format
The first example in its printed form

name: Andorra postal code
doc: Postal code in Andorra: the letters AD and three digits; the first digit is 1 to 7 and the second is 0.

name: Address (physical location)
doc: Geographic address, commonly consist of postindex, country, area, town, street and building

ru.name: Адрес (физическое местонахождение)
ru.doc: Географический или административный адрес местонахождения. Может включать почтовый индекс, название страны, региона, города, улицы и здания.

name: Address line 2 (secondary address line)
doc: Additional line of a postal address after the street line. It holds the part of a building or the delivery point: apartment, suite, unit, floor, building name or PO box, such as Apt 4B or Suite 200. Forms often have two or three such lines.

name: First-level administrative division
doc: Name or code of the largest administrative subdivision of a country, such as a US state, a Canadian province, a German Land or a Russian federal subject. The registry keeps a record per country as a child of this one.

name: Second-level administrative division
doc: Name or code of a subdivision of a first-level administrative division, such as a US county, an Italian province or a French department. The registry keeps a record per country as a child of this one.

name: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre company number (DMCC)
doc: Number of a company registered with the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC), a free zone authority in Dubai. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AE-DMCC; with that prefix an identifier reads AE-DMCC-JLT-65609.

name: UAE Bank Account Number
doc: UAE bank account number

examples.description: Example UAE bank account number (IBAN format)

name: UAE City Name
doc: UAE city name

name: UAE Emirates ID Number
doc: UAE Emirates ID number used for identification of UAE citizens and residents

name: UAE IBAN
doc: UAE IBAN (International Bank Account Number)

name: UAE Passport Number
doc: UAE passport number used for international travel identification

name: UAE Postal Code
doc: UAE postal code

name: UAE Tax Number
doc: UAE tax identification number (TRN - Tax Registration Number)

name: Afghan Central Business Registry number
doc: Number of a company in the Afghanistan Central Business Registry. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-CBR; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-CBR-102164.

name: Afghan NGO registration number
doc: Number that the NGO Department of the Ministry of Economy of Afghanistan gives to the non-governmental organisations it registers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-MOE; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-MOE-89.

name: Afghanistan postal code
doc: Postal code in Afghanistan: four digits.

name: Afghan taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Tax identification number of taxpayers in Afghanistan, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AF-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads AF-TIN-9000082348.

name: Age
doc: Age of the person or organization in years

name: Age range
doc: Range of ages in years that groups people, such as 18-24, 65+ or <18. Surveys, census tables and marketing data use it instead of an exact age.

name: age public key (X25519 recipient)
doc: Public key of the age file encryption format and tool, that is, an X25519 recipient that files are encrypted to. It is a 62-character lowercase Bech32 string with the human-readable part age, so it starts with age1. Post-quantum recipients (age1pq1...) and recipients of age plugins are longer or use other prefixes and are not covered.

examples.description: Test vector of the age specification

name: age secret key (X25519 identity)
doc: Secret key (identity) of the age file encryption format and tool, which decrypts files encrypted to the matching age1... public key. It is an uppercase Bech32 string with the human-readable part AGE-SECRET-KEY-, so it starts with AGE-SECRET-KEY-1 and has 74 characters. Post-quantum identities start with AGE-SECRET-KEY-PQ-1. The Bech32 checksum covers the whole string, including the hyphens of the prefix.

examples.description: X25519 test vector of the age specification
Post-quantum (ML-KEM-768 + X25519) test vector of the age specification

name: AGROVOC concept identifier
doc: Local identifier of a concept in AGROVOC, the multilingual agriculture thesaurus of the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations. Older concepts use c_ and a decimal number, newer ones c_ and eight lowercase hexadecimal characters. Appended to http://aims.fao.org/aos/agrovoc/ it gives the concept URI.

name: Aircraft/tail number
doc: An aircraft registration, alternatively called a tail number, is a code unique to a single aircraft, required by international convention to be marked on the exterior of every civil aircraft.

name: Airline call sign
doc: Unique call sign of the airline

name: Airline code
doc: Unique code of the airline provided by IATA or ICAP

patterns.name: IATA airline designator (airline code)
patterns.doc: IATA airline designators, sometimes called IATA reservation codes, are two-character codes assigned by the International Air Transport Association (IATA) to the worlds airlines.

patterns.name: ICAO Airline code
patterns.doc: The ICAO airline designator is a code assigned by the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) to aircraft operating agencies, aeronautical authorities, and services related to international aviation, each of which is allocated both a three-letter designator and a telephony designator.

name: Airline name
doc: Unique name of the airline

name: Airport location identifier
doc: A location identifier is a symbolic representation for the name and the location of an airport, navigation aid, or weather station, and is used for staffed air traffic control facilities in air traffic control, telecommunications, computer programming, weather reports, and related services.

patterns.name: FAA airport code (FAA identifier)
patterns.doc: The Federal Aviation Administration location identifier (FAA LID) is a three- to five-character alphanumeric code identifying aviation related facilities inside the United States, though some codes are reserved for, and are managed by other entities.

patterns.name: IATA Airport code
patterns.doc: An IATA airport code, also known as an IATA location identifier, IATA station code, or simply a location identifier, is a three-letter geocode designating many airports and metropolitan areas around the world, defined by the International Air Transport Association (IATA)

patterns.name: ICAO Airport code
patterns.doc: The ICAO airport code or location indicator is a four-letter code designating aerodromes around the world. These codes, as defined by the International Civil Aviation Organization and published in ICAO Document 7910: Location Indicators, are used by air traffic control and airline operations such as flight planning.

name: Albanian taxpayer identification number (NIPT)
doc: Numri i Identifikimit për Personin e Tatueshëm (NIPT, also NUIS), the tax number that Albania gives to businesses and individuals. It has ten characters: a letter, eight digits and a final letter. The leading characters encode the registration date, or the birth date of an individual. The check letter algorithm is not published.

name: Albania postal code
doc: Postal code in Albania: four digits.

name: Authoritative Legal Entity Identifier (ALEI, IBRN)
doc: Globally unique identifier of a legal entity defined by ISO 8000-116. It combines a prefix for the jurisdiction and the register that created the entity with the local registration number from that register, for example US-DE.BER:3031657. Unlike proxy identifiers such as the LEI or the DUNS number, it is issued by the authority that registers the entity. The International Business Registration Number (IBRN) is the name used for ALEIs in trade.

examples.description: Entity in the Delaware Business Entity Register

name: AllMusic album ID
doc: Identifier of an album in the AllMusic database: the letters mw and ten digits. The two-letter prefix tells the kind of entry.

examples.description: The Dark Side of the Moon

name: AllMusic artist ID
doc: Identifier of an artist, group or record label (AllMusic lists labels as artists) in the AllMusic database: the letters mn and ten digits. The two-letter prefix tells the kind of entry.

name: AllMusic composition ID
doc: Identifier of a composition, mostly of classical music in the AllMusic database: the letters mc and ten digits. The two-letter prefix tells the kind of entry.

name: AllMusic song ID
doc: Identifier of a song in the AllMusic database: the letters mt and ten digits. The two-letter prefix tells the kind of entry.

name: Armenian Bank Account Number
doc: Armenian bank account number used for financial transactions

hy.doc: Բանկային հաշիվ - Հայաստանում ֆինանսական գործարքների համար օգտագործվող հաշվեհամար

doc: Armenian driver license number used for vehicle operation authorization

doc: State registration number of a legal entity in the register of the State Register Agency of Legal Entities of the Ministry of Justice of Armenia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AM-SRALE; with that prefix an identifier reads AM-SRALE-16.110.00666.

name: Armenian Organization Taxpayer Identification Number
doc: Armenian organization Taxpayer Identification Number used for tax purposes to identify businesses and organizations

hy.name: Կազմակերպության հարկային համար
hy.doc: Կազմակերպության հարկային համար - բիզնեսների և կազմակերպությունների հարկային համակարգում նույնականացման համար

name: Armenian Passport Number
doc: Armenian passport number used for international travel identification

hy.name: Հայտարարագիր
hy.doc: Հայտարարագիր - Հայաստանի քաղաքացիների միջազգային ճանապարհորդության նույնականացման փաստաթուղթ

doc: Armenian postal code used for mail delivery and addressing

name: Armenian Social Security Number
doc: Armenian Social Security Number (SSN) is a 10-digit unique identifier assigned to Armenian citizens, legally residing foreigners, stateless individuals, and refugees. Generated based on personal information such as gender and date of birth, it remains constant throughout an individual's lifetime.

hy.name: Հասարակական ապահովագրության համար
hy.doc: Հասարակական ապահովագրության համար - 10-նիշ եզակի նույնականացման համար, որը տրվում է Հայաստանի քաղաքացիներին, օրինականորեն բնակվող օտարերկրացիներին, անքաղաքացիներին և փախստականներին

name: Armenian Taxpayer Identification Number
doc: Armenian Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) used for tax purposes to identify individuals and entities within the tax system. Mandatory for public sector systems.

hy.name: Հարկ վճարողի նույնականացման համար
hy.doc: Հարկ վճարողի նույնականացման համար - հարկային համակարգում անհատների և կազմակերպությունների նույնականացման համար օգտագործվող համար

name: Armenian Vehicle Registration Plate
doc: Armenian vehicle registration plate. Format consists of two or three numbers, two letters, and two or three additional numbers. Plates include the international code "AM" and feature the national flag, security hologram, and machine-readable Data Matrix Code (since 2014).

examples.description: Example Armenian vehicle plate (2 digits, 2 letters, 3 digits)
Example Armenian vehicle plate (3 digits, 2 letters, 2 digits)

hy.name: Մեքենայի համարանիշ
hy.doc: Մեքենայի համարանիշ - Հայաստանում ավտոմեքենաների գրանցման համարանիշ, որը բաղկացած է թվերից և տառերից

name: Animal
doc: Common name of an animal or a kind of animal, such as dog, cat or horse. Typical columns hold pet types, livestock or animals in observation records.

name: Anthropic API key
doc: Secret key of the Anthropic (Claude) API, sent in the x-api-key header. Standard keys start with sk-ant-api03- and Admin API keys, which manage an organization, with sk-ant-admin01-. Secret scanners expect 93 more letters, digits, underscores or hyphens and the ending AA.

name: API key or client secret
doc: Secret string that an application presents to an API or an identity provider to authenticate itself, such as an API key, a subscription key or an OAuth client secret. Formats differ by service.

purview: Azure Machine Learning web service API key

name: Argentine uniform bank account code (CBU)
doc: Clave Bancaria Uniforme, the 22-digit code that identifies a customer account at a bank in Argentina. The first block holds a 3-digit bank code, a 4-digit branch code and a check digit; the second block holds a 13-digit account number and another check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Argentine community organisation number (CENOC)
doc: Number of a civil society organisation in the register of the National Centre of Community Organisations (Centro Nacional de Organizaciones de la Comunidad, CENOC) of Argentina. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AR-CENOC; with that prefix an identifier reads AR-CENOC-9316-A.

name: Argentina postal code
doc: Postal code in Argentina: the Código Postal Argentino (CPA) of eight characters, a letter (not I or O), four digits and three letters.

name: Argentina DNI (National Identity Document)
doc: Documento Nacional de Identidad or DNI (which means National Identity Document) is the main identity document for Argentine citizens, as well as temporary or permanent resident aliens (DNI Extranjero).

name: Argon2 password hash (PHC string)
doc: Password hash of Argon2 (RFC 9106), the winner of the Password Hashing Competition, in the PHC string format: $argon2id$ (or argon2i, argon2d), the version v=19, the memory, time and parallelism costs m, t and p, then the salt and the hash in Base64 without padding. Argon2id is the default of libsodium crypto_pwhash.

examples.description: Hash of the word "example" with the salt examplesalt (m=19456, t=2, p=1)

name: Archival Resource Key (ARK)
doc: Persistent identifier for digital, physical or abstract objects, used by libraries, archives, publishers and research institutions. The core is ark:<NAAN>/<name>, where the Name Assigning Authority Number (NAAN) identifies the organization that named the object. Older ARKs write ark:/<NAAN>/<name>. An ARK can be prefixed with the host of a resolver, such as n2t.net or the host of the institution that serves the object. The NAAN registry is kept by the ARK Alliance.

examples.description: Bibliothèque nationale de France authority record for Paris
The same ARK without the slash after ark:
The same ARK with a resolver host

name: ArrayExpress accession
doc: Accession of an experiment or array design in ArrayExpress, the EMBL-EBI archive of functional genomics data, now a collection of the BioStudies database. It is a letter (E for an experiment, A for an array design), a hyphen, a four-character code of the submission route, such as MEXP or MTAB, a hyphen and a number.

examples.description: Transcription profiling of Streptococcus gordonii wild type and Brf mutants; Bioregistry example

name: Article ID by field name
doc: Article ID by field name identifier

name: arXiv identifier
doc: Identifier of a preprint in arXiv. Since 2007 it is YYMM.NNNNN (four digits before 2015); older papers use the archive name and a seven-digit number, such as hep-th/9711200. A version suffix such as v2 may follow.

name: Amazon Standard Identification Number (ASIN)
doc: Ten-character code of uppercase letters and digits that Amazon and its partners assign to a product in the Amazon catalog. For a book with a 10-digit ISBN, the ASIN is that ISBN. Other products, including most Kindle editions, get a code assigned by Amazon.

examples.description: Book: the ASIN is its ISBN-10

ru.name: Идентификатор товара Amazon (ASIN)
ru.doc: Десятисимвольный код товара в каталоге Amazon; для книг совпадает с ISBN-10.

name: Autonomous system number (ASN)
doc: Number that identifies an autonomous system: a network or group of networks under one routing policy, such as an Internet service provider, a hosting company or a university, that exchanges routes with its neighbours over BGP. IANA hands out blocks of numbers to the five regional Internet registries, which assign them to network operators. Numbers were 16-bit (1 to 65535) until RFC 6793 extended them to 32 bits (up to 4294967295). They are written as a plain decimal number, often with the prefix AS (AS174). The regexp covers this asplain form, not the asdot form (1.10) of RFC 5396, and rejects AS 0, which is reserved (RFC 7607). RFC 5398 sets aside 64496-64511 and 65536-65551 for documentation.

examples.description: Cogent Communications (example of Wikidata property P3797)
Library of Congress (example of Wikidata property P3797)
AS 0 is reserved and never used in routing

ru.name: Номер автономной системы (ASN)
ru.doc: Номер автономной системы в маршрутизации BGP: 16- или 32-битное число, часто с префиксом AS, например AS174.

name: Austrian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Austria. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Austrian company register number (Firmenbuchnummer)
doc: Number of a company in the Austrian commercial register: digits followed by a lowercase check letter, such as 123456a. It is often written with the prefix FN.

name: Austrian municipality code (Gemeindekennziffer)
doc: Five-digit code of an Austrian municipality assigned by Statistics Austria: the state digit, two digits for the district and two for the municipality.

name: Austrian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Austria. Microsoft Purview looks for a letter, an optional space and seven digits.

name: Austrian postal code
doc: Postal code (Postleitzahl) in Austria: four digits. The first digit is the region, 1 for Vienna.

name: Austrian tax identification number
doc: Austrian tax number (Steuernummer): a two-digit tax office code, three digits and four digits, often written with a hyphen and a slash.

name: Austrian VAT identification number (UID)
doc: Austrian VAT identification number (Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer, UID). In the EU form it is ATU followed by eight digits. The last digit is a check digit.

name: Austrian social insurance number (VNR)
doc: Versicherungsnummer (also SVNR or VSNR), the personal number of the Austrian social insurance. It has ten digits: a 3-digit serial number, a check digit and six digits that usually hold the date of birth (DDMMYY).

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

purview: EU Social Security Number (SSN) or Equivalent ID
EU social security number or equivalent identification

name: Austrian association register number (ZVR-Zahl)
doc: ZVR-Zahl, the number of an association (Verein) in the Central Register of Associations (Zentrales Vereinsregister) of Austria. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AT-ZVR; with that prefix an identifier reads AT-ZVR-555769679.

name: Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification System
doc: The Anatomical Therapeutic Chemical (ATC) Classification System is a drug classification system that classifies the active ingredients of drugs according to the organ or system on which they act and their therapeutic, pharmacological and chemical properties. Its purpose is an aid to monitor drug use and for research to improve quality medication use. It does not imply drug recommendation or efficacy.

ru.name: Анатомо-терапевтическо-химическая классификация (АТХ)
ru.doc: Анатомо-терапевтическо-химическая классификация — международная система классификации лекарственных средств.

name: Austrian city name (in German)
doc: Austrian city name in German language

name: Atlassian API token
doc: API token of an Atlassian account (Jira, Confluence and other Atlassian cloud products). Current tokens start with ATATT3; secret scanners expect 186 more letters, digits and the characters _ - =.

name: Australian bank account number
doc: Number of a bank account held in Australia. Microsoft Purview looks for six to ten digits; the bank state branch (BSB) number is written separately.

name: Australian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Australia. Microsoft Purview looks for the formats of all states and territories: six to ten digits, six letters and digits, or digit groups separated by spaces or hyphens.

name: Australian postcode
doc: Postcode in Australia: four digits. Codes in the Northern Territory start with 0, such as 0800 for Darwin.

name: Australian state or territory
doc: Name of one of the six states of Australia (New South Wales, Victoria, Queensland, Western Australia, South Australia, Tasmania) or of its two mainland territories (Australian Capital Territory, Northern Territory). The abbreviation is the pattern au_state_code.

patterns.name: Australian state or territory abbreviation
patterns.doc: Abbreviation of an Australian state or mainland territory, as written in addresses: ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC or WA. ISO 3166-2:AU uses the same letters after AU-.

name: Australian state or territory abbreviation
doc: Abbreviation of an Australian state or mainland territory, as written in addresses: ACT, NSW, NT, QLD, SA, TAS, VIC or WA. ISO 3166-2:AU uses the same letters after AU-.

name: Australian suburb or locality
doc: Name of a suburb or locality of Australia: the place named in a postal address before the state and the postcode, such as Parramatta or Fitzroy.

name: Australian Business Number (ABN)
doc: The Australian Business Number (ABN) is a unique 11-digit identifier issued by the Australian Business Register (ABR) which is operated by the Australian Taxation Office (ATO).

name: Australian Company Number (ACN)
doc: An Australian Company Number (usually shortened to ACN) is a unique identifier required by every company registered under Australia’s Corporations Act 2001 (Cth).

name: Australia bank state branch (BSB) code
doc: A bank state branch is the name used in Australia for a bank code, which is a branch identifier.

name: Australian medicare number
doc: Medicare number is a unique identifier issued by Australian Government that enables the cardholder to receive a rebates of medical expenses under Australia Medicare system.

name: Australian passport number
doc: Number of Australian National passport

name: Australian Tax File Number (TFN)
doc: The tax file number (TFN) is a unique identifier issued by the Australian Taxation Office to each taxpaying entity — an individual, company, superannuation fund, partnership, or trust.

name: authentihash
doc: authentihash is a sha256 hash used by Microsoft to verify that the relevant sections of a PE image file have not been altered. This specific type of hash is used by Microsoft AppLocker.

name: Contract award notice id
doc: EU datatype for 'Contract award notice id' (awardnotice) from rules in context 'government'. The Contract Award Notice ID is a unique identifier assigned to contract award notices published in the Official Journal of the European Union. The identifier format consists of a 4-digit year, followed by '/S', then 1 to 3 digits representing the supplement number, a hyphen, and finally 1 to 5 digits representing the notice number within that supplement.

examples.description: Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 3-digit supplement, and 5-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 2-digit supplement, and 4-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, single-digit supplement, and 3-digit notice number
Contract award notice ID with 4-digit year, 3-digit supplement, and single-digit notice number

es.name: ID de aviso de adjudicación de contrato

name: Air Waybill number by field name
doc: Air Waybill number by field name identifier

name: AWS access key ID
doc: Public half of an Amazon Web Services access key pair, sent with every signed API request together with the secret access key. It has 20 characters: the prefix AKIA for a long-term key of an IAM user or the root user, or ASIA for a temporary key issued by AWS STS, then 16 uppercase letters and digits.

examples.description: Example key ID from the AWS IAM documentation
Unique ID of an IAM user (prefix AIDA), not an access key

name: AWS account ID
doc: Twelve-digit number that identifies an Amazon Web Services account, for example in the account field of an ARN. AWS states that account IDs are not secret, but secret scanners report them because they help to target an account.

examples.description: Example account ID from the AWS IAM documentation

name: AWS secret access key
doc: Secret part of an Amazon Web Services access key pair, used with the access key ID to sign API requests (for example to Amazon S3): 40 letters, digits, slashes or plus signs.

purview: Amazon S3 client secret access key

name: Azerbaijan postal code
doc: Postal code in Azerbaijan: four digits. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix AZ.

name: Azerbaijani taxpayer identification number (VÖEN)

ORG-ID.guide lists the register as AZ-IVI; with that prefix an identifier reads AZ-IVI-3100073821.

The same 12 digits follow BE and the two IBAN check digits in a Belgian IBAN (be_iban), so old account numbers are still found in historical data and are converted to IBAN.

patterns.name: Czech bank account number
patterns.doc: Number of a bank account in the Czech Republic in the national format, written as prefix-number/bank code, for example 19-2000145399/0800. Czech National Bank decree 169/2011 defines it: an optional prefix (předčíslí) of up to six digits, an account number of two to ten digits with at least two that are not 0, and the 4-digit bank code (kód platebního styku). Leading zeros of both parts have no meaning. Each part has its own check: its digits, weighted 6 3 7 9 10 5 8 4 2 1 from the left after padding to ten digits, must give a sum divisible by 11.

doc: A bank card is typically a plastic card issued by a bank to its clients that performs one or more of a number of services that relate to giving the client access to bank account.

ru.name: Банковская карта
ru.doc: Банковская карта (англ. bank card) — пластиковая, металлическая или виртуальная карта, обычно привязанная к одному или нескольким расчётным счетам в банке.

name: Payment card security code (CVV, CVC, CID)
doc: Short code printed on a payment card that card-not-present transactions use to show that the payer holds the card. Visa calls it CVV2, Mastercard CVC2 and American Express CID. Most networks print three digits on the back of the card; American Express prints four digits on the front. Card rules forbid storing it after authorization, so its presence in a data set is a finding on its own. The digits alone cannot be told apart from other short numbers.

name: Payment card expiration date
doc: Month and year after which a payment card is no longer valid, printed on the card next to the card number. Payment card rules treat it as cardholder data together with the card number and the cardholder name. Data sets usually store it as month and two- or four-digit year.

name: Barbados postal code
doc: Postal code in Barbados: the letters BB and five digits.

name: bcrypt password hash
doc: Password hash produced by bcrypt in Modular Crypt Format: $2, an optional version letter (a, b, x or y), $, a two-digit cost, $ and 53 characters of bcrypt Base64 (a 22-character salt and a 31-character hash).

name: Bangladeshi business identification number (BIN)
doc: Business Identification Number (BIN) on the VAT registration certificate that the National Board of Revenue of Bangladesh gives to registered organisations and companies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BD-NBR; with that prefix an identifier reads BD-NBR-000697679-0101.

name: Bangladeshi NGO Affairs Bureau registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the NGO Affairs Bureau of Bangladesh. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BD-NAB; with that prefix an identifier reads BD-NAB-2330.

name: Bangladeshi national identity card number (NID)
doc: Number of the national identity card issued by the Bangladesh Election Commission. Cards issued from 2008 carry 13-digit numbers, and later registrations received 17-digit numbers; a 13-digit number can be turned into the 17-digit form by putting the four-digit year of birth in front of it. Smart cards carry a 10-digit number of nine random digits and a check digit, whose algorithm is not published.

doc: Belgian bank account number in the national format used before the IBAN replaced it in payments: 12 digits written as 3, 7 and 2, as in 096-1234567-69. The first three digits are the bank identification code of the National Bank of Belgium, the next seven the account, and the last two the remainder of the first ten digits divided by 97 (97 when the remainder is 0). The same 12 digits follow BE and the two IBAN check digits in a Belgian IBAN (be_iban), so old account numbers are still found in historical data and are converted to IBAN.

name: Belgian BIS number
doc: BIS number (BIS-nummer, numéro BIS), the 11-digit number that the Crossroads Bank for Social Security (KSZ/BCSS) assigns to people who have a link with Belgium but are not in the National Register, such as cross-border workers, owners of property in Belgium and people with Belgian social security rights who live abroad. It is built like the national register number (benatcardid): date of birth as YYMMDD, a serial number (even for women, odd for men or when the sex is unknown) and two check digits modulo 97, with a 2 put before the first nine digits for people born from 2000. The month is increased by 40 when the sex was known at creation and by 20 when it was not, so it is 20 to 32 or 40 to 52. The date and sex reflect what was known when the number was created and are not updated.

nl.name: BIS-nummer
nl.doc: Elfcijferig identificatienummer dat de KSZ toekent aan personen die niet in het Rijksregister staan; opgebouwd zoals het rijksregisternummer, met de geboortemaand verhoogd met 20 of 40.

fr.name: Numéro BIS
fr.doc: Numéro d'identification à onze chiffres attribué par la BCSS aux personnes absentes du Registre national; construit comme le numéro de registre national, avec le mois de naissance augmenté de 20 ou 40.

ru.name: Номер BIS Бельгии
ru.doc: Одиннадцатизначный номер, который Банк-перекрёсток социального обеспечения присваивает лицам вне Национального реестра; устроен как номер реестра, но к месяцу рождения прибавлено 20 или 40.

name: Belgian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence (rijbewijs, permis de conduire, Führerschein) issued in Belgium as a card in the European format. Microsoft Purview looks for ten digits without spaces or delimiters and no check digit. On the card models described in PRADO a changing image shows the photo of the holder and the last five digits of the number.

ru.doc: Номер бельгийского водительского удостоверения европейского образца - десять цифр без пробелов.

name: Belgian eID card number
doc: Number of a Belgian electronic identity card (eID), issued to Belgian citizens aged 12 and over. It identifies the card, not the person, and changes with every new card; the national register number (benatcardid) printed on the same card identifies the person. It has 12 digits written as 000-0011032-71. The last two are the remainder of the first ten divided by 97, or 97 when the remainder is 0. Residence cards of foreigners use other formats (a B and nine digits for citizens of the EU, EEA and Switzerland, nine digits for others) and are not covered. Google Sensitive Data Protection detects it as BELGIUM_NATIONAL_ID_CARD_NUMBER.

fr.doc: Numéro à douze chiffres d'une carte eID belge (xxx-xxxxxxx-yy); les deux derniers chiffres sont le reste de la division des dix premiers par 97.

name: Belgian establishment unit number (vestigingseenheidsnummer)
doc: Vestigingseenheidsnummer (numéro d'unité d'établissement), the 10-digit number that the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE) gives to each establishment unit of an enterprise: a place, such as a shop, office or school, where it carries out an activity. It differs from the enterprise number (be_vat): its first digit is 2 to 8, and it is usually written as 2.190.679.276. Like the enterprise number it ends with two check digits, 97 minus the remainder of the first eight digits divided by 97.

ru.doc: Десятизначный номер места деятельности (единицы предприятия) в Банке-перекрёстке предприятий (KBO/BCE); первая цифра от 2 до 8.

name: Belgian IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Belgium. It has 16 characters: BE, two IBAN check digits and the 12 digits of the national account number (be_bank_account): a 3-digit bank identification code, a 7-digit account number and two national check digits, the remainder of the first ten digits divided by 97 (97 when it is 0). The National Bank of Belgium publishes the list of bank identification codes. It is printed in groups of four, as in BE71 0961 2345 6769.

name: Belgian social security identification number (INSZ/NISS)
doc: Identificatienummer van de sociale zekerheid (INSZ), numéro d'identification de la sécurité sociale (NISS) or Erkennungsnummer der sozialen Sicherheit (ENSS): the key that identifies a person in data exchanged within Belgian social security, for example in employer declarations and health insurance. It is the national register number (benatcardid) of a person in the National Register, otherwise the BIS number (be_bis) assigned by the Crossroads Bank for Social Security. Both have 11 digits: date of birth as YYMMDD (month plus 20 or 40 in a BIS number), a serial number and two check digits modulo 97.

fr.name: Numéro d'identification de la sécurité sociale (NISS)
fr.doc: Numéro de registre national ou numéro BIS d'une personne, utilisé comme clé dans la sécurité sociale.

ru.name: Идентификационный номер социального обеспечения Бельгии (INSZ/NISS)
ru.doc: Номер Национального реестра или номер BIS - ключ, по которому лицо идентифицируется в системе социального обеспечения Бельгии.

name: Belgian NIS code (REFNIS)
doc: Five-digit code of a Belgian administrative area in the REFNIS nomenclature of Statbel, the Belgian statistical office (formerly NIS/INS), used since the 1970 census. The first digit is the province, the second the arrondissement and the last three the municipality: 40000 is the province of East Flanders, 44000 the arrondissement of Ghent and 44021 the city of Ghent. The two provinces created when Brabant was split in 1995 have 20001 (Flemish Brabant) and 20002 (Walloon Brabant). 01000 is Belgium and 02000, 03000 and 04000 are the Flemish, Walloon and Brussels-Capital regions. A merged municipality gets a new code, so codes change with mergers (2019, 2025). A letter after the code denotes a former municipality (deelgemeente, section) of a merged one, as in 71022E (Stokrooie, part of Hasselt).

name: Belgian structured communication (OGM/VCS)
doc: Gestructureerde mededeling (OGM) or communication structurée (VCS), the 12-digit payment reference of Belgian credit transfers that lets the payee match a payment to an invoice or customer automatically. It is written in groups of three, four and five digits between three plus signs or three asterisks, as in +++090/9337/55493+++. The first ten digits are chosen by the payee, for example an invoice or customer number; the last two are their remainder divided by 97, or 97 when the remainder is 0. Banks refuse a transfer whose check digits do not match. In SEPA credit transfers it is sent as structured remittance information.

name: Belgian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Belgium, which FPS Foreign Affairs produces on request of a municipality or an embassy. It has eight characters, two letters followed by six digits, and no check digit. Microsoft Purview expects it without spaces or delimiters.

name: Belgian postal code
doc: Four-digit postal code used in Belgium since 1969; it never starts with 0. The first digit mostly shows the province, though some ranges are shared: 1xxx covers Brussels, western Flemish Brabant and Walloon Brabant, 3xxx eastern Flemish Brabant and Limburg, 6xxx parts of Hainaut and Luxembourg. The main town of an area has the round number, as in 8000 (Bruges) and 8500 (Kortrijk). Some institutions such as the EU institutions, NATO and the broadcasters have codes of their own. bpost asks not to write a country prefix such as B- before the code.

name: Belgian region and province code (ISO 3166-2:BE)
doc: Code of a Belgian region or province from ISO 3166-2:BE, BE- and three letters, alone or with the country code. The three regions are BE-BRU (Brussels-Capital), BE-VLG (Flemish Region) and BE-WAL (Walloon Region). The ten provinces have codes that start with V in Flanders (BE-VAN Antwerp, BE-VBR Flemish Brabant, BE-VLI Limburg, BE-VOV East Flanders, BE-VWV West Flanders) and with W in Wallonia (BE-WBR Walloon Brabant, BE-WHT Hainaut, BE-WLG Liège, BE-WLX Luxembourg, BE-WNA Namur). Brussels has no province.

name: Belgian enterprise number (KBO/BCE, VAT number)
doc: Ondernemingsnummer (numéro d'entreprise, Unternehmensnummer), the 10-digit number of a company, association, public body or self-employed person in the Crossroads Bank for Enterprises (KBO/BCE). With the prefix BE it is also the VAT number (BTW, TVA). It is usually written as 0415.580.365. The first digit is 0 or 1: the KBO started to assign numbers beginning with 1 on 19 September 2023, when the numbers beginning with 0 ran out. The last two digits are 97 minus the remainder of the first eight digits divided by 97. Older numbers had nine digits and are still often written without the leading 0, as in BE 428.759.497. Establishment units of an enterprise have numbers of their own, beginning with 2 to 8. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BE-BCE_KBO, and Peppol identifies Belgian participants with ISO 6523 scheme 0208 and the 10 digits.

nl.doc: Tiencijferig nummer van een onderneming in de Kruispuntbank van Ondernemingen (KBO); met het voorvoegsel BE ook het btw-nummer. Het begint met 0 of 1, de laatste twee cijfers zijn een controlegetal modulo 97.

fr.name: Numéro d'entreprise
fr.doc: Numéro à dix chiffres d'une entreprise dans la Banque-Carrefour des Entreprises (BCE); précédé de BE, c'est aussi le numéro de TVA. Il commence par 0 ou 1 et se termine par deux chiffres de contrôle modulo 97.

name: Belgian vehicle registration plate (nummerplaat)
doc: Registration number of a vehicle in Belgium as shown on the European-format plate issued since 15 November 2010: an index character, three letters and three digits, written with hyphens as 1-ABC-123. The index is a digit for ordinary plates: series 1 ran from 2010 and series 2 started with 2-AAA-001 in December 2020. Other indexes mark vehicle categories, among them M (motorcycles), S (mopeds), P (speed pedelecs), Q (trailers), O (oldtimers), T (taxis), G (agricultural vehicles), Z (dealers), Y (test drives) and V (repair businesses). The Vehicle Registration Service (DIV) issues the plates, and a plate normally stays with its owner rather than with the car. Plates of the formats used before 2010 (ABC-123 until 2008, 123-ABC from 2008), personalised, diplomatic, temporary and export plates follow other rules and are not covered.

ru.doc: Регистрационный номер на номерном знаке европейского образца с 2010 года - индексный символ, три буквы и три цифры (1-ABC-123).

name: Belgian national register number (Rijksregisternummer)
doc: Rijksregisternummer (numéro de registre national, Nationalregisternummer), the 11-digit number of a person in the Belgian National Register, often called the national number. It is printed on the identity card, but it is not the card number (be_eid). The first six digits are the date of birth as YYMMDD, the next three a serial number of the people born that day, odd for men (001 to 997) and even for women (002 to 998), and the last two a check number: 97 minus the remainder of the first nine digits divided by 97. For people born from 2000 a 2 is put before the nine digits for that calculation. When only the year, or the year and month, of birth is known the unknown parts are 00, and when the serial numbers of such a date run out the day becomes 01, 02 and so on; a fully unknown date is written as 000001. It is usually written as 85.07.30-033.28. Together with the BIS number it forms the social security identification number (be_insz).

fr.doc: Numéro d'identification à onze chiffres d'une personne au Registre national - date de naissance (AAMMJJ), numéro d'ordre (impair pour les hommes, pair pour les femmes) et chiffre de contrôle modulo 97.

ru.doc: Одиннадцатизначный номер физического лица в Национальном реестре Бельгии - дата рождения (ГГММДД), порядковый номер (нечётный у мужчин, чётный у женщин) и контрольное число по модулю 97.

name: Beverage
doc: Name of a drink or a kind of drink, such as coffee, tea, beer or orange juice, for example in menus, product catalogs or food surveys.

name: Burkinabé association registration number
doc: Registration number of an association at the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation of Burkina Faso. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BF-MATD; with that prefix an identifier reads BF-MATD-RNRD00045.

name: Bulgarian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Bulgaria. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Bulgarian unified civil number (EGN)
doc: Единен граждански номер, the 10-digit personal number of Bulgarian citizens. The first six digits encode the date of birth (the month is shifted for births outside the 20th century), the next three are a birth order number that also gives the sex, and the last digit is a check digit.

Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Bulgarian unified identification code (EIK)
doc: ЕИК (единен идентификационен код), the unified identification code under which a company is entered in the Commercial Register of Bulgaria. With the BG prefix it forms the VAT number (bg_vat). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BG-EIK; with that prefix an identifier reads BG-EIK-204853663.

name: Bulgarian EKATTE code
doc: Code in the Unified Classifier of Administrative-Territorial and Territorial Units (EKATTE) of the Bulgarian National Statistical Institute: five digits for a settlement, three letters for a province and three letters with two digits for a municipality.

name: Bulgarian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Bulgaria. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Bulgarian personal number of a foreigner (LNCh)
doc: Личен номер на чужденец, the 10-digit personal number given to foreigners who live in Bulgaria. The last digit is a weighted check digit.

name: Bulgarian postal code
doc: Postal code (пощенски код) in Bulgaria: four digits, from 1000 for central Sofia.

name: Bulgarian VAT identification number
doc: Bulgarian VAT identification number (ДДС номер). It is BG followed by 9 digits for legal entities or 10 digits for individuals, foreigners and others; a 10-digit number can be a personal number (EGN). The last digit is a check digit, with a different algorithm for each length.

name: Bahrain postal code
doc: Postal code in Bahrain: a number of three or four digits from 100 to 1299.

name: Burundian tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Burundi, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BI-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads BI-NIF-4000742330.

name: Bibcode (ADS bibliographic code)
doc: Nineteen-character identifier of a publication in the NASA Astrophysics Data System (ADS) and other astronomy databases. Its fixed fields are the year (4 digits), the publication code (5 characters), the volume (4), a qualifier (1), the first page (4) and the initial of the first author's surname (1). Periods fill unused positions: 1970ApJ...161L..77K is a 1970 letter (L) in The Astrophysical Journal, volume 161, page 77, by Kemp and others. The qualifier can also hold a Physical Review issue as a lowercase letter, or the letter of an article number. The regexp is adapted from the Wikidata format of property P819, with any letter allowed as the qualifier.

ru.doc: Девятнадцатисимвольный идентификатор публикации в астрофизической системе данных NASA (ADS).

doc: Datatype for 'SWIFT/BIC code' (bic) from rules in context 'finances'.

ru.doc: Банковский идентификационный код, БИК — уникальный идентификатор банка, используемый в платежных документах (платёжное поручение, аккредитив) на территории России. Классификатор БИКов ведёт Центробанк РФ (Банк России).

name: BioProject accession
doc: Accession of a research project in BioProject, the project registry shared by NCBI, ENA and DDBJ. A BioProject groups the sequence reads, assemblies, samples and other data that one project deposits. It is PRJ, a letter for the issuing centre (N, E or D), one more letter and a number.

name: BioSample accession
doc: Accession of a biological sample description in the BioSample databases of NCBI, EMBL-EBI and DDBJ. Sequencing, gene expression and proteomics submissions point to it to say which material was analysed. It is SAM, a letter for the issuing centre (N, E or D), an optional further letter and digits.

examples.description: ENA sample accession of the same sample, not a BioSample accession

name: BIP-32 extended key (xpub, xprv)
doc: Extended public or private key of a hierarchical deterministic (HD) wallet in the serialization of BIP-32: 4 version bytes, depth, fingerprint of the parent key, child number, 32-byte chain code and 33-byte key data, followed by a 4-byte checksum and encoded with Base58Check into 111 characters. Mainnet keys start with xpub (public) or xprv (private), testnet keys with tpub or tprv. An xprv value is a wallet secret that controls all funds below it; an xpub value reveals every address of its branch. Keys with the prefixes of SLIP-132 (ypub, zpub and others) use the same structure but are not matched here.

name: BIP-39 mnemonic phrase (seed phrase)
doc: Recovery phrase of a cryptocurrency wallet as defined by BIP 39: 12, 15, 18, 21 or 24 words from a fixed list of 2048 words, where the last word also carries a checksum of the entropy. The phrase, with an optional passphrase, gives the wallet seed from which BIP-32 keys are derived, so whoever knows it controls the wallet. The regexp covers the English word list (lower-case words of 3 to 8 letters separated by single spaces); BIP 39 also has word lists for other languages.

name: Year of birth
doc: Year in which a person was born, written with four digits, for example 1984. Data sets publish it instead of the full date of birth to make people harder to identify, but it is still personal data.

examples.description: a full date of birth is the datatype birthday

name: Birthday
doc: A birthday is the anniversary of the birth of a person, or figuratively of an institution. Birthdays of people are celebrated in numerous cultures, often with birthday gifts, birthday cards, a birthday party, or a rite of passage.

ru.name: День рождения
ru.doc: День рождения — годовщина рождения, соответствует дате рождения человека.

name: Place of birth
doc: The place where a person was born, usually a city or town, often followed by the region or country, such as "Montreal, QC, CAN". Together with a name and a birth date it helps to identify a person, so it is personal data.

name: Bitcoin Cash address (CashAddr)
doc: Address of Bitcoin Cash in the CashAddr format: the network prefix bitcoincash (it may be omitted), a colon and a Base32 payload with a version byte, the hash and a 40-bit BCH-code checksum. With a 160-bit hash the payload has 42 characters and starts with q (P2PKH) or p (P2SH). Lower case is preferred and upper case is allowed, never mixed. Addresses with longer hashes, testnet prefixes (bchtest, bchreg) and legacy Base58 addresses, which look like Bitcoin's, are not matched.

P2SH example of the CashAddr specification
Example of the CashAddr specification without the prefix

name: Bitcoin transaction ID (txid)
doc: Identifier of a Bitcoin transaction: the double SHA-256 hash of the serialized transaction without its witness data, written as 64 hexadecimal digits in reversed byte order, as block explorers and the Bitcoin Core RPC show it. Block hashes and the transaction IDs of Bitcoin forks (Litecoin, Bitcoin Cash, Dogecoin) have the same form, so the value alone does not tell them apart.

one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

name: Bitcoin payment URI (bitcoin:)
doc: URI of the bitcoin: scheme that wallets open from links and QR codes to start a payment (BIP 321, which replaces BIP 21). It holds an address and query parameters such as amount (in BTC), label, message, lightning (a BOLT 11 invoice) or further addresses. The scheme and the parameter names are case-insensitive, and QR codes often use upper case. The address part may be empty when the parameters carry the payment instructions.

Upper-case example of BIP 321 for QR codes (illustrative addresses)

name: Beninese unique tax identifier (IFU)
doc: Identifiant fiscal unique (IFU), the tax identifier of taxpayers in Benin, including companies and public bodies. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BJ-IFU; with that prefix an identifier reads BJ-IFU-3200901353510.

name: BLAKE2b-256 hash
doc: Digest of the BLAKE2b hash function with a 256-bit output. It is written as 64 hexadecimal digits. Other 256-bit digests (SHA-256, SHA3-256, Keccak-256, BLAKE3 and Streebog-256) have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: BLAKE2b-256 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

name: BLAKE2b-512 hash
doc: Digest of the BLAKE2b hash function with a 512-bit output. It is written as 128 hexadecimal digits. Other 512-bit digests (SHA-512, SHA3-512, Keccak-512 and Streebog-512) have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: BLAKE2b-512 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (127 instead of 128)

name: BLAKE3 hash
doc: Digest of the BLAKE3 hash function with its default 256-bit output, written as 64 hexadecimal digits. BLAKE3 is a fast successor of BLAKE2 and one of the registered algorithms of OCI content digests. It can also produce longer outputs, which the regexp does not cover. Other 256-bit digests (SHA-256, SHA3-256, Keccak-256, BLAKE2b-256 and Streebog-256) have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: BLAKE3 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

doc: Handle of a Bluesky account: a domain name, such as name.bsky.social or a custom domain.

name: Bolivian institutional classifier code
doc: Code of a public sector entity in the Bolivian Institutional Classifier (Clasificador Institucional). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BO-CINS; with that prefix an identifier reads BO-CINS-0065-10.

name: Bolivian tax identification number (NIT)
doc: Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Bolivia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as BO-NIT; with that prefix an identifier reads BO-NIT-301140029.

name: Boolean
doc: In computer science, the Boolean data type is a data type that has one of two possible values (usually denoted true and false) which is intended to represent the two truth values of logic and Boolean algebra.

ru.name: Логический тип
ru.doc: Логи́ческий тип да́нных, или булев тип, или булевый тип (от англ. Boolean или logical data type) — примитивный тип данных в информатике, принимающий два возможных значения, иногда называемых истиной (true) и ложью (false).

name: Brazilian driving licence registration number (CNH)
doc: Número de registro of the Brazilian national driving licence (Carteira Nacional de Habilitação), generated by the national BINCO system. It is unique to each driver for life and never reused. It has nine positions and two check digits, eleven digits in all; the check-digit algorithm is not published in the CONTRAN resolution.

name: Brazilian national health card number (CNS)
doc: Number of the Cartão Nacional de Saúde, the 15-digit identifier of a patient of the Brazilian Unified Health System (SUS), issued by the Ministry of Health and DATASUS. According to the ANS, numbers start with 1 or 2 (derived from the PIS base), 7 (generated by DATASUS) or 8 or 9 (generated locally). The DATASUS FHIR profile only requires 15 digits, which the regexp follows.

name: Brazilian municipality
doc: Name of a municipality (município) of Brazil, the level of local government below the state, such as São Paulo or Salvador. IBGE lists 5,570 of them, counting the Federal District; their codes are the pattern br_municipality_code.

patterns.doc: Seven-digit code of a Brazilian municipality assigned by IBGE, the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics. The first two digits are the code of the state, for example 35 for São Paulo, and the last digit is a check digit.

name: Brazilian municipality code (IBGE)
doc: Seven-digit code of a Brazilian municipality assigned by IBGE, the Brazilian Institute of Geography and Statistics. The first two digits are the code of the state, for example 35 for São Paulo, and the last digit is a check digit.

name: Brazilian PIS/PASEP/NIT/NIS number
doc: Eleven-digit worker number of Brazil used for labour and social security benefits. Caixa issues it as the PIS number; the PASEP number of public servants, the NIT of the INSS and the NIS share the same numbering. The last digit is a check digit. It is often written as NNN.NNNNN.NN-N.

doc: Brazilian postal code (CEP, Código de Endereçamento Postal): eight digits, usually written as five digits, a hyphen and three digits.

name: Brazilian vehicle registry code (RENAVAM)
doc: Code of a vehicle in the Registro Nacional de Veículos Automotores of Brazil. Since April 2013 it has eleven digits, ten digits and a check digit computed modulo 11; older nine-digit codes are padded with leading zeros.

doc: Número de inscrição of a voter, assigned by the Superior Electoral Court of Brazil: up to twelve digits, an eight-digit sequential number, a two-digit code of the state (01 to 27, 28 for voters abroad) and two check digits computed modulo 11. Leading zeros are often dropped in print; the regexp expects all twelve digits, optionally grouped with spaces.

name: Brazilian vehicle registration plate
doc: Registration number on the plate of a vehicle in Brazil, issued by the state DETRANs. The national format used from 1990 has three letters and four digits, written ABC-1234 or ABC·1234, and is still valid. The Mercosur format introduced in 2018 has seven characters in the order letter, letter, letter, digit, letter, digit, digit; converted plates replace the second digit with a letter, 0 by A to 9 by J.

name: CPF number (Cadastro de Pessoas Fisicas)

name: Dutch citizen service number (BSN)
doc: Burgerservicenummer (BSN), the personal number of everyone registered in the Dutch population register (BRP). It replaced the sofinummer in 2007 and keeps its numbers. The government uses it to identify a person in contacts with public bodies, the tax service, healthcare and education. The Rijksdienst voor Identiteitsgegevens (RvIG) issues the numbers, which carry no information about the person. A BSN has nine digits and passes the 11-proef (elfproef). The first eight digits are weighted 9 down to 2 and the last one -1, and the sum must be divisible by 11. Systems that store it as a number drop the leading zero, so 8-digit values occur; they are checked with the zero restored.

The letter is a postal district within one province or territory, and a 0 as the digit marks a rural area. doc: Chain-agnostic identifier of a blockchain defined by CAIP-2: a namespace of 3 to 8 lower-case letters, digits or hyphens that names an ecosystem (eip155 for EVM chains, bip122 for Bitcoin-like chains, cosmos, solana and others), a colon and a reference of up to 32 characters that identifies the chain within it, such as the EIP-155 chain ID or the start of the genesis block hash.

name: Radio call sign
doc: Identifier of a radio station, such as a broadcaster, a ship, an aircraft or an amateur radio operator, formed under the ITU Radio Regulations from a prefix allocated to the country and a suffix assigned by the national administration. Amateur radio call signs identify individual licence holders.

Each geographic area receives a unique numeric code ranging from 1 to 10 digits, which extend telescopically to refer to increasingly small areas.

name: Canada social insurance number (SIN)
doc: Social insurance number (SIN) is a number issued in Canada to administer various government programs.

name: CAS Registry Number

CCAM (Classification Commune des Actes Médicaux) is the French common classification of medical procedures used in the French healthcare system. CCAM codes are used to identify and classify medical acts and procedures for billing, reimbursement, and statistical purposes. The format consists of exactly 4 characters: 1 uppercase letter, 2 digits, and 1 uppercase letter (e.g., A123B).

name: Cell Ontology (CL) term ID
doc: Identifier of a cell type in the Cell Ontology, a structured vocabulary of cell types from prokaryotes to mammals, plants and fungi. It is CL: and seven digits; OBO PURLs and Wikidata write CL_ instead.

name: Cellosaurus accession (RRID:CVCL)

name: The Catalog of Federal Domestic Assistance (CFDA) number
doc: CFDA numbers are the system for identifying and sorting the 2,000+ federal programs. Each CFDA number contains five digits and appears in the following format: ##.### (e.g., 10.001 or 98.102).

doc: ISO 10962, generally known as CFI (Classification of Financial Instruments) is a six-letter-code used in the financial services industry to classify and describe the structure and function of a financial instrument (in the form of security or contract). The CIF (Código de Identificación Fiscal) is a Spanish tax identification code assigned to companies and legal entities. It consists of 9 characters: one letter from the set A-H, J-N, P-S, U-W (excluding I, O, and certain letters), followed by 7 digits, and ending with one alphanumeric character (letter or digit) that serves as a check digit.

doc: Code of the North American telecommunications industry, maintained by iconectiv (formerly Bellcore and Telcordia), that identifies telephone company buildings and the switches and other equipment in them. Four characters name the place and two the state, province or country; two more letters or digits name the building, which makes the 8-character site code, and three further characters name the equipment in an 11-character entity code.

Четыре символа обозначают населённый пункт, два — штат, провинцию или страну, ещё два — здание; три следующих символа обозначают оборудование.

name: Cloudflare Origin CA key
doc: Key for the Cloudflare Origin CA certificates API, often sent in the X-Auth-User-Service-Key header and also used by the Keyless SSL key server. It always starts with v1.0-; secret scanners expect 24 hexadecimal digits, a hyphen and 146 more hexadecimal digits.

name: Cameroonian taxpayer number (NIU)
doc: Numéro d'identifiant unique (NIU), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Cameroon. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as CM-NIU; with that prefix an identifier reads CM-NIU-M099600009248R.

name: Chinese administrative division code
doc: Code of an administrative division of the People's Republic of China used by the National Bureau of Statistics: six digits for provinces, prefectures and counties (GB/T 2260), up to twelve for townships and villages. Wikidata writes it in groups separated by spaces.

name: Chinese ordinary passport number
doc: Number of an ordinary passport issued by the National Immigration Administration of the People's Republic of China: nine characters. E-passports used E and eight digits until that range ran out in 2017, then E, a letter other than I and O, and seven digits, starting with EA0000001. Older ordinary passports, and now border tourism passports, use G and eight digits. Diplomatic, service and Hong Kong and Macao documents are not covered.

name: Chinese civil vehicle registration plate
doc: Registration number on the plate of a civil vehicle in mainland China under the standard GA 36-2018: the one-character abbreviation of the province, a letter of the issuing authority, often a separating dot, and a serial. Ordinary plates have five digits and letters, never I or O. Green new-energy plates have six characters: small vehicles start with an energy letter (D, A, B, C or E for pure electric, F, G, H, J or K for others), large vehicles end with it. Police, learner, trailer, Hong Kong, Macao and diplomatic plates are not covered.

name: Colombian department
doc: Name of one of the 32 departments of Colombia, such as Antioquia, Cundinamarca or Valle del Cauca. Bogotá, the Capital District, is often listed with them.

name: Colombian municipality
doc: Name of a municipality (municipio) of Colombia, the level below the department, such as Medellín, Cali or Leticia. Colombia has about 1,100 of them.

name: Colombian tax identification number (NIT)
doc: Número de Identificación Tributaria, the tax number of businesses and other taxpayers in Colombia, also called the RUT number (Registro Único Tributario). It has 7 to 15 digits and a check digit, and is often written with dots and a hyphen before the check digit.

name: Colombian postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Colombia: six digits. The first two digits are the department, such as 11 for Bogotá and 05 for Antioquia.

name: CODEN bibliographic code
doc: Six-character code for the title of a periodical or non-serial publication, defined by ASTM E250 and assigned by the International CODEN Service at Chemical Abstracts Service. For periodicals, four letters come from the title, the fifth letter is A to F, and the sixth character is a check character. For non-serial publications such as conference proceedings, the code starts with two digits. CODEN is common in chemistry and other science citations.

examples.description: The fifth letter of a periodical CODEN is A to F

name: COICOP code (Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose)
doc: Code of the UN Classification of Individual Consumption According to Purpose (COICOP), which classifies consumption expenditure by its purpose. Codes are written with dots: a two-digit division (01 to 15 in COICOP 2018) followed by one digit each for the group, class and subclass, as in 01.1.1.1. The COICOP 2018 structure published by the UN Statistics Division adds a fifth level under some subclasses (01.1.1.1.1). COICOP 1999 uses the same notation with fewer divisions, so the version cannot be told from the code alone.

The regexp does not cover percentages, an alpha channel or the space-separated syntax of CSS Color Level 4.

doc: Name of an IT product in the formatted string binding of Common Platform Enumeration (CPE) 2.3, maintained by NIST: cpe:2.3: followed by eleven colon-separated attributes - part (a for an application, o for an operating system, h for hardware), vendor, product, version, update, edition, language, sw_edition, target_sw, target_hw and other. An asterisk means any value and a hyphen means not applicable. The NVD CPE dictionary and CVE records name affected products this way. The regexp is the one of the CPE 2.3 naming XML schema. The older CPE 2.2 URI form (cpe:/a:...) is not covered.

name: Component/Part Identifier (CPID)
doc: GS1 identification key for a type of component or part, used mainly in the automotive industry. It is a GS1 Company Prefix followed by a component/part reference, up to 30 characters of GS1 character set 39 (digits, capital letters, '#', '-' and '/'); the first four characters are digits because the shortest GS1 Company Prefix has four. In barcodes it is carried by Application Identifier (8010), and (8011) adds the serial number of one part; the element strings are the patterns gs1_ai_8010 and gs1_ai_8011.

doc: Cédula de Persona Física, also called cédula de identidad, the identity number of people in Costa Rica. It has ten digits in the form 0P-TTTT-AAAA: the province, the volume (tomo) and the entry (asiento) in the civil register. The leading zeros of each part are often left out.

name: Costa Rican legal person ID number (cédula jurídica)

name: Costa Rican foreigner residence ID number (DIMEX)

name: CRC-32 checksum
doc: Check value of CRC-32 (CRC-32/ISO-HDLC, polynomial 0x04C11DB7), the cyclic redundancy check that Ethernet, ZIP, gzip and PNG use to detect accidental corruption of data. It is not a cryptographic hash and does not protect against deliberate changes. It is usually written as 8 hexadecimal digits; some tools, such as MySQL CRC32() and Python zlib.crc32(), return it as an unsigned 32-bit integer instead.

name: Cryptocurrency address
doc: Address that receives payments on a blockchain network. It is derived from a public key or a script and identifies an account or wallet without naming its owner. Each network has its own format; the registry describes them as separate datatypes: p2pkhaddr, p2shaddr, p2wpkhaddr, p2wshaddr and p2traddr (Bitcoin), ethereum_address (Ethereum and other EVM networks), litecoin_address, dogecoin_address, bitcoin_cash_address, tron_address, xrp_address, monero_address, solana_address and cardano_address. Use this record when only the field name tells that a value is an address.

name: Cryptocurrency name
doc: Name of a cryptocurrency, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin or Monero, in English or another language. A ticker such as BTC is the datatype cryptocurrency_ticker, a wallet address is crypto_address.

name: Cryptocurrency ticker symbol
doc: Short code of a cryptocurrency or token used by exchanges, wallets and price services, such as BTC for Bitcoin or ETH for Ether. No authority assigns these codes and ISO 4217 does not include them, so the same ticker can denote different tokens on different platforms. A registered, unambiguous identifier of a token is the ISO 24165 Digital Token Identifier (dti).

name: CUID (collision-resistant unique identifier)
doc: Identifier of the cuid library, written as the letter c followed by 24 lowercase base36 characters that encode a timestamp, a counter, a host fingerprint and random data. Prisma generates it with @default(cuid()). Its authors deprecated it for security reasons, since parts of it can be guessed, and recommend Cuid2 (cuid2) instead. The 25-character length holds while the base36 timestamp has 8 digits, which lasts until 2059.

name: Cuid2 identifier
doc: Identifier of the Cuid2 library, the successor of cuid. It is a SHA-3 hash of a timestamp, a counter, a host fingerprint and random data, written in lowercase base36 after an initial random letter, so it reveals no creation time. The default length is 24 characters; applications can choose other lengths up to 32, which the regexp does not cover.

name: CVE identifier
doc: Identifier that the CVE Program gives to a publicly disclosed cybersecurity vulnerability: CVE-, a four-digit year and a sequence number of at least four digits. The year is the year the vulnerability was discovered or the year the identifier was published. The CVE JSON 5 record format allows up to 19 digits in the sequence number. NVD, OSV.dev and the GitHub Advisory Database refer to vulnerabilities by their CVE identifier.

CVE records and security advisories use it to name the root cause of a vulnerability, for example CWE-79 for cross-site scripting. Wikidata stores the number without the CWE- prefix.

name: Czech bank account number
doc: Number of a bank account in the Czech Republic in the national format, written as prefix-number/bank code, for example 19-2000145399/0800. Czech National Bank decree 169/2011 defines it: an optional prefix (předčíslí) of up to six digits, an account number of two to ten digits with at least two that are not 0, and the 4-digit bank code (kód platebního styku). Leading zeros of both parts have no meaning. Each part has its own check: its digits, weighted 6 3 7 9 10 5 8 4 2 1 from the left after padding to ten digits, must give a sum divisible by 11.

name: Czech bank code (kód banky)
doc: Four-digit code of a bank or other payment service provider in Czech payments (kód platebního styku, usually called kód banky). It follows the slash in a national account number, as in 19-2000145399/0800, and is characters 5 to 8 of a Czech IBAN. The Czech National Bank publishes the list of codes with the provider names and BIC codes.

name: Czech data box ID (ID datové schránky)
doc: Identifier of a data box (datová schránka) in the Czech information system of data boxes (ISDS), which public authorities, companies, entrepreneurs and individuals use for official electronic delivery. It has seven characters from an alphabet of 32: lowercase Latin letters without o and l and the digits 2 to 9. The first six encode the box number, generated at random, and the seventh is a check character computed with the Luhn algorithm in base 32, as described in the ISDS web service documentation of the Ministry of the Interior. Boxes of individuals identify a person.

name: Czech VAT number (DIČ)
doc: Daňové identifikační číslo (DIČ), the Czech tax identification number, also used as the VAT (DPH) number. It is CZ followed by a base part: for a legal entity its 8-digit IČO, for an individual the 9- or 10-digit birth number (rodné číslo), or a number that the tax administrator assigns instead (vlastní identifikátor, VČP), for example to people without a birth number. Since 1 January 2021 an individual can ask for such a number so that the DIČ no longer contains the birth number. python-stdnum validates assigned numbers of 9 digits that start with 6 with their own check digit. The CZ prefix is often omitted or followed by a space.

name: Czech driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence (řidičský průkaz) issued in the Czech Republic. Microsoft Purview describes it as two letters and six digits, and matches the letter E, another letter, an optional space and six digits, without a check digit. Older licences may use other series.

name: Czech IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in the Czech Republic. Czech National Bank decree 169/2011 sets its form: 24 characters, CZ, two IBAN check digits, the 4-digit bank code (kód platebního styku) and the 16-digit account identifier, which is the 6-digit prefix and the 10-digit account number of the national format, both padded with leading zeros.

name: Czech business identification number (IČO)
doc: Identifikační číslo osoby (IČO), the eight-digit number that identifies a company, cooperative, association, public body or self-employed person in the Czech Republic. It was introduced on 1 January 1990. Registry courts assign it to companies, trade licensing offices to self-employed persons, and the Czech Statistical Office to the remaining economic subjects. Older, shorter numbers are padded with leading zeros. The last digit is a check digit (weights 8 to 2, modulo 11). Numbers can be looked up in ARES, the register of economic subjects. The DIČ of a legal entity is CZ followed by its IČO. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as CZ-ICO; with that prefix an identifier reads CZ-ICO-28179609.

It starts with 5 and does not change over time; the Czech Statistical Office describes five digits starting with 5 followed by a check digit.

doc: Number of a passport (cestovní pas) issued by the Czech Republic. Microsoft Purview describes it as eight digits without spaces or delimiters and without a check digit; Google Sensitive Data Protection detects it as CZECHIA_PASSPORT.

name: Czech postal code (PSČ)
doc: Poštovní směrovací číslo (PSČ), the five-digit postal code of the Czech Republic, usually written as three and two digits, as in 110 00. Czechoslovakia introduced it in 1973 and the system has not changed since. The first digit is the postal zone of 1973: 1 Prague, 2 Central Bohemia, 3 western and southern Bohemia, 4 northern Bohemia, 5 eastern Bohemia and western Moravia, 6 southern Moravia, 7 northern and eastern Moravia. Codes starting with 8, 9 and 0 belong to Slovakia. Mail from abroad may put CZ- before the code.

name: Czech birth number (rodné číslo)
doc: Rodné číslo, the Czech personal number; Slovakia uses the same scheme. The first six digits are the date of birth as YYMMDD. Women have 50 added to the month. Since 2004 (Act 53/2004) a further 20 is added to the month (70 for women) when the serial numbers of a day run out. Numbers of people born before 1954 have nine digits. Later ones have a tenth, check digit: the number is divisible by 11, except a few issued until 1985 whose first nine digits leave a remainder of 10 and that end in 0. It is usually written with a slash after the sixth digit. The Ministry of the Interior also assigns birth numbers to foreigners with long-term residence. Health insurance, social security and, by default, tax registration use it.

name: Czech region code (ISO 3166-2:CZ)
doc: Code of one of the 14 Czech regions (kraje) from ISO 3166-2:CZ, two digits after CZ-, such as CZ-10 (Prague), CZ-64 (Jihomoravský kraj) or CZ-80 (Moravskoslezský kraj), alone or with the country code. Codes of districts (okresy) have a third character, as in CZ-201 (Benešov) or CZ-20A (Praha-západ), and are not covered.

name: Czech vehicle registration plate (registrační značka)
doc: Registration number of a car in the Czech Republic as shown on the plate (registrační značka, colloquially SPZ). Plates issued since 2001 have seven characters shown as three and four, with no punctuation: a serial digit, the letter of the region (A Praha, S Středočeský, C Jihočeský, P Plzeňský, K Karlovarský, U Ústecký, L Liberecký, H Královéhradecký, E Pardubický, J Vysočina, B Jihomoravský, M Olomoucký, T Moravskoslezský, Z Zlínský), a digit or letter, and four digits, as in 1A2 3456. When the numbers of a region run out a letter replaces the next digit: Prague moved to 1AA A000 in 2023. Decree 343/2014 allows only the letters A-F, H-N, P, R-V and X-Z after the region code. Plates of electric vehicles have EL and five letters or digits. Personalised plates (up to eight characters), historic (V), sport (R), diplomatic and older district-based plates (before 2001) follow other rules and are not covered. Since 2015 a plate stays with the vehicle when it moves to another region.

name: Data URI (data: URL)
doc: URI of the data: scheme that carries a small file inline instead of pointing to it (RFC 2397): data:, an optional media type with parameters, an optional ;base64 flag, a comma and the data, percent-encoded or in Base64. HTML and CSS use it to embed images and fonts. Without a media type the data is text/plain;charset=US-ASCII. Browsers parse it as the WHATWG Fetch Standard describes, which is more lenient than RFC 2397.
