ru.name: Дата в формате ММ/ДД/ГГ (США)
ru.doc: Календарная дата в американском порядке: месяц, день и год из двух цифр через косую черту, например 12/25/24.

name: Date with a Polish month name
doc: Calendar date written in Polish with the month name, day first, usually with the month in the genitive case (5 maja 2022), optionally followed by roku or r. (5 maja 2022 r.). The nominative month (5 maj 2022) and a dot after the day (5. maja 2022) are accepted too.

ru.name: Дата с польским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на польском языке с названием месяца, например 5 maja 2022 r.

name: Date with a Portuguese month name
doc: Calendar date written in Portuguese with the month name, day first: 5 de maio de 2022, 5 maio 2022 or 5 mai 2022, optionally after the weekday (quinta-feira, 5 maio 2022). The month-first form maio 5, 2022 is accepted too.

ru.name: Дата с португальским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на португальском языке с названием месяца, например 5 de maio de 2022.

name: Date with a Romanian month name
doc: Calendar date written in Romanian with the month name, day first: 5 mai 2022 or, with an abbreviated month, 5 ian. 2022. The month is capitalised or in lower case.

ru.name: Дата с румынским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на румынском языке с названием месяца, например 5 mai 2022.

name: Date with a Russian month name
doc: Calendar date written in Russian with the month name in the genitive case, day first: 5 мая 2022, 5 мая 2022 г. or 5 мая 2022 года, optionally after the weekday (четверг, 5 мая 2022 г.). Also a numeric date followed by the year word (05.05.2022 г.), the month between dots or slashes (5.мая.2022, 5/мая/2022) and the month-first form Май 5, 2022.

examples.description: Numeric date with the year word

ru.name: Дата с русским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на русском языке с названием месяца в родительном падеже: 5 мая 2022, 5 мая 2022 г., 5 мая 2022 года, в том числе с днём недели; а также числовая дата с «г.» (05.05.2022 г.).

name: Date with a Slovak month name
doc: Calendar date written in Slovak with the month name, day first, usually with a dot after the day and the month in the genitive case (5. mája 2022). The nominative month (5. máj 2022) and a day without the dot are accepted too. Month names that Slovak shares with English (5. September 2022) also match date_english.

ru.name: Дата со словацким названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на словацком языке с названием месяца, например 5. mája 2022.

name: Date with a Spanish month name
doc: Calendar date written in Spanish with the month name, day first, with or without the preposition de: 5 de mayo de 2022, 5 mayo 2022, 5 de may de 2022, optionally after the weekday (jueves, 5 mayo 2022). The month-first form mayo 5, 2022 is accepted too.

ru.name: Дата с испанским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на испанском языке с названием месяца, например 5 de mayo de 2022.

name: Date with a Turkish month name
doc: Calendar date written in Turkish with the month name, day first, for example 5 Mayıs 2022, optionally followed by tarihinde or tarihli (on, dated).

ru.name: Дата с турецким названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на турецком языке с названием месяца, например 5 Mayıs 2022.

name: Date with a Ukrainian month name
doc: Calendar date written in Ukrainian with the month name, day first: 5 травня 2022 (genitive), 5 травень 2022 (nominative) or 5 трав. 2022 (abbreviated), optionally followed by р. or року (year): 5 травня 2022 р. The month is capitalised or in lower case.

ru.name: Дата с украинским названием месяца
ru.doc: Календарная дата на украинском языке с названием месяца, например 5 травня 2022.

name: Date as YYYYMMDD
doc: Calendar date written as eight digits without separators: four-digit year, two-digit month and two-digit day, for example 20241225. This is the basic format of ISO 8601, common in file names, logs and database exports. A column of such values is easy to take for integers.

ru.name: Дата в формате ГГГГММДД
ru.doc: Календарная дата из восьми цифр без разделителей: год, месяц и день, например 20241225. Это базовый формат ISO 8601.

name: Date as YYYY.MM.DD
doc: Calendar date written as four-digit year, month and day separated by dots, for example 2024.12.25.

ru.name: Дата в формате ГГГГ.ММ.ДД
ru.doc: Календарная дата: год из четырёх цифр, месяц и день через точки, например 2024.12.25.

name: Date as YYYY/MM/DD
doc: Calendar date written as four-digit year, month and day separated by slashes, for example 2024/12/25, as often written in Japan.

ru.name: Дата в формате ГГГГ/ММ/ДД
ru.doc: Календарная дата: год из четырёх цифр, месяц и день через косую черту, например 2024/12/25.

name: Date and time
doc: Date and time of day. The regexp covers the ISO 8601 extended form YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm[:ss[.fff]] with an optional time zone (Z or an offset), and the RFC 3339 variant with a space instead of T. Some data sets store plain dates as timestamps at midnight local time, for example 2021-05-24T21:00:00.000Z for 25 May 2021 in Moscow.

examples.description: Space separator, as allowed by RFC 3339
A date without a time is the datatype date

ru.name: Дата и время
ru.doc: Дата и время суток. Регулярное выражение описывает форму ISO 8601 ГГГГ-ММ-ДДTчч:мм[:сс[.fff]] с необязательным часовым поясом (Z или смещение) и вариант RFC 3339 с пробелом вместо T.

name: Chinese day name
doc: Chinese day name identifier

name: Day of month
doc: Month day, numeric value from 1 to 31

ru.name: День месяца
ru.doc: День месяца в значении от 1 до 31

name: Day of week
doc: Week day name

ru.name: День недели
ru.doc: Название для недели

patterns.name: Day of week (in English)
patterns.doc: Day of week writtern in English

patterns.name: Day of week (in Russian)
patterns.doc: Day of week written in Russian language

name: dbGaP study accession
doc: Accession of a study in dbGaP, the NCBI database that archives and distributes the results of studies of how genotype and phenotype interact. It is phs and six digits, optionally followed by the version of the study and of its participant set, as in phs000768.v2.p1.

examples.description: Study with version and participant set; Bioregistry example

name: dbSNP Reference SNP number (rsID)
doc: Identifier of a reference SNP record (RefSNP) in dbSNP, the database of short genetic variations kept by the US National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI). It is the letters rs followed by a number. A RefSNP groups the submitted reports of a variant at the same location of the reference genome, so genome-wide association studies, genotyping files and variant annotations use the rsID to name a variant.

examples.description: Variant of the HBB gene behind sickle cell disease
Submitted SNP (ss) number, not a RefSNP

ru.name: Идентификатор варианта dbSNP (rsID)
ru.doc: Номер записи RefSNP в базе генетических вариаций dbSNP (NCBI): буквы rs и число.

name: Contributor (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'contributor': an entity that contributed to the resource: a person, an organization or a service.

name: Coverage (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'coverage': the spatial or temporal topic of the resource, the place it applies to, or the jurisdiction it falls under.

name: Creator (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'creator': an entity primarily responsible for making the resource: a person, an organization or a service.

name: Date (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'date': a point or period of time in the life of the resource, such as its creation or publication; usually written in ISO 8601 form.

name: Description (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'description': an account of the resource, such as an abstract, a table of contents or a free-text description.

name: Format (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'format': the file format, physical medium or dimensions of the resource; for digital resources usually a media (MIME) type.

name: Identifier (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'identifier': an unambiguous reference to the resource in a given context, such as a URI, a DOI or an ISBN.

examples.description: DOI of the DOI Handbook, as a URI

name: Language (Dublin Core)
doc: A language of the resource.

ru.name: Язык
ru.doc: Язык ресурса

name: Publisher (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'publisher': an entity responsible for making the resource available.

name: Relation (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'relation': a related resource, usually referenced by its identifier.

name: Rights (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'rights': information about rights held in and over the resource, such as a license or a copyright statement.

name: Source (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'source': a related resource from which the described resource is derived.

name: Subject (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'subject': the topic of the resource, usually keywords, key phrases or classification codes.

name: Title (Dublin Core)
doc: A name given to the resource.

ru.name: Заголовок
ru.doc: Имя данное ресурсу

name: Type (Dublin Core)
doc: Dublin Core element 'type': the nature or genre of the resource, preferably a term from the DCMI Type Vocabulary such as Dataset, Text or Image.

name: Abstract (Dublin Core)
doc: A summary of the resource.

ru.name: Кратное изложение
ru.doc: Краткое изложение ресурса.

name: Datacommons unique id
doc: Every entity in Data Commons (DC) has a unique identifier, called ‘dcid’. So, for example, the dcid of California is ‘geoId/06’ and of India is ‘country/IND’.

name: Language (Dublin Core)
doc: A language of the resource.

name: Title (Dublin Core)
doc: A name given to the resource.

ru.doc: Имя данное ресурсу

name: DDI agency identifier
doc: Identifier of an organization that maintains metadata in the Data Documentation Initiative (DDI) standard, such as a national statistics office, a data archive or a survey project. The organization registers it in the DDI Agency Registry in the form country code, dot, name (for example dk.dst; international bodies use int, as in int.esseric), and may extend it with sub-agency labels separated by dots (us.mpc.ipums). The DDI Lifecycle schema allows labels of letters, digits and hyphens, up to 63 characters each and 253 in total. It also accepts a single label, but the identifiers listed in the registry all have a prefix, so the regexp requires at least one dot and a first label of two or three letters (the country code or int). Without that, dates such as 01.01.2015 and decimal numbers matched. The agency identifier is the namespace part of DDI URNs (urn:ddi:<agency>:<id>:<version>) and the registration authority in ISO/IEC 11179-6 identifiers (IRDI).

examples.description: Sub-agency of us.mpc (Minnesota Population Center), from the DDI Lifecycle guide
Full DDI URN, not the agency identifier alone
A date, not an agency identifier

name: German municipality key (Amtlicher Gemeindeschlüssel, AGS)
doc: Eight-digit official code of a German municipality that the statistical offices publish in the municipality directory (Gemeindeverzeichnis): two digits for the state (01 Schleswig-Holstein to 16 Thüringen), one for the government region, two for the district and three for the municipality. The first five digits are the district key (Kreisschlüssel).

ru.name: Официальный код общины Германии (AGS)
ru.doc: Восьмизначный код общины - две цифры земли, одна цифра административного округа, две цифры района и три цифры общины.

name: German regional key (Amtlicher Regionalschlüssel, ARS)
doc: Twelve-digit official regional key of a German municipality: the municipality key with a four-digit code of the municipal association (Gemeindeverband) inserted after the district, so two digits for the state, one for the government region, two for the district, four for the association and three for the municipality. Keys that end in zeros denote a district or an association as a whole.

examples.description: A municipality key (AGS), not a regional key

ru.name: Официальный региональный ключ Германии (ARS)
ru.doc: Двенадцатизначный код общины - код общины (AGS) с четырёхзначным кодом объединения общин после кода района.

name: German bank code (Bankleitzahl, BLZ)
doc: Bankleitzahl (BLZ), the eight-digit code of a bank or bank branch in Germany, introduced in 1970. The first three digits are the location number of the Bundesbank branch area (the first digit is the clearing area), the fourth is the banking group and the last four are chosen by the bank. The Deutsche Bundesbank publishes the directory of bank codes. Since SEPA it no longer appears alone in transfers but it is digits 5 to 12 of every German IBAN. It is often written in groups, as in 640 901 00.

examples.description: Volksbank Reutlingen, the example of German Wikipedia
The same code in its printed form
Bank code of the German IBAN documentation example DE89370400440532013000

ru.name: Банковский код Германии (Bankleitzahl)
ru.doc: Восьмизначный код банка или отделения банка в Германии; справочник кодов ведёт Бундесбанк. Входит в немецкий IBAN (символы 5-12).

name: FSK film age rating (Germany)
doc: Age rating of a film or video in Germany by the Freiwillige Selbstkontrolle der Filmwirtschaft (FSK): released for ages 0, 6, 12, 16 or 18. The mark reads FSK ab 12 freigegeben; the short form FSK 12 and the bare number are common. Video games are rated by the USK (de_usk_rating) with the same ages.

name: German IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Germany. It has 22 characters, all digits after the country code: DE, two IBAN check digits, the 8-digit bank code (Bankleitzahl) and a 10-digit account number padded with leading zeros. Since SEPA replaced the national transfer formats in 2014 it is the usual form of a German account number.

examples.description: The same IBAN in its printed form

ru.name: IBAN Германии
ru.doc: Международный номер банковского счёта в Германии - 22 символа - DE, две контрольные цифры, восьмизначный код банка (Bankleitzahl) и десятизначный номер счёта.

name: German institution code (Institutionskennzeichen, IK)
doc: Institutionskennzeichen (IK), the nine-digit number that identifies health insurers, hospitals, care services, pharmacies and other institutions that bill the German social insurance (§ 293 SGB V). Two digits classify the kind of institution, two give the state, four are a serial number and the last is a check digit: digits 3 to 8 weighted 2 1 2 1 2 1, 9 subtracted from products above 9, and the sum modulo 10. The IK of a health insurer is printed on the health card as its insurer number.

examples.description: Worked example of the check digit in German Wikipedia
Patient transport company (class 60) in Niedersachsen (region 03), serial 0008, from the German Wikipedia example

ru.name: Код учреждения в системе социального страхования Германии (IK)
ru.doc: Девятизначный номер больничных касс, больниц, аптек и других учреждений, которые выставляют счета социальному страхованию; последняя цифра контрольная.

name: German district key (Kreisschlüssel)
doc: Five-digit official code of a German district (Landkreis) or independent city: two digits for the state, one for the government region and two for the district. It is the first five digits of the municipality key (AGS).

ru.name: Код района Германии (Kreisschlüssel)
ru.doc: Пятизначный код района или города районного подчинения - первые пять цифр кода общины (AGS).

name: German health insurance number (Krankenversichertennummer, KVNR)
doc: Krankenversichertennummer (KVNR), the lifelong number of a person in the German statutory health insurance (§ 290 SGB V), printed on the electronic health card. The fixed part has ten characters: a random capital letter, eight random digits and a check digit. For the check, the letter becomes its position in the alphabet as two digits (A=01 ... Z=26), the ten digits are weighted 1 2 1 2 ..., and the digit sums of the products are added modulo 10. It is derived from the pension insurance number in a way that cannot be reversed. In data exchange the insurer code (IK) and further check digits follow, which gives 20 or 30 characters.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first character is a letter

ru.name: Номер застрахованного в обязательном медицинском страховании Германии (KVNR)
ru.doc: Пожизненный номер застрахованного на электронной карте медицинского страхования - буква, восемь случайных цифр и контрольная цифра.

name: German lifelong physician number (Lebenslange Arztnummer, LANR)
doc: Lebenslange Arztnummer (LANR), the nine-digit number that the Associations of Statutory Health Insurance Physicians (Kassenärztliche Vereinigungen) give to each doctor and psychotherapist who bills the statutory health insurance, valid since 1 July 2008. Six digits identify the person for life, the seventh is a check digit (the six digits weighted 4 and 9 alternately, 10 minus the sum modulo 10) and the last two are the specialty group. A doctor in several specialties has several LANRs that share the first seven digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

ru.name: Пожизненный номер врача в Германии (LANR)
ru.doc: Девятизначный номер врача или психотерапевта, работающего с обязательным медицинским страхованием, - шесть цифр личного номера, контрольная цифра и две цифры специальности.

name: German e-invoice routing ID (Leitweg-ID)
doc: Leitweg-ID, the address of a public contracting authority that receives electronic invoices in Germany, given as the buyer reference (BT-10) of an XRechnung. It has three parts separated by hyphens: a coarse address of 2 to 12 digits that starts with the state code (01 to 16) or 99 for the federal administration, an optional fine address of up to 30 letters and digits, and two check digits by ISO 7064 MOD 97-10.

examples.description: Synthetic ID with a fine address and valid check digits
The coarse address starts with two digits

ru.name: Маршрутный идентификатор электронного счёта Германии (Leitweg-ID)
ru.doc: Адрес государственного заказчика для получения электронных счетов (XRechnung) - грубый адрес из 2-12 цифр, необязательный точный адрес и две контрольные цифры ISO 7064 MOD 97-10.

name: German passport number
doc: Serial number of a German passport (Reisepass): nine characters, a four-character code of the issuing authority and a five-character random number. Since November 2007 it is alphanumeric and avoids vowels and the letters B, D, Q and S; since November 2021 the digit 0 is no longer used. Microsoft Purview expects the first character of a passport number to be C, F, G, H, J or K, and also accepts the check digit and the D (Germany) that follow the number in the machine-readable zone. Temporary passports use a letter and seven digits instead.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
The same number with its machine-readable zone check digit
Synthetic number in the documented format

ru.name: Номер паспорта Германии
ru.doc: Серийный номер немецкого заграничного паспорта - девять букв и цифр - код выдавшего органа и случайный номер.

name: German postal code (Postleitzahl)
doc: Five-digit postal code (Postleitzahl, PLZ) used in Germany since 1 July 1993, in the range 01001 to 99998. The first digit is the postal zone and the first two digits are the postal region.

examples.description: four digits, the system used before 1993

name: German pharmacy product number (Pharmazentralnummer, PZN)
doc: Pharmazentralnummer (PZN), the number that the Informationsstelle für Arzneispezialitäten (IFA) assigns to each pack of a medicine, medical device or other pharmacy product sold in Germany; a different pack size gets a different number. Since 2013 it has eight digits: seven digits and a check digit, the sum of the first seven weighted 1 to 7 modulo 11 (a result of 10 is never issued). The seven-digit numbers issued before were kept with a leading 0. Packs show it as PZN-12345678 next to a Code 39 barcode.

examples.description: Example of the IFA coding rules
The same number as printed on a pack
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

ru.name: Фармацевтический центральный номер Германии (PZN)
ru.doc: Номер упаковки лекарства или другого аптечного товара в Германии, который присваивает IFA, - семь цифр и контрольная цифра (сумма первых семи цифр с весами 1-7 по модулю 11).

name: German pension insurance number (Rentenversicherungsnummer)
doc: Versicherungsnummer of the German statutory pension insurance (§ 147 SGB VI), also called social insurance number (Sozialversicherungsnummer). It has 12 characters, as in 15 070649 C 103: a two-digit area number of the pension insurance institution, the date of birth as DDMMYY, the first letter of the birth name, a two-digit serial number (00-49 male, 50-99 female, diverse or no gender entry) and a check digit. For the check, the letter becomes its position in the alphabet as two digits (A=01 ... Z=26), the twelve digits are weighted 2 1 2 5 7 1 2 1 2 1 2 1, and the digit sums of the products are added modulo 10. The day of birth can be raised above 31 when a serial range is used up.

ru.name: Номер пенсионного страхования Германии (Rentenversicherungsnummer)
ru.doc: Номер застрахованного в обязательном пенсионном страховании - код региона, дата рождения, первая буква фамилии при рождении, порядковый номер (00-49 мужской пол, 50-99 женский, иной или не указанный) и контрольная цифра.

name: German pension insurance number (Rentenversicherungsnummer)
doc: Versicherungsnummer of the German statutory pension insurance (§ 147 SGB VI), also called social insurance number (Sozialversicherungsnummer). It has 12 characters, as in 15 070649 C 103: a two-digit area number of the pension insurance institution, the date of birth as DDMMYY, the first letter of the birth name, a two-digit serial number (00-49 male, 50-99 female, diverse or no gender entry) and a check digit. For the check, the letter becomes its position in the alphabet as two digits (A=01 ... Z=26), the twelve digits are weighted 2 1 2 5 7 1 2 1 2 1 2 1, and the digit sums of the products are added modulo 10. The day of birth can be raised above 31 when a serial range is used up.

ru.name: Номер пенсионного страхования Германии (Rentenversicherungsnummer)
ru.doc: Номер застрахованного в обязательном пенсионном страховании - код региона, дата рождения, первая буква фамилии при рождении, порядковый номер (00-49 мужской пол, 50-99 женский, иной или не указанный) и контрольная цифра.

name: German state (Land)
doc: Name of one of the 16 states (Länder) of Germany, such as Bayern, Nordrhein-Westfalen or Berlin, in German or English (Bavaria).

patterns.name: German state code (ISO 3166-2:DE)
patterns.doc: Two-letter code of a German state from ISO 3166-2:DE, such as BY (Bayern), NW (Nordrhein-Westfalen) or BE (Berlin), alone or after the country code as in DE-BY.

examples.description: Draft code for Brandenburg, replaced by DE-BB in ISO 3166-2:1998

name: German state code (ISO 3166-2:DE)
doc: Two-letter code of a German state from ISO 3166-2:DE, such as BY (Bayern), NW (Nordrhein-Westfalen) or BE (Berlin), alone or after the country code as in DE-BY.

examples.description: Draft code for Brandenburg, replaced by DE-BB in ISO 3166-2:1998

name: German tax identification number (Steuer-ID, IdNr.)
doc: Steuerliche Identifikationsnummer (IdNr., Steuer-ID), the personal tax number that the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt) assigns once to every person registered in Germany and that stays the same for life. It has 11 digits that are chosen at random and hold no personal data. The first digit is never 0; in the first ten digits one digit occurs twice (since 2016 also three times, never three in a row) and the others at most once. The last digit is an ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 check digit. It is often printed in groups, as in 36 574 261 809. It is not the Steuernummer that a tax office gives.

examples.description: The same number in its printed form
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

ru.name: Налоговый идентификационный номер Германии (Steuer-ID)
ru.doc: Пожизненный личный налоговый номер, который Федеральное центральное налоговое ведомство (BZSt) присваивает каждому зарегистрированному в Германии человеку, - 11 случайных цифр, последняя из которых контрольная (ISO 7064 MOD 11,10).

name: German tax number (Steuernummer)
doc: Steuernummer (St.-Nr.), the number that a regional German tax office gives to taxable individuals and organisations. The regional form has 10 or 11 digits and is usually written with slashes; the form that is unique in all of Germany has 13 digits. It holds the tax office number, a district number, a serial number and a check digit. The tax identification number (Steuer-ID) and, for businesses, the W-IdNr. are replacing it.

ru.name: Налоговый номер Германии (Steuernummer)
ru.doc: Номер, который региональная налоговая инспекция присваивает налогоплательщику, - 10-11 цифр в региональной форме или 13 цифр в общефедеральной.

name: USK video game age rating (Germany)
doc: Age rating of a video game in Germany by the Unterhaltungssoftware Selbstkontrolle (USK): released for ages 0, 6, 12, 16 or 18. The mark reads USK ab 12 freigegeben; the short form USK 12 and the bare number are common. Films are rated by the FSK (de_fsk_rating) with the same ages.

name: German vehicle registration plate (Kfz-Kennzeichen)
doc: Registration number of a vehicle in Germany as shown on the plate. It has a distinguishing sign of one to three capital letters for the registration district (umlauts possible), such as B (Berlin) or M (München), then an identification number of one or two letters (no umlauts) and one to four digits without a leading zero, at most eight characters in all. E marks electric vehicles and H historic vehicles. The euro plates, the only ones issued since November 2000, dropped the hyphen after the district sign, but it is still common in data. Official, military, diplomatic, seasonal and red dealer plates follow other rules and are not covered.

examples.description: Format example of a historic vehicle plate from German Wikipedia
Synthetic plate of München written with a hyphen
The letters of the identification number have no umlauts

ru.name: Номерной знак транспортного средства Германии
ru.doc: Регистрационный номер автомобиля в Германии - от одной до трёх букв района регистрации, одна-две буквы и от одной до четырёх цифр (не более восьми символов), E для электромобилей и H для исторических.

name: German business identification number (Wirtschafts-Identifikationsnummer, W-IdNr.)
doc: Wirtschafts-Identifikationsnummer (W-IdNr., § 139c AO), the permanent number of a business, legal entity or self-employed person for German tax and administrative purposes. The Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt) has issued it in stages since November 2024. It is DE, nine digits built like the VAT number (USt-IdNr.) and a five-digit suffix (Unterscheidungsmerkmal) for each economic activity: -00001 for the first, -00002 for the second and so on. A business that already had a USt-IdNr. keeps those nine digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number for a first economic activity
Synthetic number for a second economic activity
A VAT number without the suffix

ru.name: Хозяйственный идентификационный номер Германии (W-IdNr.)
ru.doc: Постоянный налоговый номер предприятия или самозанятого, который BZSt выдаёт с ноября 2024 года, - DE, девять цифр как в номере плательщика НДС и пятизначный суффикс вида деятельности (-00001).

name: German securities identification number (WKN)
doc: Wertpapierkennnummer, the 6-character code of digits and capital letters (without I and O) that identifies securities in Germany. It has no check digit and no internal structure, and the ISIN is replacing it. A German ISIN is DE000, the WKN and an ISIN check digit.

examples.description: The letter O is not used

ru.name: Идентификационный номер ценной бумаги в Германии (WKN)
ru.doc: Шестисимвольный код ценной бумаги из цифр и заглавных букв (без I и O), без контрольной цифры; его заменяет ISIN.

name: Date of death
doc: Date of death of the person

ru.name: Дата смерти
ru.doc: Дата смерти человека

name: Country name in German
doc: Name of a country written in German, such as Deutschland, Österreich, Frankreich or Vereinigte Staaten. Official short and long forms both occur, for example Russland and Russische Föderation.

name: Germany driver license number
doc: Number (Führerscheinnummer) of a German card driving licence: eleven characters. The first four are the key of the issuing authority (a letter for the state, A Baden-Württemberg to P Thüringen, two digits for the district and one more character), the next five a serial number of digits and capital letters, then a check digit and an issue number that grows with each new licence. For the check digit the first nine characters count as base-36 values (A=10 ... Z=35), are weighted 9 down to 1, and the sum modulo 11 is the digit, X for 10.

examples.description: Synthetic number whose check digit is X

ru.name: Номер водительского удостоверения Германии
ru.doc: Номер немецкого водительского удостоверения - 11 символов - код выдавшего органа, порядковый номер, контрольная цифра (или X) и номер выдачи.

name: German identity card number (Personalausweis)
doc: Serial number (Ausweisnummer) of a German identity card (Personalausweis). Cards issued since 1 November 2010 have nine characters: a four-character code of the issuing authority and a five-character random number, from the digits and the consonants C, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, R, T, V, W, X, Y and Z (0 is no longer used since November 2021). Microsoft Purview expects the first character to be L, M, N, P, R, T, V, W, X or Y; in the machine-readable zone a check digit follows. Cards issued from April 1987 to October 2010 have a nine-digit number and a check digit. The cards are produced by the Bundesdruckerei and issued by local registration offices and missions abroad.

name: German VAT identification number (USt-IdNr.)
doc: Umsatzsteuer-Identifikationsnummer (USt-IdNr.), the VAT identification number that the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt) issues to businesses in Germany for trade with other EU member states. It is DE followed by nine digits; the first digit is never 0 and the last one is an ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 check digit. It is not the domestic tax number (Steuernummer) or the personal tax identification number (Steuer-ID). Since November 2024 the business identification number (W-IdNr.) reuses it with a five-digit suffix.

ru.name: Идентификационный номер плательщика НДС Германии (USt-IdNr.)

name: DICOM unique identifier (UID)
doc: Unique identifier that DICOM medical imaging data uses for studies, series, image and other SOP instances, SOP classes, transfer syntaxes and other items. It has the numeric form of an ISO/IEC 8824 object identifier: an organization root followed by a suffix, both made of numbers separated by dots. A number has no leading zero unless it is the single digit 0, and the whole UID has at most 64 characters. The root 1.2.840.10008 is reserved for UIDs that the DICOM Standard defines itself. DICOM PS3.5, chapter 9, sets these rules. In a DICOM file a UID of odd length ends with a NUL padding byte, which the regexp does not accept.

name: Decentralized identifier (DID)
doc: Identifier defined by the W3C Recommendation Decentralized Identifiers (DIDs) v1.0 (2022). It has the form did:<method>:<method-specific-id>. The method name is lowercase letters and digits, such as web, key or plc, and the method decides how the identifier resolves to a DID document with keys and service endpoints. The method-specific part uses letters, digits, period, hyphen, underscore, percent-encoded bytes and colons, and does not end with a colon. A DID followed by a path, query or fragment is a DID URL, which the regexp does not accept. Bluesky and the AT Protocol identify accounts with did:plc and did:web DIDs.

examples.description: Example 1 of the W3C DID specification
did:web with an encoded port and a path, did:web method specification
Uppercase letter in the method name

name: DigitalOcean API token
doc: API token of DigitalOcean. The prefix tells the token type: dop_v1_ for a personal access token, doo_v1_ for an OAuth access token and dor_v1_ for an OAuth refresh token. 64 hexadecimal digits follow. The API takes the token in a bearer Authorization header.

name: Discogs artist ID
doc: Numeric identifier of an artist (a person, group or alias) in Discogs, the database and marketplace of music recordings, as in discogs.com/artist/<id>. Artists, labels, masters and releases are numbered separately, so the same number can name entities of different kinds, and the field name matters.

name: Discogs label ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a record label, studio, series or company in Discogs, the database and marketplace of music recordings, as in discogs.com/label/<id>. Artists, labels, masters and releases are numbered separately, so the same number can name entities of different kinds, and the field name matters.

name: Discogs master release ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a master release, which groups all editions of an album, single or other release, in Discogs, the database and marketplace of music recordings, as in discogs.com/master/<id>. Artists, labels, masters and releases are numbered separately, so the same number can name entities of different kinds, and the field name matters.

examples.description: The Dark Side of the Moon

name: Discogs release ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a release, one edition of a recording with its own format, label, country and catalogue number, in Discogs, the database and marketplace of music recordings, as in discogs.com/release/<id>. Artists, labels, masters and releases are numbered separately, so the same number can name entities of different kinds, and the field name matters.

name: Discount (money)
doc: Discount from price sub-type of money

name: Indian district by known name

name: Danish business registration number (CVR)
doc: CVR-nummer, the 8-digit number of a business in the Danish Central Business Register. With the DK prefix it is also the VAT number (momsregistreringsnummer). It does not start with 0 and has a weighted modulo 11 check.

name: Danish driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Denmark. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Danish municipality code (kommunekode)
doc: Three-digit code of a Danish municipality, used in official registers and statistics.

name: Danish passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Denmark. Microsoft Purview looks for nine digits.

name: Danish postal code
doc: Postal code (postnummer) in Denmark: four digits, such as 1050 for central Copenhagen. Greenland uses codes from the same series.

name: CPR-Number, Personal identification number (Denmark)
doc: The Danish Personal Identification number is a national identification number, which is part of the personal information stored in the Civil Registration System (Danish: Det Centrale Personregister, Greenlandic: Inunnik Qitiusumik Nalunaarsuiffik).

name: DNS resource record type
doc: Mnemonic of a DNS resource record type, such as A (IPv4 address), AAAA (IPv6 address), CNAME (alias), MX (mail server), NS (name server), TXT (text) or SOA (start of authority). DNS zone files, resolver and passive DNS logs and DNS APIs store it. IANA assigns the 16-bit type values and their mnemonics in the DNS Parameters registry. The regexp lists the mnemonics registered in November 2026, the query types AXFR, IXFR and ANY, and the generic form TYPE<number> of RFC 3597 for types without a mnemonic. It accepts only uppercase, the usual form.

ru.name: Тип ресурсной записи DNS
ru.doc: Мнемоника типа записи DNS, например A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS или TXT.

name: Dominican Republic identity number (cédula)
doc: Cédula de identidad y electoral, the 11-digit identification number that the Dominican Republic gives to citizens and residents. It is usually written as 3, 7 and 1 digits separated by hyphens; the last digit is a Luhn check digit.

Current numbers have 11 characters and start with B followed by a 2-digit document type; electronic receipts (e-CF) have 13 characters and start with E; the older 19-character form starts with A or P.

name: Digital Object Identifier (DOI)
doc: A digital object identifier (DOI) is a persistent identifier or handle used to identify objects uniquely, standardized by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

ru.doc: Цифровой идентификатор объекта (англ. digital object identifier (DOI), дискретный объекта идентификатор (ДОИ)) — основной элемент системы ДОИ, предназначенной для обозначения объектов информационной деятельности.

name: Doppler token
doc: Access token of the Doppler secrets manager. Doppler documents one format per token type, each starting with dp. and a type code: dp.pt. (personal), dp.st. (service, optionally followed by a lowercase name of 2 to 35 characters and a dot), dp.ct. (CLI), dp.sa. (service account), dp.scim. (SCIM) and dp.audit. (audit). 40 to 44 letters and digits follow.

name: Driver's license number (universal)
doc: Number of a driving licence, the document that a public authority issues to allow a person to drive motor vehicles. Each country or state defines its own format, so the registry keeps one record per issuer as a child of this one.

name: DrugBank ID
doc: Accession number of a drug in DrugBank, a database of drugs and drug targets started at the University of Alberta. A drug accession is "DB" followed by five digits; salts use "DBSALT" and drug categories "DBCAT", each followed by six digits.

examples.description: Digits are not zero-padded to five

ru.name: Идентификатор DrugBank
ru.doc: Номер лекарственного средства в базе данных DrugBank.

name: Digital Token Identifier (ISO 24165 DTI)
doc: Identifier of a digital token (a native cryptocurrency or a token issued on another blockchain) under ISO 24165, assigned by the Digital Token Identifier Foundation (DTIF) and listed in its public registry. It has 9 characters: an 8-character random base made of digits and consonants (no vowels and no Y, the first character is never 0) and a check character. The check character follows Annex A of ISO 24165-1, but codes registered before the algorithm keep their original check character, so no checksum is enforced here. DTIs identify crypto-assets in financial and regulatory reporting.

name: DSSTox substance ID (DTXSID)
doc: Identifier of a substance in DSSTox, the curated chemistry database of the US Environmental Protection Agency (EPA) behind the CompTox Chemicals Dashboard. It is "DTXSID" followed by seven to nine digits.

ru.name: Идентификатор вещества DSSTox (DTXSID)

name: Data Universal Numbering System (DUNS)
doc: The Data Universal Numbering System, abbreviated as DUNS or D-U-N-S, is a proprietary system developed and managed by Dun & Bradstreet (D&B) that assigns a unique numeric identifier, referred to as a "DUNS number" to a single business entity. It was introduced in 1963 to support D&B's credit reporting practice.

name: Dynatrace token
doc: Access token of Dynatrace in the format used since Dynatrace version 1.210: a prefix that names the token type (dt0 followed by a letter and two digits, such as dt0c01 or dt0s01), a 24-character public part and a 64-character secret part, separated by dots and written in uppercase letters and digits. The prefix and the public part form the token identifier, which may appear in logs; the secret part must not.

examples.description: Token identifier only, without the secret part

name: Algerian tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'Identification Fiscale, the tax number that the Algerian tax administration has assigned since 2006 in place of the older NIS number. It is given to individuals, companies, public bodies, associations and branches of foreign companies. It has 15 digits; a 20-digit form identifies a branch or secondary establishment. Digits are often written in groups of three separated by spaces.

examples.description: Example from the python-stdnum documentation, written in groups
20-digit branch form, example from the python-stdnum documentation

name: Algeria postal code
doc: Postal code in Algeria: five digits.

name: E number (food additive)
doc: Code of a food additive approved in the European Union: the letter E and three or four digits, sometimes with a letter or a roman numeral for a subclass, such as E330 for citric acid.

name: European Article Number (EAN-13, EAN-8)
doc: GS1 barcode number of a trade item, the form of the GTIN printed under EAN-13 and EAN-8 barcodes on retail goods, books, music releases and video discs. EAN-13 has 13 digits: a GS1 prefix, a company number, an item reference and a check digit. EAN-8 has 8 digits and is used on small packages. The last digit is a GS1 mod 10 check digit. Books carry their ISBN-13 as an EAN-13 with the prefix 978 or 979. A GS1 element string (gtin) carries the same number as 14 digits, with leading zeros, after the Application Identifier 01.

name: Easting (projected coordinate)
doc: Eastward coordinate of a point in a projected coordinate reference system, such as a UTM zone or the British National Grid, usually in metres from a false origin. It is paired with a northing. Unlike longitude, its origin and scale depend on the projection, so the value has a meaning only together with its coordinate reference system.

name: European Business Identifier (EBID)
doc: EBID, the identifier of a company or production site in the directory of German and Austrian companies of the CAS Group (Unternehmensverzeichnis.org). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZZ-EBID; with that prefix an identifier reads ZZ-EBID-2-500897-444478.

name: Ecuadorian identity card number (cédula)
doc: Cédula de identidad, the 10-digit number that identifies citizens of Ecuador. The first two digits are a province code and the last digit is a check digit.

name: Enzyme Commission (EC) number
doc: Classification number of an enzyme by the reaction it catalyses, assigned by the IUBMB: four numbers separated by dots, such as 3.4.21.5. A hyphen stands for an unassigned level and an n prefix marks a preliminary number. It differs from the European Community (EC) number of a chemical substance.

name: Ecuadorian province
doc: Name of one of the 24 provinces of Ecuador, such as Pichincha, Guayas or Galápagos.

name: Ecuadorian taxpayer number (RUC)
doc: Registro Único de Contribuyentes, the 13-digit tax number in Ecuador. The third digit shows the kind of taxpayer: below 6 for natural persons (their cédula followed by an establishment number), 6 for public entities and 9 for private companies.

name: ECLASS classification class code
doc: Coded name of a class in the ECLASS product classification maintained by ECLASS e.V.: eight digits, two for each of four levels (segment, main group, group and commodity class). Higher levels end in 00 pairs. The code is also displayed with hyphens between the pairs.

examples.description: Blackberry, in the hyphenated display form

name: ECLASS IRDI
doc: International Registration Data Identifier of an ECLASS element, 20 characters long: the supplier code 0173-1, a hash sign, a two-character element type (01 for classes, 02 for properties), a hyphen, a six-character concept code, a hash sign and a three-digit version.

examples.description: IRDI of the class Feed-through terminal block

name: European Case Law Identifier (ECLI)
doc: Identifier of a court decision, introduced by conclusions of the Council of the European Union published in 2011. It has five parts separated by colons: ECLI, the country code, a court code of at most seven characters, the year of the decision and a unique part of at most 25 letters, digits and dots. Country codes follow the EU style guide, so Greece is EL and the United Kingdom UK; the EU courts use EU and the European Court of Human Rights CE.

name: Evidence and Conclusion Ontology (ECO) term ID
doc: Identifier of a term in the Evidence and Conclusion Ontology, which classifies the kinds of evidence behind scientific statements, so that gene and protein annotations can say how they were made. It is ECO: and seven digits; OBO PURLs and Wikidata write ECO_ instead.

name: UN/EDIFACT message type
doc: Six-letter code that names a standard message of UN/EDIFACT, the United Nations rules for electronic data interchange in trade, transport and administration, for example ORDERS for a purchase order or INVOIC for an invoice. The code is written in the message header (UNH segment) together with the directory version. UN/CEFACT publishes the message types in each release of the UN/EDIFACT directories.

doc: Identifier of a film, television or radio work in the Entertainment Identifier Registry, which studios, broadcasters and distributors use to refer to the same title, edit or encoding. An EIDR content ID is a DOI with the prefix 10.5240 and a suffix of five groups of four hexadecimal digits and a check character (ISO 7064 mod 37,36). EIDR party IDs (prefix 10.5237) and video service IDs (prefix 10.5239) are other identifiers of the same registry.

ru.name: Идентификатор контента EIDR
ru.doc: Идентификатор фильма, телевизионной или радиопрограммы в реестре EIDR. Это DOI с префиксом 10.5240.

name: EIDR party ID
doc: Identifier of a party, a company such as a studio, producer, broadcaster or distributor, in the Entertainment Identifier Registry. It is a DOI with the prefix 10.5237 and two groups of four characters. Films and programmes have EIDR content IDs (eidr) with the prefix 10.5240.

examples.description: EIDR content ID of Toy Story (eidr)

name: Elevation above sea level
doc: Height of a place, such as a mountain summit, a town or a weather station, above mean sea level. Datasets store it as a number in metres or feet, sometimes with the unit after the number. Places below sea level have negative values. Schema.org reads a number without a unit as metres.

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

examples.description: summit of Mount Everest, in metres

name: European Legislation Identifier (ELI)
doc: HTTP URI that identifies a piece of legislation under the European Legislation Identifier framework. Each jurisdiction defines its own URI template from common components such as jurisdiction, type, year, number, version and language, in an order it chooses; the EU level uses data.europa.eu/eli/. There is no fixed syntax: the regexp only requires a web URI with an /eli/ path segment, which every known implementation has but the framework does not mandate.

examples.description: ELI of a Swiss federal act
A EUR-Lex link without an ELI path

name: Email address
doc: Address of an electronic mailbox in the form local-part@domain, defined in section 3.4.1 of RFC 5322. The local part names the mailbox, and the domain says which mail server accepts messages for it. The standard grammar also allows quoted local parts, comments and IP address literals, and RFC 6531 allows non-ASCII characters; the regexp covers the common form: letters, digits and . _ % + - in the local part and a dotted domain name.

examples.description: Dots, a plus tag and a subdomain

ru.name: Адрес электронной почты
ru.doc: Адрес почтового ящика в форме локальная_часть@домен (RFC 5322).

name: Email address
doc: Address of an electronic mailbox in the form local-part@domain, defined in section 3.4.1 of RFC 5322. The local part names the mailbox, and the domain says which mail server accepts messages for it. The standard grammar also allows quoted local parts, comments and IP address literals, and RFC 6531 allows non-ASCII characters; the regexp covers the common form: letters, digits and . _ % + - in the local part and a dotted domain name.

examples.description: Dots, a plus tag and a subdomain

ru.name: Адрес электронной почты
ru.doc: Адрес почтового ящика в форме локальная_часть@домен (RFC 5322).

name: European Medical Device Nomenclature (EMDN) code
doc: Code of the European Medical Device Nomenclature, which the European Commission maintains for the Medical Devices and In Vitro Diagnostic Regulations and EUDAMED. It is a category letter followed by a two-digit group and up to five two-digit type levels, at most 13 characters. A bare category letter is also a code but is not matched.

name: Emission inventory field by name
doc: Datatype for 'Emission inventory field by name' (emissioninventory) from rules in context 'environment'.

name: Company/business name in English
doc: English written company/business/legal name of business entity

name: Country name (English)
doc: Name of the country in English

name: Day of week (in English)
doc: Day of week writtern in English

name: Engine number by field name
doc: Engine number by field name number

name: ENI Number
doc: An ENI number (European Number of Identification or European Vessel Identification Number) is a registration for ships capable of navigating on inland European waters. It is a unique, eight-digit identifier that is attached to a hull for its entire lifetime, independent of the vessels current name or flag.

name: Month name (English)
doc: English name of the month

name: Short name of month (English)
doc: Abbreviated short English name/abbreviation of month

name: Person nationality in English
doc: Nationality of the person written in English

name: ENS name (.eth)
doc: Name in the Ethereum Name Service (ENS), such as foo.eth, that resolves to an Ethereum address and other records. A name is a sequence of labels separated by dots and normalized by ENSIP-15, which is based on Unicode UTS-46, so labels may contain non-Latin letters and emoji. The regexp covers names under the .eth top-level domain; ENS can also resolve imported DNS names, which look like ordinary domain names.

name: Ensembl stable ID (gene, transcript or protein)
doc: Stable identifier that the Ensembl genome database gives to a gene, transcript or protein of a vertebrate genome. It is ENS, a three-letter species code (none for human, MUS for mouse, RNO for rat, DAR for zebrafish), a feature letter (G for gene, T for transcript, P for protein) and eleven digits. A version suffix such as .8 may follow; it grows when the feature changes. Ensembl Genomes (plants, fungi, protists, bacteria) and some model organisms, such as fly and yeast, use other identifiers, which the regexp does not cover.

examples.description: Human transcript BRCA2-201, with its version
X is not a feature letter

ru.name: Стабильный идентификатор Ensembl
ru.doc: Идентификатор гена, транскрипта или белка позвоночных в базе Ensembl: ENS, код вида, буква типа объекта и 11 цифр.

name: Ensembl gene ID
doc: Stable identifier of a gene in Ensembl, the genome database of EMBL-EBI. It is "ENS", a three-letter species code (none for human, MUS for mouse, GAL for chicken), the feature letter G for gene and eleven digits. A version number may follow after a dot. Transcripts (T), proteins (P) and exons (E) use the same scheme with their own letter and are not covered here.

examples.description: Ensembl transcript ID, not a gene ID

ru.name: Идентификатор гена Ensembl
ru.doc: Постоянный идентификатор гена в геномной базе данных Ensembl.

name: Standard Occupational Classification System (US and GB)
doc: Standard Occupational Classification System

examples.description: Mental Health and Substance Abuse Social Workers

name: Economic Operators Registration and Identification number (EORI)
doc: EORI number, the identifier of a business or other economic operator in the customs procedures of the European Union. It starts with the code of the country that issued it. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as XI-EORI; with that prefix an identifier reads XI-EORI-NL810656371.

patterns.name: Dutch EORI number
patterns.doc: EORI number issued in the Netherlands for customs procedures in the European Union, NL followed by nine digits. A company that has an RSIN and files its own customs declarations composes it from NL and its RSIN, padded with leading zeros to nine digits. Other businesses, sole proprietorships among them, request one from Dutch Customs (Douane).

examples.description: Built from the RSIN example of the KVK Zoeken API

nl.name: EORI-nummer
nl.doc: NL gevolgd door negen cijfers; een bedrijf met een RSIN gebruikt NL en zijn RSIN.

ru.name: Номер EORI Нидерландов
ru.doc: NL и девять цифр; компания с RSIN составляет номер из NL и своего RSIN.

name: European patent publication number
doc: Number under which the European Patent Office publishes documents from one European patent application: EP, a seven-digit serial number shared by all publications of the application, and an optional kind code. A1 to A4 mark application publications and search reports, B1 and B2 patent specifications; 8 and 9 in place of the digit mark corrections and corrected reprints. Databases that drop the leading zeros of the serial number are not covered.

examples.description: Application publication of European patent application 1000000
Patent specification of the same application
Publication number written without a kind code

name: Electronic Product Code (EPC) pure identity URI
doc: Identifier of one individual physical object in the GS1 EPC Tag Data Standard, written as a URN: urn:epc:id:<scheme>:<fields>. The scheme says which GS1 key is used, for example sgtin (a GTIN plus a serial number), sscc, sgln or grai. The fields hold the GS1 Company Prefix and the rest of the key separated by dots, without the check digit. The same identifier can be encoded in RFID tags and in barcodes.

examples.description: SGTIN of GS1's example GTIN 09506000134352 with serial number 1001
Tag URI, not a pure identity URI

name: Etablissements publics de cooperation intercommunale (EPCI)
doc: Etablissements publics de cooperation intercommunale (EPCI). French administrative geo code

name: Epidemiological week (CDC MMWR week)
doc: Week number used by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) to report notifiable diseases in the Morbidity and Mortality Weekly Report (MMWR). MMWR weeks start on Sunday. Week 1 is the first week of the year with at least four days in that calendar year, so the last days of December can fall in week 1 of the next year. Values run from 1 to 53. Some data sets combine year and week as YYYYWW (202101); that form looks like a year and month, so it is not covered by the regexp.

examples.description: last week of a 52-week MMWR year

name: EPSG coordinate reference system code
doc: Identifier of a coordinate reference system (CRS) in the EPSG Geodetic Parameter Dataset. The regexp covers the forms that name the authority: EPSG:4326, used by PROJ and many GIS tools, the OGC URN urn:ogc:def:crs:EPSG::4326 and the OGC URI http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/4326. The code itself is a number of four or five digits, and Wikidata stores only that number; a bare number is not covered because it looks like any other number.

name: Spanish bank account code (CCC)
doc: Código Cuenta Cliente, the 20-digit Spanish bank account number: a 4-digit bank code, a 4-digit office code, two check digits and a 10-digit account number. Since 2014 it is used inside the Spanish IBAN.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Spanish energy supply point code (CUPS)
doc: Código Unificado de Punto de Suministro, the identifier of an electricity or piped gas supply point in Spain. It has 20 or 22 characters: ES, a 4-digit distribution company code, a 12-digit supply point number, two check letters and, optionally, a border point digit and letter.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

es.name: Código Unificado de Punto de Suministro (CUPS)

name: Spanish DIR3 code
doc: Code of an organisational unit or office of the Spanish public administration in the Common Directory of Organisational Units and Offices (Directorio Común de Unidades Orgánicas y Oficinas, DIR3). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ES-DIR3; with that prefix an identifier reads ES-DIR3-E04100802.

name: Spanish national identity document number (DNI)
doc: Documento Nacional de Identidad, the identity number of Spanish citizens: eight digits and a check letter, which is the number modulo 23 looked up in TRWAGMYFPDXBNJZSQVHLCKE. The same value is the person's tax number (NIF). Foreigners receive an NIE instead.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
python-stdnum test value, with a hyphen before the letter

name: Spanish IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Spain. It has 24 characters: ES, two IBAN check digits and the 20-digit CCC.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Spanish INE municipality code
doc: Code of a Spanish province (two digits), municipality (five digits) or populated entity (eleven digits) assigned by the National Statistics Institute (INE).

name: Spanish Ministry of Justice registration number
doc: Registration number of an organisation, such as a foundation or a religious entity, in one of the public registers of the Ministry of Justice of Spain. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ES-MDJ; with that prefix an identifier reads ES-MDJ-539SND.

name: Spanish social security number
doc: Spanish social security affiliation number (número de la Seguridad Social): a two-digit province code, seven or eight digits and two check digits, optionally separated by slashes.

purview: EU Social Security Number (SSN) or Equivalent ID
EU social security number or equivalent identification

name: Spanish province
doc: Name of one of the 50 provinces of Spain, such as Madrid, Barcelona or A Coruña, in Spanish or in a co-official language (Alacant). Ceuta and Melilla are autonomous cities outside the provinces.

name: Spanish cadastral reference (referencia catastral)
doc: Referencia catastral, the 20-character identifier that the Spanish Directorate General for Cadastre gives to a real estate property. It holds 14 characters for the parcel, 4 for the property within the parcel and 2 check letters; digits and letters, including Ñ, are used.

examples.description: The first example in its printed form

name: ESCO occupation URI
doc: URI of an occupation in ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations), the multilingual classification of the European Commission. The URI is http://data.europa.eu/esco/occupation/ followed by a lowercase UUID; Wikidata stores only the UUID. Every ESCO occupation sits under an ISCO-08 unit group (isco08), and ESCO links it to its essential and optional skills (esco_skill).

examples.description: A skill URI, not an occupation

name: ESCO skill URI
doc: URI of a skill, competence or knowledge concept in ESCO (European Skills, Competences, Qualifications and Occupations), the multilingual classification of the European Commission. The URI is http://data.europa.eu/esco/skill/ followed by a lowercase UUID; Wikidata stores only the UUID. ESCO links each occupation (esco_occupation) to its essential and optional skills.

examples.description: An occupation URI, not a skill

name: Spain driver license number
doc: Alphanumeric value of the Spain driver license

name: Electronic Serial Number (ESN) of a mobile device
doc: 32-bit identifier of AMPS and CDMA mobile devices, replaced by the MEID (meid). It is written as 8 hexadecimal digits or as an 11-digit decimal number, in which the first three digits encode the first eight bits (000 to 255) and the other eight digits the remaining 24 bits. The prefix 80 in hexadecimal (128 in decimal) marks a pseudo-ESN derived from an MEID, which is not guaranteed to be unique.

examples.description: The same ESN in decimal form
The same pseudo-ESN in decimal form
Seven hexadecimal digits, one too few
The first three decimal digits cannot exceed 255

ru.name: Электронный серийный номер (ESN) мобильного устройства
ru.doc: 32-битный идентификатор мобильных устройств стандартов AMPS и CDMA, заменённый MEID. Записывается 8 шестнадцатеричными цифрами или 11-значным десятичным числом. Префикс 80 (128 в десятичной записи) обозначает псевдо-ESN, вычисленный из MEID.

name: Spanish Foreigner Identity Number (NIE)
doc: The NIE is a tax identification number in Spain, known in Spanish as the NIE, or more formally the Numero de identidad de extranjero

name: Spanish Tax identification number
doc: Spanish tax identification number used to identify tax paying individuals

name: Spanish passport number
doc: Number of Spanish passport

name: Spanish postal code (by language)
doc: Spanish postal code (by language)

name: ESRB video game rating
doc: Age rating of a video game or app by the Entertainment Software Rating Board, used in the United States, Canada and Mexico: E (everyone), E10+ (everyone 10 and older), T (teen, 13 and older), M (mature, 17 and older), AO (adults only, 18 and older) and RP (rating pending). EC (early childhood) was retired in 2018; the regexp accepts it for older data. The regexp does not accept the ratings written in full, such as Mature 17+.

name: Spanish intra-Community VAT number (NIF-IVA)
doc: NIF-IVA, the Spanish VAT number for intra-Community trade: ES followed by the 9-character tax identification number (NIF). Spanish citizens use their DNI, eight digits and a check letter. Foreigners use their NIE, which starts with X, Y or Z. Companies and other entities have a NIF that starts with a letter for the legal form (formerly the CIF). The last character is a check digit or a check letter.

examples.description: The first or the last character must be a letter

es.name: Número de identificación fiscal a efectos del IVA (NIF-IVA)

name: Ethiopian civil society organisation registration number
doc: Registration number of a civil society organisation at the Authority for Civil Society Organizations (ACSO) of Ethiopia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-CSA; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-CSA-1327.

name: Ethiopian Fayda Identification Number (FIN)
doc: Fayda Identification Number, the unique 12-digit number that Ethiopia's National ID Program gives to a registered resident. It is sent by SMS after enrolment; a printed card is optional. No check-digit rule is published.

examples.description: Synthetic value in the documented format
Synthetic value in the documented format

name: Ethiopia postal code
doc: Postal code in Ethiopia: four digits.

name: Ethiopian taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of taxpayers in Ethiopia, including companies, charities and trusts. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-TIN-0000178477.

name: Ethiopian Ministry of Trade registration number
doc: Registration number of a company or other organisation at the Ministry of Trade of Ethiopia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ET-MOT; with that prefix an identifier reads ET-MOT-020/4/007.

name: Ethereum address
doc: Address of an Ethereum account or contract: 0x followed by 40 hexadecimal digits, the last 20 bytes of the Keccak-256 hash of the public key (or the address computed for a contract). Mixed upper and lower case encodes the EIP-55 checksum; all lower case or all upper case carries no checksum. Other EVM networks (BNB Smart Chain, Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism, Avalanche C-Chain and others) use the same format, so the value alone does not tell the network.

examples.description: EIP-55 test vector, all lower case

name: Ethereum transaction hash
doc: Identifier of an Ethereum transaction: the Keccak-256 hash of the signed, encoded transaction, written as 0x and 64 hexadecimal digits. Block hashes and the transaction hashes of other EVM networks have the same form, so the value alone does not tell them apart.

examples.description: Example of eth_getTransactionByHash in the Ethereum JSON-RPC documentation
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

name: ETIM class code
doc: Language-independent code of an ETIM class, assigned by ETIM International in its classification model of technical products: the prefix EC and six digits. Classes group products of the same kind, such as screwdrivers for slot head screws (EC000158).

examples.description: Example from the ETIM International classification guidelines

name: ETIM feature code
doc: Language-independent code of an ETIM feature, assigned by ETIM International in its classification model of technical products: the prefix EF and six digits. Features are the technical characteristics that describe the products of a class.

examples.description: Example from the ETIM International classification guidelines

name: ETIM group code
doc: Language-independent code of an ETIM group, assigned by ETIM International in its classification model of technical products: the prefix EG and six digits. Groups bundle related classes.

examples.description: Example from the ETIM International classification guidelines

name: ETIM unit code
doc: Language-independent code of an ETIM unit, assigned by ETIM International in its classification model of technical products: the prefix EU and six digits. Units are the measurement units of numeric features.

examples.description: Example from the ETIM International classification guidelines

name: ETIM value code
doc: Language-independent code of an ETIM value, assigned by ETIM International in its classification model of technical products: the prefix EV and six digits. Values are the allowed values of alphanumeric features.

examples.description: Example from the ETIM International classification guidelines

name: SEPA creditor identifier (AT-02)
doc: Creditor identifier of SEPA direct debits (data element AT-02 of the SEPA rulebooks, Creditor Scheme Identification in ISO 20022). It starts with the ISO country code and two ISO 7064 mod 97-10 check digits, followed by a 3-character creditor business code (ZZZ when not used) and a national identifier.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Euro banknote serial number
doc: Serial number printed on euro banknotes. Notes of the first series have one letter and eleven digits; notes of the Europa series have two letters and ten digits. The first letter shows the printing works, and all characters together form a simple checksum.

name: EU bovine animal identification code (ear tag number)
doc: Unique code carried by the two ear tags or the electronic identifier of a kept bovine animal in the European Union under Implementing Regulation (EU) 2021/520. It is the country code of the Member State where the animal was first tagged, as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 letters (EL for Greece, XI for Northern Ireland) or three digits, followed by an individual code of at most 12 digits. Ear tags often print the digits in groups. Older alphanumeric codes of some countries are not covered.

examples.description: Illustration of a UK ear tag number from ScotEID
Illustration of a UK ear tag number from ScotEID, without spaces

name: CELEX number
doc: Identifier of a document in EUR-Lex, the database of European Union law: a sector digit, the year, a document type letter and a number, such as 32016R0679 for the GDPR.

name: EU Combined Nomenclature (CN) code
doc: Eight-digit goods code of the Combined Nomenclature, the goods classification of the European Union for its common customs tariff and its foreign trade statistics. The CN is Annex I to Council Regulation (EEC) No 2658/87 and is updated every year. The first six digits are the HS subheading (hs_code) and the last two are EU subdivisions. The official text groups the digits as 1806 10 15; databases often write them without spaces. TARIC codes (eu_taric_code) add two more digits.

examples.description: Cocoa powder with added sugar, containing no sucrose or less than 5 % sucrose by weight

name: EU corporate body code
doc: Code of an institution, body or agency of the European Union in the corporate bodies authority list of the Publications Office of the EU. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as XR-EUCB; with that prefix an identifier reads XR-EUCB-ACP_MIN.

name: EU CT number (Clinical Trials Information System)
doc: Number of a clinical trial in the Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS), the system that supports running and supervising clinical trials in the European Union and the European Economic Area. It has 14 digits in four groups separated by hyphens (4, 6, 2 and 2 digits) and starts with the year, as in 2023-503698-40-00. CTIS numbers succeed EudraCT numbers, a separate datatype (eu_eudract).

name: European Community (EC) number
doc: Seven-digit number of a chemical substance in the European Community inventory, which joins EINECS, ELINCS and the NLP list. It is written as three groups, NNN-NNN-N; the last digit is a check digit. The European Chemicals Agency (ECHA) maintains the inventory and uses the same form for its list numbers.

examples.description: CAS Registry Number of aspirin, not an EC number

ru.name: Номер EC (Европейского сообщества)
ru.doc: Номер химического вещества в перечне веществ Европейского сообщества (EINECS, ELINCS, NLP).

name: Energy Identification Code (EIC)
doc: Energy Identification Code, the 16-character code of the European electricity and gas sector for market participants, areas, metering points and other objects. It has a 2-character code of the issuing office, an object type letter, twelve characters for the object and a check character. Digits, capital letters and hyphens are used.

name: EudraCT number (EU Clinical Trials Register)
doc: Number of a clinical trial of a medicinal product in EudraCT, the European Union clinical trials database, and in the EU Clinical Trials Register that publishes it. The form is YYYY-NNNNNN-CC; the year when the number was issued, a six-digit sequence and a check number. The register may add a member state code to show one national protocol, as in 2006-002830-38/GB. EudraCT numbers were issued from 2004 until 2023; the Clinical Trials Information System (CTIS) issues EU CT numbers instead.

examples.description: Phase 1/2 study of ABT-751 with Alimta in non-small cell lung cancer
Treatment of growth failure in children with primary IGF-1 deficiency
The sequence is not zero-padded to six digits

ru.name: Номер EudraCT
ru.doc: Номер клинического исследования в базе данных EudraCT и Регистре клинических исследований ЕС.

name: NACE code (EU classification of economic activities)
doc: Code of NACE, the Statistical Classification of Economic Activities in the European Community and the EU version of the UN ISIC classification. A section is a single letter; divisions, groups and classes have two to four digits, usually written with a dot after the second digit. Revision 2.1 replaced revision 2 from 2025 and changed some codes.

examples.description: Class: growing of cereals, other than rice, leguminous crops and oil seeds

name: Natura 2000 site code
doc: Code of a protected area in the Natura 2000 network of the European Union: the two-letter country code and seven characters.

name: EU TARIC code
doc: Ten-digit goods nomenclature code of TARIC, the integrated tariff of the European Union, which lists the customs duties, trade measures and restrictions that apply to each kind of goods. The first eight digits are the Combined Nomenclature code (eu_cn_code) and the last two are TARIC subdivisions, 00 where there is none. TARIC additional codes are separate values and are not covered. The regexp only checks for ten digits, so it also matches other ten-digit numbers.

examples.description: Horses, pure-bred breeding animals (CN 0101 21 00, no TARIC subdivision)
TARIC subdivision under HS subheading 0303.14 (frozen trout)
TARIC subdivision under HS subheading 0303.11 (frozen sockeye salmon)

name: European Union trade mark (EUTM) number
doc: Number of a European Union trade mark at the European Union Intellectual Property Office (EUIPO). The same number serves as application and registration number. It has a fixed nine digits, an eight-digit serial number and a check digit, and leading zeros are kept. The WIPO ST.13 form adds the office code EM and a type code in front.

examples.description: Example given by EUIPO in a WIPO numbering survey

name: EU Transparency Register ID
doc: Identification number of an organization in the Transparency Register of the European Parliament, Council and Commission, which lists interest representatives: digits, a hyphen and two digits.

name: Craft Identification Number
doc: The Craft Identification Number (CIN) or Hull Identification Number (HIN), standardised as EN ISO 10087:2006, is a permanent unique fourteen-digit alphanumeric identifier issued to all marine vessels in Europe.

name: MAC address (Media Access Control)
doc: 48-bit hardware address (EUI-48) of a network interface in Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other IEEE 802 networks, used to deliver frames within one network segment. The first three octets usually hold the OUI of the manufacturer; the second-lowest bit of the first octet marks a locally administered address, such as the random addresses that phones use on Wi-Fi. It is written as six pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by hyphens (IEEE style) or colons, or as three groups of four digits separated by dots (Cisco style). RFC 9542 reserves 00-00-5E-00-53-00 to 00-00-5E-00-53-FF for documentation. 64-bit identifiers are described by eui64.

examples.description: Documentation address of RFC 9542, IEEE notation
Documentation address of RFC 9542 with colons
Documentation address of RFC 9542 in dotted notation

ru.name: MAC-адрес
ru.doc: 48-битный аппаратный адрес сетевого интерфейса (EUI-48): шесть пар шестнадцатеричных цифр через дефис или двоеточие.

name: EUI-64 identifier
doc: 64-bit Extended Unique Identifier of the IEEE: an OUI or a longer company identifier followed by an extension that the organization assigns. IEEE 802.15.4 networks such as Zigbee and Thread, FireWire and InfiniBand use it as a hardware address, and IPv6 can derive interface identifiers from it. It is written as eight pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by hyphens or colons; a MAC address (EUI-48) has six pairs and is described by mac_address. RFC 9542 reserves 00-00-5E-EF-10-00-00-00 to 00-00-5E-EF-10-00-00-FF for documentation.

examples.description: Documentation value of RFC 9542 with colons

ru.name: Идентификатор EUI-64
ru.doc: 64-битный расширенный уникальный идентификатор IEEE: восемь пар шестнадцатеричных цифр.

name: eUICC identifier (EID)
doc: Permanent 32-digit identifier of an eUICC, the chip of an eSIM that stores mobile network profiles, defined by GSMA SGP.29. It begins with the identification number of the eUICC manufacturer, older EIDs with 89, and ends with two check digits chosen so that the whole number divided by 97 leaves the remainder 1. Phones show it in their settings, and remote SIM provisioning uses it to address the chip.

examples.description: Synthetic EID with valid check digits

ru.name: Идентификатор eUICC (EID)
ru.doc: Постоянный 32-значный идентификатор eUICC — чипа eSIM, хранящего профили операторов, по спецификации GSMA SGP.29. Начинается с идентификатора производителя (у старых EID — с 89) и заканчивается двумя контрольными цифрами, при которых остаток от деления всего числа на 97 равен 1.

name: European Unique Identifier (EUID)
doc: EU datatype for 'European Unique Identifier (EUID)' (euid) from rules in context 'finances'. The European Unique Identifier (EUID) is a unique identifier format used within the European Union. It consists of a 2-letter uppercase country code (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2) followed by 4 to 18 alphanumeric characters (letters and/or digits), resulting in a total length of 6 to 20 characters. This identifier format is commonly used for financial and business identification purposes across EU member states.

doc: European Union geographic code, identifier for a region per NUTS

name: EU VAT number (VIES format)
doc: VAT identification number of a business registered for VAT in a European Union member state, in the compact form that the VIES system checks. It is the 2-letter code of the member state followed by the national number without spaces or punctuation. Greece uses EL rather than GR, and businesses in Northern Ireland use XI for trade in goods with the EU. Each member state has its own fixed structure for the national part, from 8 to 12 characters (2 to 10 digits in Romania); the national records describe them and their check digits.

name: FAA airport code (FAA identifier)
doc: The Federal Aviation Administration location identifier (FAA LID) is a three- to five-character alphanumeric code identifying aviation related facilities inside the United States, though some codes are reserved for, and are managed by other entities.

name: Facebook app access token
doc: App access token of the Meta (Facebook) Graph API written as the app ID, a vertical bar and the app secret. Meta allows this form in place of a generated app access token; it contains the app secret and must stay on the server.

name: Facebook username
doc: Username of a Facebook profile or page, the part of the address after facebook.com/.

name: FCC ID (FCC equipment identifier)
doc: Identifier of radio equipment certified by the Federal Communications Commission (FCC) of the United States for the US market; it is printed on the device label. It joins a grantee code, which the FCC assigns to the applicant, and a product code of 1 to 14 capital letters, digits or hyphens, which the applicant chooses. Grantee codes that start with a letter have three characters; those issued since May 2013 have five characters and start with a digit from 2 to 9. Wikidata property P7290 (FCC Product Code) holds only the product code part.

ru.doc: Идентификатор радиооборудования, сертифицированного Федеральной комиссией по связи США (FCC) для рынка США; указывается на этикетке устройства. Состоит из кода заявителя, который присваивает FCC (3 символа с буквой в начале или, для кодов, выданных с мая 2013 года, 5 символов с цифрой от 2 до 9 в начале), и кода продукта из 1–14 заглавных букв, цифр или дефисов, который выбирает заявитель.

name: Finnish VAT number (ALV)
doc: Arvonlisäveronumero, the Finnish VAT number: the FI prefix and the 8-digit business ID (Y-tunnus) without its hyphen. The last digit is a weighted check digit.

name: Finnish association register number
doc: Number of an association in the Finnish Register of Associations. It has one to six digits, often written with a dot before the last three digits.

name: Finnish driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Finland. Microsoft Purview looks for six digits, a hyphen, three digits and a final digit or letter.

name: Finnish European Health Insurance Card number
doc: Number of the European Health Insurance Card issued in Finland: 20 digits that start with 8024680246.

name: Finnish personal identity code (HETU)
doc: Henkilötunnus, the personal identity code of people registered in Finland. It is the date of birth (DDMMYY), a century sign (+ for the 1800s, - or one of Y, X, W, V, U for the 1900s, A to F for the 2000s), a 3-digit individual number (odd for men, even for women; 900 to 999 for temporary codes) and a check character - the nine-digit number DDMMYYZZZ modulo 31, looked up in 0123456789ABCDEFHJKLMNPRSTUVWXY.

name: Finnish passport number
