name: Kuwait postal code
doc: Postal code in Kuwait: five digits.

name: Kazakh business identification number (BIN)
doc: Business identification number (BIN) of Kazakhstan: the 12-digit number of a legal entity, of a branch or representative office, or of an individual entrepreneur working in joint entrepreneurship. It is also the tax identification number of these taxpayers. The first four digits are the year and month of registration. The fifth digit is the type: 4 for a resident legal entity, 5 for a non-resident legal entity, 6 for a joint individual entrepreneur. The sixth digit is 0 for a head office, 1 for a branch, 2 for a representative office and 3 for a peasant farm in joint entrepreneurship. Five digits of serial number follow (90001 to 99999 for bodies and participants of the Astana International Financial Centre), and the last digit is a check digit. The BIN replaced the taxpayer registration number (RNN) on 1 January 2013. Individuals have an IIN (kz_iin) instead. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as KZ-BIN, so an identifier reads KZ-BIN-950440001673.

examples.description: The fifth digit 3 is not a BIN entity type

ru.name: Бизнес-идентификационный номер (БИН)
ru.doc: Двенадцатизначный номер юридического лица, его филиала или представительства, а также индивидуального предпринимателя, действующего в форме совместного предпринимательства. Первые четыре цифры - год и месяц регистрации, пятая - тип лица, шестая - признак головного подразделения, филиала или представительства, затем пять цифр порядкового номера и контрольная цифра. С 1 января 2013 года заменил РНН.

name: Kazakh IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Kazakhstan. Kazakhstan uses the IBAN as the national account number, called the individual identification code of the account (ИИК). It has 20 characters: KZ, two IBAN check digits, a 3-digit bank code and a 13-character account number that can contain letters.

examples.description: The same IBAN in its printed form

ru.name: IBAN (ИИК) Казахстана
ru.doc: Номер банковского счёта в Казахстане в формате IBAN (индивидуальный идентификационный код, ИИК), 20 символов - KZ, две контрольные цифры, трёхзначный код банка и 13 символов номера счёта.

name: Kazakh individual identification number (IIN)
doc: Individual identification number (IIN) of Kazakhstan: the 12-digit number that a citizen or a resident foreigner receives at first registration. It never changes, is printed on the identity card and serves as the tax identification number of individuals and of individual entrepreneurs working on their own. Numbers formed before 26 August 2013 usually start with the date of birth (YYMMDD) and a digit for century and sex, but the current rules give the digits no meaning, so the number must not be parsed. The last digit is a check digit, computed as for the BIN (kz_bin). The IIN replaced the taxpayer registration number (RNN) and the social individual code (SIK) on 1 January 2013.

examples.description: Synthetic: under the old structure it would belong to a man born on 1 January 1850
Synthetic; the first weights give 10, so the check digit comes from the second weights

ru.name: Индивидуальный идентификационный номер (ИИН)
ru.doc: Двенадцатизначный номер физического лица в Казахстане, неизменный с момента формирования. Указан в удостоверении личности и служит налоговым номером. Последняя цифра контрольная. С 1 января 2013 года заменил РНН и СИК.

name: Kazakh KATO code
doc: Nine-digit code of an administrative-territorial object or settlement of Kazakhstan in the national Classifier of administrative-territorial objects (KATO, НК РК 11), kept by the Bureau of National Statistics. The code is hierarchical: AB is the region or city of republican significance (10 to 70 for regions, above 70 for cities such as Astana 71 and Almaty 75), CD a district or a city of regional significance, EF an object of district level such as a rural district or a town, and HIJ a village or another small settlement. The first two, four or six digits alone may stand for the higher levels; zeros fill the rest of a full code. The classifier also has a separate one-digit attribute K for the type of locality, which is not part of the nine-digit code. The current edition НК РК 11-2025 took effect on 1 February 2025.

ru.name: Код КАТО
ru.doc: Девятизначный код административно-территориального объекта или населённого пункта Казахстана по классификатору административно-территориальных объектов (КАТО, НК РК 11). Код иерархический (AB CD EF HIJ) - область или город республиканского значения, район, сельский округ, село.

name: Kazakh beneficiary code (KBe)
doc: Two-digit code of the recipient in Kazakh payment documents (код бенефициара, КБе). The first digit is residence: 1 for a resident of Kazakhstan, 2 for a non-resident. The second digit is the sector of the economy: 1 government, 2 regional and local authorities, 3 central bank, 4 other deposit-taking organizations, 5 other financial organizations, 6 state non-financial organizations, 7 non-state non-financial organizations, 8 non-profit organizations serving households, 9 households. The code of the sender (КОд) has the same form. The codes come from the rules of the National Bank of Kazakhstan on economic sector and payment purpose codes, and go together with the payment purpose code (kz_knp).

examples.description: Resident non-state non-financial organization, such as a private company
Non-resident deposit-taking organization, such as a foreign bank

ru.name: Код бенефициара (КБе)
ru.doc: Двузначный код получателя денег в платёжных документах Казахстана. Первая цифра - признак резидентства (1 - резидент, 2 - нерезидент), вторая - сектор экономики. Код отправителя денег (КОд) устроен так же.

name: Kazakh payment purpose code (KNP)
doc: Three-digit code of the purpose of a payment (код назначения платежа, КНП) in Kazakh payment orders and bank transfers, from the list in the rules of the National Bank of Kazakhstan on economic sector and payment purpose codes. Banks report it to the National Bank for payment statistics. It goes together with the beneficiary code (kz_kbe).

examples.description: Payment for goods other than real estate and the goods of codes 711, 712 and 713
Refund for goods that were not delivered

ru.name: Код назначения платежа (КНП)
ru.doc: Трёхзначный код назначения платежа в платёжных документах Казахстана по Правилам применения кодов секторов экономики и назначения платежей Национального Банка.

name: Kazakh economic activity code (OKED)
doc: Code of the General classifier of economic activities of Kazakhstan (ОКЭД, НК РК 03-2019), kept by the Bureau of National Statistics and built on NACE Rev. 2 (eu_nace). A section is a letter. Divisions, groups, classes and subclasses have two to five digits, written with a dot after the second and after the fourth digit, as in 06.10.0. The first four digits follow NACE, and the fifth digit adds national subclasses. Data files of the Bureau write the codes without dots, as in 06100. The edition НК РК 03-2019 took effect on 1 January 2020.

examples.description: Subclass: extraction of crude petroleum and associated gas, the example of the classifier
Subclass: development and testing of software code
Subclass written without dots: growing of cereals and leguminous crops

ru.name: Код ОКЭД
ru.doc: Код общего классификатора видов экономической деятельности Республики Казахстан (ОКЭД, НК РК 03-2019), построенного на NACE Rev. 2. Секции обозначаются буквами, разделы, группы, классы и подклассы - кодами вида ХХ, ХХ.Х, ХХ.ХХ и ХХ.ХХ.Х.

name: Kazakh postal code
doc: Postal code of Kazakhstan. The rules on postal codes approved by order No. 66 of the Minister of Information and Communications of 29 July 2016 give each building its own seven-character code: a Latin letter for the region or city of republican significance, two digits for the district, then a letter, a digit, a letter and a digit for the building. The older six-digit codes of post offices, such as 010000 for Astana, remain in wide use, and both forms appear in addresses.

examples.description: Seven-character postcode, example from the USPS country listing
The seventh character must be a digit

ru.name: Почтовый индекс Казахстана
ru.doc: Почтовый индекс Казахстана: семизначный код здания (буква, две цифры, буква, цифра, буква, цифра) по Правилам присвоения почтовых индексов 2016 года или прежний шестизначный индекс почтового отделения.

name: Kazakh taxpayer registration number (RNN)
doc: Taxpayer registration number (регистрационный номер налогоплательщика, РНН) that the tax authorities of Kazakhstan gave to individuals and legal entities. The individual identification number (kz_iin) and the business identification number (kz_bin) replaced it on 1 January 2013, but it still appears in older registers, documents and data sets.

ru.name: Регистрационный номер налогоплательщика (РНН)
ru.doc: Регистрационный номер налогоплательщика в Казахстане, с 1 января 2013 года заменённый ИИН и БИН.

name: Kazakh vehicle registration plate
doc: Standard registration plate of a car in Kazakhstan in the format used since 2012: three digits, three Latin letters and a two-digit region code, as in 123 ABC 02. The region codes run from 01 (Astana), 02 (Almaty) and 03 (Akmola Region) to 17 (Shymkent); 18 (Abai), 19 (Jetisu) and 20 (Ulytau) were added for the regions formed in 2022. Plates of other vehicle types and of diplomatic missions, and the older plates with a region letter first, have other layouts and are not covered.

examples.description: Format example of a plate of Almaty
The same plate written without spaces
Plate of the format used before 2012

ru.name: Государственный регистрационный номерной знак Казахстана
ru.doc: Стандартный номерной знак автомобиля в Казахстане образца 2012 года - три цифры, три латинские буквы и двузначный код региона (01-20).

name: Laos postal code
doc: Postal code in Laos: five digits.

name: Laboratory test name
doc: Name of a laboratory or blood test, for example complete blood count or HbA1c.

name: Language
doc: Human language written as a name, such as English, Deutsch or allemand (German in French), or as a code. Codes have their own patterns: iso639_1 (two letters) and iso639_2 (three letters). A language tag with region or script subtags, such as en-GB, is the datatype languagetag.

patterns.name: ISO 639-1 language code (two letters)
patterns.doc: Two-letter code of a language from ISO 639-1, such as en (English), de (German) or ja (Japanese). About 180 languages have such a code. It is written in lowercase, but data sets often use uppercase.

patterns.name: ISO 639-2 language code (three letters)
patterns.doc: Three-letter code of a language from ISO 639-2, such as eng (English) or rus (Russian). About twenty languages have two codes: a bibliographic one based on the English name (ger, fre) and a terminology one based on the native name (deu, fra).

name: IETF language tag
doc: An IETF BCP 47 language tag is a standardized code or tag that is used to identify human languages in the Internet. The tag structure has been standardized by the Internet Engineering Task Force (IETF) in Best Current Practice (BCP) 47; the subtags are maintained by the IANA Language Subtag Registry.

ru.name: Языковой код IETF
ru.doc: Языковой код/тэг по стандарту IETF BCP 47 идентифицирующий конкретный человеческий язык, стиль написания и тд.

name: Indian last name by known name
doc: Indian last name by known name identifier

name: latitude
doc: In geography, latitude is a geographic coordinate that specifies the north–south position of a point on the Earths surface. Latitude is an angle (defined below) which ranges from 0° at the Equator to 90° (North or South) at the poles.

name: Lebanese commercial register number
doc: Number of a company in the Commercial Register of the Ministry of Justice of Lebanon. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LB-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads LB-CR-77621.

name: Lebanon postal code
doc: Postal code in Lebanon: four digits, or eight digits written as two groups of four with an optional space.

name: Library of Congress Classification (LCC) number
doc: Class number or call number in the Library of Congress Classification, the subject classification of the US Library of Congress, which most research and academic libraries in the United States use to shelve books. It starts with one to three letters for the class and subclass, such as QA for mathematics or TK for electrical engineering, followed by a number with an optional decimal part. A call number adds Cutter numbers, such as .P98, and often a year. The regexp is adapted from the Wikidata format of property P1149 and requires a class number.

examples.description: Class number with a Cutter number
Class number with a decimal part

ru.name: Индекс Классификации Библиотеки Конгресса (LCC)
ru.doc: Классификационный индекс или шифр хранения по Классификации Библиотеки Конгресса США.

name: Library of Congress Control Number (LCCN)
doc: Serial number of a catalog record of the US Library of Congress, used since 1898. It is made of a year and a six-digit serial number with leading zeros. The year has two digits for 1898 to 2000 and four digits from 2001. A hyphen between year and serial number is optional. Some numbers start with a short alphabetic prefix such as n, sh or sn. The LCCN is not related to the Library of Congress Classification.

examples.description: Name authority: Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals
The serial number must have six digits

name: Library of Congress authority ID (LCCN of an authority record)
doc: Identifier of a name, subject or genre authority record of the Library of Congress: a prefix such as n, nb, nr, no or sh, then the year and a serial number. It is used in library catalogues and in id.loc.gov.

examples.description: Royal Society for the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals

name: Legal document type by known name
doc: Legal document type by known name identifier

name: Legislation name
doc: A legal document such as an act, decree, bill, etc. (enforceable or not) or a component of a legal act (like an article).

ru.name: Название нормативного документа
ru.doc: Название нормативного документа

name: Legislation type
doc: The type of the legislation. Examples of values are "law", "act", "directive", "decree", "regulation", "statutory instrument", "loi organique", "reglement grand-ducal", etc., depending on the country.

ru.name: Тип нормативного документа
ru.doc: Тип нормативного документа

name: Legal Entity Identifier
doc: The Legal Entity Identifier (LEI) is a unique global identifier for legal entities participating in financial transactions. Also known as an LEI code or LEI number, its purpose is to help identify legal entities on a globally accessible database. Legal entities are organisations such as companies or government entities that participate in financial transactions. An individual person may not obtain an LEI.

name: Liechtenstein personal identification number (PEID)
doc: Personenidentifikationsnummer, a numeric code of up to 12 digits that identifies individuals and entities in Liechtenstein, used as the tax identification number.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format

name: Liechtenstein postal code
doc: Postal code in Liechtenstein: four digits from 9485 to 9498. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix FL-. Liechtenstein is part of the Swiss postal code system.

name: License number by known name
doc: License number by known name identifier

name: Lightning Network invoice (BOLT 11)
doc: Payment request of the Lightning Network as defined by BOLT 11. The human-readable part is ln, the network (bc for Bitcoin mainnet, tb for testnet, tbs for signet, bcrt for regtest) and an optional amount with a multiplier (m, u, n or p). The Bech32 data part, without the 90-character limit of BIP 173, holds a timestamp, tagged fields such as the payment hash, description and expiry, and the signature of the payee. Invoices are written in lower case, or in upper case in QR codes.

examples.description: BOLT 11 example, donation of any amount
BOLT 11 example, 2500 micro-BTC for a cup of coffee
last character changed, the checksum fails

name: Linear API key
doc: Personal API key of Linear, the issue tracking service: lin_api_ followed by 40 letters and digits.

name: LinkedIn company page ID
doc: Name of a company, school or showcase page in the LinkedIn address linkedin.com/company/<id>.

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

name: LIPID MAPS ID (LM ID)
doc: Identifier of a lipid in the LIPID MAPS Structure Database. It is LM, a two-letter code of one of the eight LIPID MAPS lipid categories, such as FA or PR, four digits for its place in the classification and, for an individual lipid, four to six more letters or digits.

examples.description: XX is not a lipid category

name: Litecoin address
doc: Mainnet address of Litecoin. P2PKH addresses are Base58Check with version byte 48 and start with L; P2SH addresses use version byte 50 and start with M; native SegWit addresses use the prefix ltc1 (Bech32 for witness version 0, Bech32m for Taproot). Older P2SH addresses with version byte 5 start with 3 like Bitcoin's and are not matched, nor are MWEB addresses (ltcmweb1).

examples.description: P2PKH address from the test data of Litecoin Core (key_io_valid.json)
P2SH address from the test data of Litecoin Core
P2WPKH address from the test data of Litecoin Core
Taproot address from the test data of Litecoin Core

name: Sri Lankan company registration number
doc: Registration number of a company at the Department of the Registrar of Companies of Sri Lanka. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LK-DRC; with that prefix an identifier reads LK-DRC-GA139.

name: Sri Lankan NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the National Secretariat for Non-Governmental Organisations of Sri Lanka. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LK-NGO; with that prefix an identifier reads LK-NGO-80505.

name: Sri Lanka postal code
doc: Postal code in Sri Lanka: five digits.

name: LOINC code
doc: Code of a laboratory test, clinical observation or document type in LOINC (Logical Observation Identifiers Names and Codes): digits, a hyphen and a check digit. Regenstrief Institute maintains it. Part and answer codes (LP, LA prefixes) are not covered.

name: Longitude
doc: Longitude is a geographic coordinate that specifies the east–west position of a point on the Earths surface, or the surface of a celestial body. It is an angular measurement, usually expressed in degrees and denoted by the Greek letter lambda (λ)

name: Customer loyalty number by known name
doc: Customer loyalty number by known name identifier

name: Liberian NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the Ministry of Finance and Development Planning of Liberia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LR-MFDPNGO; with that prefix an identifier reads LR-MFDPNGO-0961.

name: Liberia postal code
doc: Postal code in Liberia: four digits.

name: Lesotho higher education institution registration number
doc: Registration number of a higher education institution in Lesotho. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LS-HEI; with that prefix an identifier reads LS-HEI-HEI-CRL-2025CNT-3182004.

name: Lesotho postal code
doc: Postal code in Lesotho: three digits.

name: Lesotho society registration number
doc: Registration number of a society (a non-profit organisation) in Lesotho. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LS-SRN; with that prefix an identifier reads LS-SRN-88-6.

name: Life Science Identifier (LSID)
doc: Identifier for a piece of life-science data, written in URN form as urn:lsid:<authority>:<namespace>:<object id>, optionally followed by :<version>. The authority is usually the domain name of the issuing service. The lsid namespace was never registered with IANA. LSIDs are still used by biodiversity catalogues such as ZooBank to identify taxonomic names and publications.

name: Lithuanian personal code (asmens kodas)
doc: Asmens kodas, the 11-digit personal code in Lithuania. The first digit gives the sex and the century of birth, the next six the date of birth (YYMMDD), then come a 3-digit serial number and a check digit.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Lithuanian legal entity code (juridinio asmens kodas)
doc: Juridinio asmens kodas, the 9-digit code of a legal entity in the Register of Legal Entities of Lithuania (Registrų centras). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LT-RC; with that prefix an identifier reads LT-RC-111484678.

name: Lithuanian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Lithuania. Microsoft Purview looks for eight digits.

name: Lithuanian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Lithuania. Microsoft Purview looks for eight letters or digits.

name: Lithuania postal code
doc: Postal code in Lithuania: five digits. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix LT-.

name: Lithuanian VAT number (PVM)
doc: PVM mokėtojo kodas, the VAT code in Lithuania: nine digits for legal entities or twelve digits for temporarily registered taxpayers, with a check digit.

name: Luxembourg driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Luxembourg. Microsoft Purview looks for six digits.

name: Luxembourg national identification number
doc: National identification number (matricule) of a natural person in Luxembourg: 13 digits, of which the last two are check digits.

name: Luxembourg national identification number of a legal entity
doc: National identification number of a legal entity (non-natural person) in Luxembourg, also used as its tax number: 11 digits that end with a check digit.

name: Luxembourg passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Luxembourg. Microsoft Purview looks for seven or eight letters or digits.

name: Luxembourg postal code
doc: Postal code in Luxembourg: four digits. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix L-.

name: Luxembourg trade and companies register number (RCS)
doc: Number of a company in the Luxembourg Trade and Companies Register (Registre de commerce et des sociétés, RCS): a letter followed by digits. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LU-RCS; with that prefix an identifier reads LU-RCS-B247312.

name: Luxembourg VAT number
doc: Numéro d'identification à la taxe sur la valeur ajoutée, the 8-digit VAT number in Luxembourg. The last two digits are check digits.

name: Latvian driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Latvia. Microsoft Purview looks for three letters and six digits.

name: Latvian passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Latvia. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and seven digits.

name: Latvian personal code
doc: Latvian personal code (personas kods), 11 digits. Codes issued before July 2017 start with the date of birth (DDMMYY), followed by a hyphen, a century digit and four digits. Newer codes start with 32 and carry no date of birth.

name: Latvia postal code
doc: Postal code in Latvia: the letters LV, a hyphen and four digits.

name: Latvian VAT number (PVN)
doc: PVN reģistrācijas numurs, the 11-digit VAT number in Latvia. For legal entities the first digit is greater than 3; for natural persons it is the personal code (personas kods), which starts with the date of birth (DDMMYY) or, for newer codes, with 32.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Latvian registration number
doc: Reģistrācijas numurs, the 11-digit registration number of a company in the Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia. With the LV prefix it is the VAT number (lv_pvn). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as LV-RE; with that prefix an identifier reads LV-RE-40008124830.

examples.description: Register of Enterprises of the Republic of Latvia

name: Moroccan common company identifier (ICE)
doc: Identifiant Commun de l'Entreprise (ICE), the 15-digit number that identifies a company and each of its establishments in the same way for all Moroccan administrations. It does not replace the tax identifier (IF), the trade register number (RC) or the CNSS number. The first nine digits identify the enterprise, the next four the establishment, and the last two are check digits: the whole number is divisible by 97. It applies to natural persons as well as to legal entities.

name: Morocco postal code
doc: Postal code in Morocco: five digits.

name: MAC address (Media Access Control)
doc: 48-bit hardware address (EUI-48) of a network interface in Ethernet, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other IEEE 802 networks, used to deliver frames within one network segment. The first three octets usually hold the OUI of the manufacturer; the second-lowest bit of the first octet marks a locally administered address, such as the random addresses that phones use on Wi-Fi. It is written as six pairs of hexadecimal digits separated by hyphens (IEEE style) or colons, or as three groups of four digits separated by dots (Cisco style). RFC 9542 reserves 00-00-5E-00-53-00 to 00-00-5E-00-53-FF for documentation. 64-bit identifiers are described by eui64.

examples.description: Documentation address of RFC 9542, IEEE notation
Documentation address of RFC 9542 with colons
Documentation address of RFC 9542 in dotted notation

ru.name: MAC-адрес
ru.doc: 48-битный аппаратный адрес сетевого интерфейса (EUI-48): шесть пар шестнадцатеричных цифр через дефис или двоеточие.

name: Magnet URI (BitTorrent)
doc: URI of the magnet: scheme that identifies a file or a torrent by a hash of its content instead of by its location, used by BitTorrent and other peer-to-peer clients. The parameter xt (exact topic) holds a URN such as urn:btih:<info hash> for BitTorrent v1 (BEP 9) or urn:btmh:<multihash> for v2 (BEP 52); optional parameters include dn (display name), tr (tracker URL), ws (web seed) and xs (exact source). The regexp requires an xt parameter, in any position.

examples.description: Sintel magnet link published by WebTorrent, cut to one tracker
Big Buck Bunny, published by WebTorrent
Display name before the exact topic

ru.name: Magnet-ссылка
ru.doc: URI схемы magnet:, который указывает файл или торрент по хешу содержимого, а не по адресу.

name: Maidenhead locator (QTH locator)
doc: Grid square of the Maidenhead Locator System, used by radio amateurs to give a station position; the IARU adopted it in 1980. Pairs of characters give longitude then latitude: a field of two letters A to R (20 by 10 degrees), a square of two digits, a subsquare of two letters A to X and an extended square of two digits, giving two, four, six or eight characters. Field letters are upper case; subsquare letters are often written in lower case. A two-character locator looks like many other two-letter codes.

examples.description: Station W1AW of the ARRL in Newington, Connecticut (Wikipedia)

name: Mailchimp API key
doc: API key of the Mailchimp Marketing API: 32 hexadecimal digits, a hyphen and the data center of the account (for example us6), which is also the subdomain of the API endpoint.

name: Mailto URI
doc: URI of the mailto: scheme (RFC 6068) that opens a new email message: one or more email addresses separated by commas, optionally followed by ? and header fields such as subject, cc or body. Web pages use it in mailto: links, and Wikidata stores email addresses (property P968) in this form. Spaces and other special characters in the header values are percent-encoded.

examples.description: Example of RFC 6068 with a subject
Example of RFC 6068 with cc and body
An email address without the mailto: scheme

ru.name: URI mailto:
ru.doc: URI схемы mailto: с одним или несколькими адресами электронной почты и необязательными полями письма (RFC 6068).

name: Marital status
doc: Civil status of a person with respect to marriage: single, married, divorced, widowed, separated or in a civil partnership. Data sets also use one-letter codes such as S, M, D and W.

name: Mastodon address
doc: Address of an account on Mastodon or another fediverse server: user@server, sometimes written with a leading @.

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

name: Monaco postal code
doc: Postal code in Monaco: five digits starting with 980. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix MC-. Monaco is part of the French postal code system.

name: Monaco trade and industry register number (RCI)
doc: Number of a business in the Trade and Industry Register (Répertoire du commerce et de l'industrie, RCI) of Monaco. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MC-RCI; with that prefix an identifier reads MC-RCI-00S03773.

name: Monaco VAT number
doc: VAT number (numéro de TVA) of businesses in Monaco, which belongs to the French VAT territory. It has the French format, FR followed by a 2-character key and nine digits, but the nine digits start with 000 instead of being a French SIREN.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: MD5 hash
doc: Digest of the MD5 hash function (128 bits), often used as a checksum of a file or as a record fingerprint. MD5 is not collision-resistant and must not be used for security. It is written as 32 hexadecimal digits.

examples.description: MD5 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (31 instead of 32)

name: MD5-crypt password hash
doc: Password hash of the MD5-based crypt scheme of FreeBSD, in Modular Crypt Format: $1$, a salt of up to 8 characters, $ and 22 characters of crypt Base64. It was the default on Linux before SHA-crypt and is now considered weak.

examples.description: Hash of the word "example" with the salt examples

name: MD5 hash
doc: Digest of the MD5 hash function (128 bits), often used as a checksum of a file or as a record fingerprint. MD5 is not collision-resistant and must not be used for security. It is written as 32 hexadecimal digits.

examples.description: MD5 hash of the empty string
one hex digit short (31 instead of 32)

name: Moldovan state identification number (IDNO)
doc: IDNO (numărul de identificare de stat), the 13-digit identifier of legal entities in Moldova. It holds a registry digit, three digits for the year the code was assigned, an identifier and a check digit.

name: Moldova postal code
doc: Postal code in Moldova: four digits. In addresses the code may be written after the prefix MD-.

name: Montenegrin IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in Montenegro. It has 22 characters: ME, two IBAN check digits, a 3-digit bank code, a 13-digit account number and two national check digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The first example in its printed form

name: Montenegrin tax identification number (PIB)
doc: Poreski identifikacioni broj (PIB), the tax identification number of companies and other organisations in Montenegro. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ME-PIB; with that prefix an identifier reads ME-PIB-04252361.

name: Montenegro postal code
doc: Postal code in Montenegro: five digits starting with 8.

name: MedDRA term code
doc: Numeric code of a term in MedDRA, the Medical Dictionary for Regulatory Activities, a standard medical terminology developed by the International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) for sharing regulatory information on medical products. It is used in regulatory processes and safety monitoring. The terms form a hierarchy from System Organ Classes down to Lowest Level Terms.

examples.description: abscess of prostate; example of Wikidata property P3201

name: Medical condition name
doc: Name of a disease, disorder, injury or impairment, for example tuberculosis or type 2 diabetes. Linked to a person, it is health data.

purview: Impairments Listed In The U.S. Disability Evaluation Under Social Security

name: Medical specialty
doc: Branch of medical practice, for example cardiology or pediatrics.

name: Australian Medicare number by known name
doc: Australian Medicare number by known name identifier

name: Medication brand name
doc: Proprietary (trade) name under which a medicine is sold.

name: Medication class
doc: Group of medicines with a similar action or use, for example antibiotics or beta blockers.

name: Medication generic name
doc: Non-proprietary (generic) name of a medicine or its active ingredient, such as an International Nonproprietary Name (INN).

name: Mobile Equipment Identifier (MEID)
doc: 56-bit identifier of CDMA mobile devices that replaced the 32-bit ESN (esn). It is written as 14 hexadecimal characters or as an 18-digit decimal number, either of them optionally followed by a check character.

examples.description: The same MEID with its check character C
The same MEID in decimal form
Decimal form with its check digit 0

ru.name: Идентификатор мобильного оборудования (MEID)
ru.doc: 56-битный идентификатор мобильных устройств стандарта CDMA, заменивший 32-битный ESN. Записывается 14 шестнадцатеричными символами или 18-значным десятичным числом, в обоих случаях с необязательным контрольным символом.

name: Merchant category code (MCC, ISO 18245)
doc: Four-digit code that a card network assigns to a merchant by the kind of goods or services it sells, for example 5411 for grocery stores and supermarkets. The codes are specified by ISO 18245. Card statements and public spending data with payment cards use it. Some codes start with zero, so keep values as strings. Do not confuse it with the mobile country code (mobile_country_code), which is also called MCC.

name: MeSH descriptor ID
doc: Unique identifier of a descriptor (D and six or nine digits) or supplementary concept record (C and six or nine digits) in Medical Subject Headings, the US National Library of Medicine thesaurus used to index PubMed.

name: MeSH tree number
doc: Position of a descriptor in the MeSH hierarchy: a letter and two digits for the top category, then groups of three digits separated by dots, such as C04.557. One descriptor can have several tree numbers.

name: Message-ID (Email Message Identifier)
doc: Globally unique identifier of an email message, which the sending client or server writes in the Message-ID header (RFC 5322, section 3.6.4). It has the form <left@right>: the right part is usually the domain name of the host that created it, and the left part is a unique string such as a timestamp with a random suffix. Replies refer to it in their In-Reply-To and References headers.

examples.description: Two identifiers, as in a References header

ru.name: Идентификатор письма (Message-ID)
ru.doc: Уникальный идентификатор письма из заголовка Message-ID в форме <левая_часть@правая_часть> (RFC 5322).

name: MetaboLights accession
doc: Accession in MetaboLights, the EMBL-EBI database of metabolomics experiments and metabolites: MTBLS and a number for a study, MTBLC and a number for a compound entry.

examples.description: Study of urinary changes in type 2 diabetes in humans; Bioregistry example
Compound entry for dimethylamine; example of Wikidata property P3890
No letter for the kind of entry

name: Malagasy tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF) that the Directorate General of Taxes of Madagascar gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MG-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads MG-NIF-4001257310.

name: Madagascar postal code
doc: Postal code in Madagascar: three digits.

name: Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI) accession ID
doc: Accession ID of an object in Mouse Genome Informatics (MGI), the database of the laboratory mouse, such as a gene or another genome feature. It is MGI: and a number, as in MGI:97490 for the gene Pax6.

examples.description: Tssr90015, a transcription start site region; Bioregistry example

name: Military Grid Reference System (MGRS) coordinate
doc: Position written in the Military Grid Reference System of NATO, which is based on UTM. It is a grid zone designator (a UTM zone number from 1 to 60 and a latitude band letter from C to X without I and O), a two-letter identifier of a 100 km square, and an even number of digits, up to ten, that give the easting and then the northing within the square: four digits locate a 1 km square, ten digits a 1 m square. Spaces between the parts are optional. The regexp does not cover the polar regions, which use the UPS form with bands A, B, Y and Z.

examples.description: 10 m precision, example from the Wikipedia article
Easting and northing of different lengths

ru.name: Координата MGRS
ru.doc: Положение в военной системе координатной сетки НАТО (MGRS): зона UTM, квадрат 100 км и чётное число цифр восточного и северного смещения.

name: Marshall Islands postal code
doc: Postal code in the Marshall Islands: a ZIP code of five digits from 96960 to 96979, optionally followed by a space or hyphen and four more digits.

name: Market Identifier Code (ISO 10383)
doc: This International Standard specifies a universal method of identifying exchanges, trading platforms, regulated or non-regulated markets and trade reporting facilities as sources of prices and related information in order to facilitate automated processing

examples.description: Bulgarian Stock Exchange - SME Growth Market Beam

name: Military name suffix
doc: Abbreviation of a military service written after a person's name, for example USN or USMC. In the United States military it helps to compare seniority between services and can show reserve status.

name: Media type (MIME type)
doc: Two-part identifier of a data format, type/subtype, such as text/html, image/png or application/vnd.ms-excel, defined by RFC 6838 and registered by IANA. Email (MIME), the HTTP Content-Type header, file metadata and data catalogs use it. The top-level type is one of application, audio, example, font, haptics, image, message, model, multipart, text and video; vendor subtypes start with vnd., personal ones with prs., and unregistered ones often with x-. A value may carry parameters after a semicolon, as in text/html; charset=utf-8. Type names are case-insensitive, but the regexp accepts only the usual lowercase top-level type.

ru.name: Тип медиа (MIME-тип)
ru.doc: Идентификатор формата данных вида тип/подтип, например text/html (RFC 6838).

name: Media type (MIME type)
doc: Two-part identifier of a data format, type/subtype, such as text/html, image/png or application/vnd.ms-excel, defined by RFC 6838 and registered by IANA. Email (MIME), the HTTP Content-Type header, file metadata and data catalogs use it. The top-level type is one of application, audio, example, font, haptics, image, message, model, multipart, text and video; vendor subtypes start with vnd., personal ones with prs., and unregistered ones often with x-. A value may carry parameters after a semicolon, as in text/html; charset=utf-8. Type names are case-insensitive, but the regexp accepts only the usual lowercase top-level type.

ru.name: Тип медиа (MIME-тип)
ru.doc: Идентификатор формата данных вида тип/подтип, например text/html (RFC 6838).

name: MITRE ATT&CK group ID
doc: Identifier of a threat group (intrusion set) in MITRE ATT&CK: G followed by four digits.

name: MITRE ATT&CK mitigation ID
doc: Identifier of a mitigation in MITRE ATT&CK, a security measure that prevents a technique from succeeding: M followed by four digits. Deprecated mitigations from early ATT&CK versions reused technique IDs and are not covered.

name: MITRE ATT&CK software ID
doc: Identifier of a piece of software in MITRE ATT&CK, either malware or a tool that adversaries use: S followed by four digits.

name: MITRE ATT&CK tactic ID
doc: Identifier of a tactic in MITRE ATT&CK, that is, of an adversary's goal such as Initial Access or Credential Access: TA followed by four digits.

name: MITRE ATT&CK technique ID
doc: Identifier of a technique in MITRE ATT&CK, the knowledge base of adversary behavior: T followed by four digits. A sub-technique adds a dot and three digits, so T1059.001 (PowerShell) is a sub-technique of T1059 (Command and Scripting Interpreter). The Enterprise, Mobile and ICS matrices share the format.

name: North Macedonian tax number (EDB)
doc: ЕДБ (единствен даночен број), the unique tax number of North Macedonia. It has 13 digits, the last of which is a check digit, and is sometimes written with the prefix MK in Latin or Cyrillic letters.

examples.description: Example with the Cyrillic prefix from the python-stdnum documentation
Example with the Latin prefix from the python-stdnum documentation

name: North Macedonian entity registration number (EMBS)
doc: ЕМБС (единствен матичен број на субјектот), the 7-digit number of a legal entity in the Central Registry of the Republic of North Macedonia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MK-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads MK-CR-6524710.

name: North Macedonia postal code
doc: Postal code in North Macedonia: four digits.

name: Malian association registration number
doc: Registration number of an association at the Ministry of Territorial Administration of Mali. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ML-MAT; with that prefix an identifier reads ML-MAT-0003.

name: Malian tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF), the tax identification number of taxpayers in Mali. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ML-NIF; with that prefix an identifier reads ML-NIF-085101101W.

name: Myanmar postal code
doc: Postal code in Myanmar: five digits.

name: Maritime Mobile Service Identity
doc: Nine-digit number that identifies a station of the maritime radio service (ITU-R Recommendation M.585) in digital selective calling, AIS and satellite systems. Ship stations start with the three-digit Maritime Identification Digits (MID) of the flag country; coast stations start with 00, groups of ships with 0, search and rescue aircraft with 111, and aids to navigation with 99. Public telephone networks can use it to call ships automatically.

examples.description: Group coast station of the US Coast Guard

ru.name: Идентификатор морской подвижной службы (MMSI)
ru.doc: Девятизначный номер станции морской радиослужбы (рекомендация МСЭ-R M.585), используемый в цифровом избирательном вызове, АИС и спутниковых системах. Номер судовой станции начинается с трёхзначного морского идентификационного кода (MID) страны флага, номер береговой станции — с 00.

name: Mongolia postal code
doc: Postal code in Mongolia: five digits.

name: Mobile country code (MCC)
doc: Three-digit code of ITU-T Recommendation E.212 that identifies the country of a mobile network; with the mobile network code (mobile_network_code) it identifies the network (plmn_id) and forms the start of an IMSI. The first digit gives the region (2 Europe, 3 North America and the Caribbean, 4 Asia and the Middle East, 5 Oceania, 6 Africa, 7 South and Central America, 9 worldwide services); 001 is for test networks. A country can have several codes.

ru.name: Мобильный код страны (MCC)
ru.doc: Трёхзначный код по рекомендации МСЭ-Т E.212, обозначающий страну мобильной сети. Вместе с кодом сети (MNC) идентифицирует сеть и образует начало IMSI. Первая цифра обозначает регион; у страны может быть несколько кодов.

name: Mobile network code (MNC)
doc: Two- or three-digit code of ITU-T Recommendation E.212 that identifies a mobile network within its mobile country code (mobile_country_code). The number of digits is significant, so 01 and 001 are different codes; the same MNC means different networks under different country codes.

examples.description: Three-digit MNC, used with MCC 310 (United States)

ru.name: Код мобильной сети (MNC)
ru.doc: Двух- или трёхзначный код по рекомендации МСЭ-Т E.212, обозначающий мобильную сеть в пределах мобильного кода страны (MCC). Количество цифр значимо, поэтому 01 и 001 — разные коды.

name: Molecular Formula
doc: Molecular formulae indicate the simple numbers of each type of atom in a molecule of a molecular substance.

name: Mondo Disease Ontology ID
doc: Identifier of a disease in Mondo, an ontology that harmonizes disease definitions from many terminologies. It is MONDO: and seven digits; OBO PURLs and Wikidata write MONDO_ instead.

name: Monero address
doc: Mainnet address of Monero: the network byte, the public spend key, the public view key and a 4-byte Keccak-256 checksum, encoded with Monero's own Base58 variant that converts 8-byte blocks into 11 characters. Standard addresses (network byte 18) have 95 characters and start with 4, subaddresses (42) have 95 characters and start with 8, and integrated addresses (19), which add an 8-byte payment ID, have 106 characters and start with 4.

examples.description: Example standard address of the Monero documentation

name: Money amount
doc: Amount of money as numeric value

categories.name: All measurable values (percentage, amount and e.t.c)

name: MongoDB unique Object ID
doc: MongoDB ObjectId, the unique id that MongoDB assigns to each document of a collection as the field _id. It is a 12-byte value written as 24 hexadecimal characters. The first 4 bytes are the creation time in seconds since the Unix epoch, then come a 5-byte random value per process and a 3-byte counter, so ObjectIds sort roughly by creation time. The MongoDB manual writes the hexadecimal digits in lowercase. The xid format encodes the same 12 bytes in Base32 (xid). It is not the ArcGIS OBJECTID (objectid).

examples.description: ObjectId(32) from the MongoDB manual, 32 seconds after the Unix epoch

name: Month
doc: Month as number since start of the year. Could be from 1 to 12

ru.doc: Месяц и день без года на китайском или японском языке, например 12月25日.

patterns.doc: Day and month without a year, written as two two-digit numbers separated by a dot, for example 25.12. Such values look like decimal numbers, so they need context, such as a column name, to be read as dates.

ru.doc: Месяц и день без года на английском языке, например May 5 или 25th December.

name: Mobile Subscriber ISDN Number (MSISDN)
doc: Telephone number of a mobile subscription, which the network links to the IMSI of the SIM card (3GPP TS 23.003). It is an ITU-T E.164 number written in international form without the plus sign, spaces or punctuation; the country code, the national destination code and the subscriber number together have at most 15 digits.

examples.description: United States; 555-0100 to 555-0199 are reserved for fictional use
United Kingdom; 07700 900000 to 900999 are reserved by Ofcom for drama
The plus sign belongs to the E.164 notation (phone_e164), not to the MSISDN
National notation with the trunk prefix 0 instead of the country code

ru.name: Номер мобильного абонента (MSISDN)
ru.doc: Телефонный номер мобильной подписки, который сеть связывает с IMSI SIM-карты (3GPP TS 23.003). Это номер по рекомендации МСЭ-Т E.164 в международном виде без знака плюс, пробелов и разделителей; код страны, код сети и номер абонента вместе содержат не более 15 цифр.

name: Maltese driver's license number
doc: Number of a driving licence issued in Malta. Microsoft Purview looks for two letters or digits and six digits in groups of three.

name: Maltese identity card number
doc: Number of the Maltese identity card: seven digits followed by one of the letters M, G, A, P, L, H, B or Z.

name: Maltese passport number
doc: Number of a passport issued by Malta. Microsoft Purview looks for seven digits.

name: Malta postal code
doc: Postal code in Malta: three letters and four digits, optionally separated by a space; codes in the format used before 2007 have two digits.

name: Maltese tax identification number
doc: Maltese tax identification number. For Maltese nationals it is seven digits and a letter (the identity card number); for other persons and for entities it is nine digits.

name: Maltese VAT number
doc: VAT registration number in Malta: eight digits, the first not 0, with a weighted check.

name: Mauritian company number
doc: Company or partnership number (file number) in the Companies and Businesses Registration Integrated System (CBRIS) of Mauritius. It differs from the business registration number that some companies also have. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MU-CR; with that prefix an identifier reads MU-CR-C136127.

name: Mauritian national identity number
doc: National identity number of people in Mauritius, given at birth and printed on the National Identity Card. It has 14 characters: the first letter of the surname at birth, the date of birth (DDMMYY), a 6-digit unique number and a check character.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

name: Mauritius postal code
doc: Postal code in Mauritius: five digits, or three digits, two letters and three digits.

name: MusicBrainz artist ID
doc: MBID of an artist in MusicBrainz: a person, group, orchestra or other performer or creator credited on releases, recordings or works, as in musicbrainz.org/artist/<id>.

examples.description: Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: MusicBrainz Identifier (MBID)
doc: Permanent identifier of an entity in MusicBrainz, the open music encyclopedia: an artist, release group, release, recording, work, label, area, place, URL or track. It is a UUID in lower case with hyphens. The value does not tell the kind of entity, so the field name matters; the records musicbrainz_artist_id, musicbrainz_release_group_id and others name one kind.

examples.description: The Dark Side of the Moon (release group)

name: MusicBrainz label ID
doc: MBID of a label in MusicBrainz: an imprint, record company or other organisation whose name appears on releases, as in musicbrainz.org/label/<id>.

examples.description: Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: MusicBrainz recording ID
doc: MBID of a recording in MusicBrainz: one recorded performance or mix of a work, which may appear on many releases, as in musicbrainz.org/recording/<id>. A recording can also have an ISRC (isrc).

examples.description: Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: MusicBrainz release group ID
doc: MBID of a release group in MusicBrainz: an album, single, EP or other release as a whole, which groups all its editions (releases), as in musicbrainz.org/release-group/<id>.

examples.description: The Dark Side of the Moon
Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: MusicBrainz release ID
doc: MBID of a release in MusicBrainz: one edition of a release group, such as a CD, vinyl or digital release with its own date, country, label and barcode, as in musicbrainz.org/release/<id>.

examples.description: Nuggets: Original Artyfacts from the First Psychedelic Era, 1965–1968
Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: MusicBrainz work ID
doc: MBID of a work in MusicBrainz: a song, composition or other piece of music apart from its recordings, as in musicbrainz.org/work/<id>. A work can also have an ISWC (iswc).

examples.description: Upper case; MusicBrainz writes MBIDs in lower case

name: Maldives postal code
doc: Postal code in Maldives: five digits.

name: Mexican public entity budget code
doc: Code of a public entity in the federal budget classification of public entities of Mexico (Clasificación Administrativa). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MX-CPA; with that prefix an identifier reads MX-CPA-4-121.

name: Mexico City public entity budget code
doc: Code of a public entity in the budget classification of public entities of Mexico City. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MX-CMX_CPA; with that prefix an identifier reads MX-CMX_CPA-01C001.

name: Mexican INEGI locality code
doc: Nine-digit code of a locality of Mexico in the INEGI geostatistical framework: two digits for the state, three for the municipality and four for the locality.

name: Mexican municipality
doc: Name of a municipality (municipio) of Mexico, the level below the state, such as Guadalajara or Monterrey. Mexico has about 2,470 municipalities; Mexico City is divided into 16 boroughs (alcaldías) instead.

name: Mexican postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Mexico: five digits. The first two digits identify the state; codes of Mexico City start with 01 to 16.

name: Mexican state (province)
doc: Mexican state/province by name or code

name: Malaysian identity card number (NRIC)
doc: National Registration Identity Card number (MyKad number) of Malaysian citizens and permanent residents. It has twelve digits: the date of birth (YYMMDD), a 2-digit birth place code and four digits, the last of which is odd for males and even for females. It is often written with hyphens after the sixth and eighth digits.

examples.description: Synthetic number in the documented format
Synthetic number in the documented format
The first example in its printed form

name: Malaysia postal code
doc: Postal code in Malaysia: five digits.

name: Malaysian company registration number (SSM)
doc: Registration number of a company at the Companies Commission of Malaysia (Suruhanjaya Syarikat Malaysia, SSM). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as MY-SSM; with that prefix an identifier reads MY-SSM-993856H.

name: Japanese My Number (マイナンバー) by known name
doc: Japanese My Number (マイナンバー) by known name identifier

name: Mozambican taxpayer identification number (NUIT)
doc: Número Único de Identificação Tributária, the tax number of individuals and organizations in Mozambique, issued by the Autoridade Tributária. It has nine digits, sometimes written as three groups of three. The first digit gives the type of taxpayer, the next seven are sequential, and the last is a check digit computed with weights 8, 9, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8 and 9 modulo 11.

name: Mozambique postal code
doc: Postal code in Mozambique: four digits.

name: Namibian BIPA registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, close corporation or other entity at the Business and Intellectual Property Authority (BIPA) of Namibia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NA-BIPA; with that prefix an identifier reads NA-BIPA-CC-2017-11330.

name: Namibia postal code
doc: Postal code in Namibia: five digits.

name: Namibian taxpayer identification number
doc: Taxpayer number that the Namibia Revenue Agency (NamRA) gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NA-NAMRA; with that prefix an identifier reads NA-NAMRA-04822224.
