name: Name suffix
doc: Word, abbreviation or numeral written after a person's surname. It can be generational (Jr., Sr., III), academic (PhD), an honour (OBE), professional or military.

examples.description: honour (Officer of the Order of the British Empire)

name: Nano ID
doc: Random identifier of the Nano ID library. By default it is 21 characters of the URL-safe alphabet A-Z, a-z, 0-9, underscore and hyphen, which gives a collision probability similar to UUIDv4. Applications can choose another length or alphabet; the regexp covers only the default.

examples.description: Example of the Nano ID README
Nano ID with a custom size of 10, not covered
The plus sign is not in the default alphabet

name: North American phone number (NANP)
doc: Ten-digit telephone number of the North American Numbering Plan (NANP), the shared numbering plan of country code 1 used by the United States, Canada and several Caribbean and Pacific territories. The number is a three-digit area code, a three-digit central office code and a four-digit line number. The area code and the central office code start with a digit from 2 to 9. Common notations are NPA-NXX-XXXX and (NPA) NXX-XXXX, with an optional leading 1 or +1.

examples.description: (NPA) NXX-XXXX notation; 555-0100 to 555-0199 are reserved for fictional use
Parentheses without a space, as in the D3M definition
An area code cannot start with 0 or 1
Seven-digit local number without an area code

ru.name: Североамериканский номер телефона (NANP)
ru.doc: Десятизначный номер телефона по Североамериканскому плану нумерации (NANP) с кодом страны 1. Используется в США, Канаде и ряде территорий Карибского бассейна и Тихого океана. Состоит из трёхзначного кода региона, трёхзначного кода станции и четырёхзначного номера абонента.

name: Person nationality
doc: Nationality of the person from list of unique code from one of code lists or defined somehow else.

patterns.name: Person nationality in English
patterns.doc: Nationality of the person written in English

name: NATO Stock Number (NSN)
doc: Thirteen-digit code of a standardized item of supply in the NATO Codification System, called National Stock Number in the United States. The first four digits are the NATO Supply Classification group and class. The remaining nine digits are the National Item Identification Number (NIIN): two digits for the National Codification Bureau of the country that first codified the item, then seven digits. The usual notation is NNNN-NN-NNN-NNNN; the hyphens are optional.

examples.description: The country code must have two digits

name: NCBI Taxonomy ID
doc: Number of a taxon in the Taxonomy database of the US National Center for Biotechnology Information, which names the organisms in the GenBank sequence databases, such as 9606 for Homo sapiens.

name: NCBI Gene ID (Entrez Gene)
doc: Numeric identifier of a gene record in the NCBI Gene database (formerly Entrez Gene) of the US National Center for Biotechnology Information. Gene records cover many species. PubChem gene pages use this ID, as in https://pubchem.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/gene/3123.

examples.description: Alkaline phosphatase gene of Bacillus cereus ATCC 14579

ru.name: Идентификатор гена NCBI (Entrez Gene)
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор записи о гене в базе данных NCBI Gene.

name: US NCES school identifier
doc: Identifier of a US school assigned by the National Center for Education Statistics: twelve digits for a public school (the seven-digit district ID followed by a five-digit school number) or eight characters for a private school.

name: NCI Thesaurus code
doc: Concept code in the NCI Thesaurus (NCIt), the reference vocabulary of the US National Cancer Institute for drugs, diseases, genes, anatomy and other biomedical concepts. A concept code is "C" followed by digits.

ru.name: Код тезауруса NCI
ru.doc: Код понятия в тезаурусе Национального института рака США (NCI Thesaurus).

name: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier (NCT number)
doc: Registration number of a clinical study in ClinicalTrials.gov, the registry of the US National Library of Medicine: NCT and eight digits.

examples.description: Atrial Fibrillation Clopidogrel Trial With Irbesartan for Prevention of Vascular Events
Trial of Treatments for COVID-19 in Hospitalized Adults

name: Nigerien tax identification number (NIF)
doc: Numéro d'identification fiscale (NIF) that the Directorate General of Taxes of Niger gives to taxpayers. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NE-DGI; with that prefix an identifier reads NE-DGI-5412.

name: Niger postal code
doc: Postal code in Niger: four digits.

name: New Relic user key
doc: User key of New Relic, a personal API key that NerdGraph, New Relic's GraphQL API, requires for querying data and changing configuration. It starts with NRAK- followed by 27 letters and digits. Ingest keys, such as the license key and browser keys, are different.

name: Nigerian BPP contractor registration number
doc: Registration number of a contractor in the Contractor Registration System of the Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP) of Nigeria. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NG-BPP; with that prefix an identifier reads NG-BPP-BPP_5125283435.

name: Nigerian Bank Verification Number (BVN)
doc: Bank Verification Number, a biometric identifier of bank customers in Nigeria introduced by the Central Bank of Nigeria in 2014 and run with the Nigeria Inter-Bank Settlement System (NIBSS). One person has one BVN across all banks. It has 11 digits. No check-digit rule is published, and it has the same shape as the National Identification Number (NIN).

examples.description: Synthetic value in the documented format
Synthetic value in the documented format

name: Nigerian National Identification Number (NIN)
doc: National Identification Number, the 11-digit number that the National Identity Management Commission (NIMC) gives to a Nigerian citizen or legal resident after enrolment in the national identity database. It is printed without separators on the NIN slip and the national ID card. No check-digit rule is published. It has the same shape as the Bank Verification Number (BVN).

examples.description: Format example from the English Wikipedia article on national identification numbers
Synthetic value in the documented format

name: Nigeria postal code
doc: Postal code in Nigeria: six digits.

name: Nigerian CAC registration number (RC number)
doc: Registration number of a company at the Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) of Nigeria; for companies it starts with RC. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NG-CAC; with that prefix an identifier reads NG-CAC-RC1726083.

name: Nigerian taxpayer identification number (TIN)
doc: Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) of taxpayers in Nigeria. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NG-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads NG-TIN-23227964-0001.

name: NHS number
doc: Datatype for 'NHS number' (nhsnumber) from rules in context 'pii'.

name: Nicaragua postal code
doc: Postal code in Nicaragua: five digits.

name: NIF por nombre de campo
doc: ES datatype for 'NIF por nombre de campo' (nif) from rules in context 'finances'. The Spanish tax identification number (Número de Identificación Fiscal, NIF) is a unique identifier assigned to individuals and entities for tax purposes in Spain. For individuals, it consists of 8 digits followed by a check letter. For foreigners, it may start with X, Y, Z, K, L, or M followed by 7 digits and a check letter. The total length is 9 characters.

examples.description: Spanish NIF for a Spanish citizen with 8 digits and check letter
Spanish NIF for a foreigner starting with X followed by 7 digits and check letter

name: UK National Insurance number
doc: The National Insurance number is a number used in the United Kingdom in the administration of the National Insurance or social security system. It is also used for some purposes in the UK tax system.

name: Dutch healthcare provider code (AGB-code)
doc: AGB-code (Algemeen GegevensBeheer zorgverleners), the eight-digit code of a party in the AGB register, which Vektis keeps for the Dutch health insurers. Individual caregivers (zorgverleners), care businesses (ondernemingen) and their locations (vestigingen) each have their own code. It is the key that identifies them in billing, in contracts with insurers and in referrals. The first two digits give the type of care (zorgsoort).

nl.name: AGB-code
nl.doc: Achtcijferige code van een zorgverlener, onderneming of vestiging in het AGB-register van Vektis; de eerste twee cijfers geven de zorgsoort.

ru.name: Код поставщика медицинских услуг Нидерландов (AGB)
ru.doc: Восьмизначный код медицинского работника, организации или её отделения в реестре AGB компании Vektis; первые две цифры обозначают вид помощи.

name: Dutch BAG building identifier (pand)
doc: Identifier of a building (pand) in the Dutch register of addresses and buildings (BAG), a BAG object identifier (nl_bag_id) with the object type 10 in digits 5 and 6.

examples.description: Building in Amsterdam, from the PDOK BAG API

name: Dutch BAG object identifier
doc: Identifier of an object in the Basisregistratie Adressen en Gebouwen (BAG), the Dutch register of addresses and buildings that the municipalities keep and Kadaster publishes. It has 16 digits: the 4-digit code of the municipality that assigned it (nl_municipality_code, possibly of a former municipality), a 2-digit object type and a 10-digit serial number. The object types are 01 verblijfsobject (unit such as a dwelling or office), 02 ligplaats (mooring), 03 standplaats (pitch), 10 pand (building, nl_bag_building_id), 20 nummeraanduiding (address) and 30 openbare ruimte (public space such as a street; Wikidata P5207). Places (woonplaatsen) have a 4-digit code instead (nl_bag_woonplaats_code).

examples.description: Verblijfsobject in Amsterdam, from the PDOK BAG API
Nummeraanduiding in Amsterdam, from the PDOK BAG API
Ligplaats in Amsterdam, from the PDOK BAG API

nl.name: BAG-identificatie
nl.doc: Zestiencijferige identificatie van een BAG-object - gemeentecode, objecttypecode en volgnummer.

ru.name: Идентификатор объекта BAG (Нидерланды)
ru.doc: Шестнадцатизначный идентификатор объекта в реестре адресов и зданий BAG - код муниципалитета, код типа объекта и порядковый номер.

patterns.name: Dutch BAG building identifier (pand)
patterns.doc: Identifier of a building (pand) in the Dutch register of addresses and buildings (BAG), a BAG object identifier (nl_bag_id) with the object type 10 in digits 5 and 6.

examples.description: Building in Amsterdam, from the PDOK BAG API

name: Dutch BAG place code (woonplaatscode)
doc: Four-digit code of a place (woonplaats) in the Dutch register of addresses and buildings (BAG), from 0001 to 9999, as in 3594 for Amsterdam. A woonplaats is the named place of an address and is not the same as a municipality, which can contain several places.

ru.name: Код населённого пункта в реестре BAG (Нидерланды)

name: Dutch healthcare professional registration number (BIG-nummer)
doc: BIG-nummer, the personal registration number of a healthcare professional, in the BIG register, which the CIBG keeps for the Ministry of Health, Welfare and Sport under the Wet BIG (Wet op de beroepen in de individuele gezondheidszorg). Dutch Wikipedia gives its length as 11 digits.

nl.name: BIG-nummer
nl.doc: Persoonlijk registratienummer van een zorgverlener in het BIG-register van het CIBG.

ru.name: Регистрационный номер медицинского работника Нидерландов (BIG)
ru.doc: Личный номер медицинского работника в реестре BIG, который ведёт CIBG.

name: Dutch school identification number (BRIN)
doc: BRIN number (Basisregistratie Instellingen), the code of a school or other education institution in the Netherlands, kept by the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) for the Ministry of Education. It has four characters, two digits and two letters, as in 21AB. Two more digits may follow for a specific location of the institution (vestigingsnummer), as in 16PK00. DUO publishes the register as open data.

examples.description: Barlaeus Gymnasium in Amsterdam, the example of Wikidata
Location of the Zuider Gymnasium in Rotterdam, the example of Wikidata
The location number has a letter

nl.name: BRIN-nummer
nl.doc: Code van een onderwijsinstelling in de Basisregistratie Instellingen van DUO - twee cijfers en twee letters, eventueel gevolgd door twee cijfers voor een vestiging.

ru.name: Номер учебного заведения Нидерландов (BRIN)
ru.doc: Код школы или другого учебного заведения в реестре DUO - две цифры и две буквы, иногда с двумя цифрами номера филиала.

name: Dutch neighbourhood code (CBS buurtcode)
doc: Code of a neighbourhood (buurt) in the Wijk- en Buurtkaart of Statistics Netherlands (CBS), BU followed by eight characters, the 4-digit municipality code (nl_municipality_code), the 2-character district number (nl_wijk_code) and a 2-digit neighbourhood number, as in BU05990110 for Stadsdriehoek in Rotterdam. In 2026 only Amsterdam uses letters in the district part, as in BU0363AA01. CBS open data table 86358NED lists the codes of 2026.

examples.description: The neighbourhood number has a letter

nl.name: Buurtcode (CBS)
nl.doc: BU gevolgd door de gemeentecode, het wijknummer en een buurtnummer van twee cijfers, zoals BU05990110.

ru.name: Код квартала Нидерландов (CBS)
ru.doc: BU, код муниципалитета, номер района и двузначный номер квартала, например BU05990110.

name: Dutch province code (CBS)
doc: Code of a Dutch province used by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) in its regional tables, PV and two digits from PV20 (Groningen) to PV31 (Limburg). The other provinces are PV21 Fryslân, PV22 Drenthe, PV23 Overijssel, PV24 Flevoland, PV25 Gelderland, PV26 Utrecht, PV27 Noord-Holland, PV28 Zuid-Holland, PV29 Zeeland and PV30 Noord-Brabant. The ISO 3166-2 codes are the pattern nl_province_code.

ru.name: Код провинции Нидерландов (CBS)
ru.doc: Код провинции в таблицах статистического бюро CBS, от PV20 (Гронинген) до PV31 (Лимбург).

name: Dutch driver's license number
doc: Document number of a driving licence (rijbewijs) issued in the Netherlands by the RDW, ten digits printed in field 5 of the card. Microsoft Purview looks for ten digits without spaces or delimiters and no check digit.

examples.description: Number of the RDW specimen driving licence, model 2025

nl.name: Rijbewijsnummer
nl.doc: Documentnummer van een Nederlands rijbewijs, tien cijfers in veld 5.

ru.name: Номер водительского удостоверения Нидерландов
ru.doc: Номер нидерландского водительского удостоверения - десять цифр в поле 5.

name: Dutch EORI number
doc: EORI number issued in the Netherlands for customs procedures in the European Union, NL followed by nine digits. A company that has an RSIN and files its own customs declarations composes it from NL and its RSIN, padded with leading zeros to nine digits. Other businesses, sole proprietorships among them, request one from Dutch Customs (Douane).

examples.description: Built from the RSIN example of the KVK Zoeken API

nl.name: EORI-nummer
nl.doc: NL gevolgd door negen cijfers; een bedrijf met een RSIN gebruikt NL en zijn RSIN.

ru.name: Номер EORI Нидерландов
ru.doc: NL и девять цифр; компания с RSIN составляет номер из NL и своего RSIN.

name: Dutch IBAN
doc: International Bank Account Number of a bank account in the Netherlands: 18 characters, NL, two IBAN check digits, the four-letter bank code and the ten-digit account number. The bank code is always the first four letters of the BIC of the bank, as in ABNA for ABN AMRO. Betaalvereniging Nederland is the registration authority and publishes the list of bank codes. It is printed in groups of four, as in NL91 ABNA 0417 1643 00.

examples.description: Example of the SWIFT IBAN Registry
The same IBAN in its printed form

nl.name: Nederlandse IBAN
nl.doc: Internationaal bankrekeningnummer van 18 tekens - NL, twee controlecijfers, een bankcode van vier letters en een rekeningnummer van tien cijfers.

ru.name: IBAN Нидерландов
ru.doc: Международный номер банковского счёта в Нидерландах - 18 символов, NL, две контрольные цифры, четырёхбуквенный код банка и десятизначный номер счёта.

name: Dutch establishment number (KVK vestigingsnummer)
doc: Vestigingsnummer, the 12-digit number that the Netherlands Chamber of Commerce (KVK) gives to each location (vestiging) of a business registered in the Business Register, such as a shop, office or factory. It is not derived from the organisation's 8-digit KVK number (kvk). Organisations without a location, as many associations, foundations and owners' associations are, have none. The KVK API writes it with leading zeros.

examples.description: Fictitious eenmanszaak of the KVK API test environment
Fictitious BV of the KVK API test environment
Example of the KVK Zoeken API specification

nl.name: Vestigingsnummer (KVK)
nl.doc: Twaalfcijferig nummer van een vestiging in het Handelsregister van de KVK.

ru.name: Номер филиала организации в Торговом реестре Нидерландов
ru.doc: Двенадцатизначный номер места деятельности (vestiging) в Торговом реестре Торговой палаты Нидерландов.

name: Dutch municipality (gemeente)
doc: Name of a municipality (gemeente) of the Netherlands, the level below the province, such as Amsterdam, Aalsmeer or Aa en Hunze. Mergers have reduced their number almost every year; Statistics Netherlands (CBS) counts 342 on 1 January 2026, the same as in 2025. Their CBS codes are the pattern nl_municipality_code.

examples.description: The Hague, under its official name

ru.name: Муниципалитет Нидерландов
ru.doc: Название муниципалитета (gemeente) Нидерландов; на 1 января 2026 года их 342.

patterns.name: Dutch municipality code (CBS)
patterns.doc: Four-digit code of a Dutch municipality assigned by Statistics Netherlands (CBS), often written with the prefix GM, as in GM0363 for Amsterdam. CBS never reuses a whole code; a municipality created by a merger or renamed gets a new code that starts with 1, which may repeat the last three digits of an abolished municipality (1892 Zuidplas, from 0892). The code is the first four digits of the CBS district (nl_wijk_code) and neighbourhood (nl_buurt_code) codes; BAG identifiers (nl_bag_id) start with the code of the municipality that assigned them.

examples.description: A district code, not a municipality code

nl.name: Gemeentecode (CBS)
nl.doc: Viercijferige code van een gemeente van het CBS, vaak met het voorvoegsel GM, zoals GM0363 voor Amsterdam.

ru.name: Код муниципалитета Нидерландов (CBS)
ru.doc: Четырёхзначный код муниципалитета, присвоенный статистическим бюро CBS, часто с префиксом GM, например GM0363 (Амстердам).

name: Dutch municipality code (CBS)
doc: Four-digit code of a Dutch municipality assigned by Statistics Netherlands (CBS), often written with the prefix GM, as in GM0363 for Amsterdam. CBS never reuses a whole code; a municipality created by a merger or renamed gets a new code that starts with 1, which may repeat the last three digits of an abolished municipality (1892 Zuidplas, from 0892). The code is the first four digits of the CBS district (nl_wijk_code) and neighbourhood (nl_buurt_code) codes; BAG identifiers (nl_bag_id) start with the code of the municipality that assigned them.

examples.description: A district code, not a municipality code

nl.name: Gemeentecode (CBS)
nl.doc: Viercijferige code van een gemeente van het CBS, vaak met het voorvoegsel GM, zoals GM0363 voor Amsterdam.

ru.name: Код муниципалитета Нидерландов (CBS)
ru.doc: Четырёхзначный код муниципалитета, присвоенный статистическим бюро CBS, часто с префиксом GM, например GM0363 (Амстердам).

name: Dutch organisation identification number (OIN)
doc: Organisatie-identificatienummer (OIN), the 20-digit number that identifies a government organisation or another party in Dutch government data exchange (Digikoppeling) and in PKIoverheid certificates. Logius keeps the register. An OIN is an 8-digit prefix naming the source register, the main number from that register and zeros up to 20 digits. The prefixes are 00000001 RSIN, 00000002 Fi-nummer, 00000003 KVK number (preferred for new OINs), 00000004 sub-OIN, 00000006 main number issued by Logius, 00000007 BRIN, 00000008 foreign organisation, 00000009 UZI, 00000010 TRR-BD of the tax service, and 00000099 test OINs.

examples.description: Gemeente Utrecht, built from its RSIN
A foreign organisation (Deloitte Global Tax Center Europe)

nl.name: Organisatie-identificatienummer (OIN)
nl.doc: Twintigcijferig nummer van een organisatie in Digikoppeling en PKIoverheid - een prefix van acht cijfers voor het bronregister, het hoofdnummer en nullen.

ru.name: Идентификационный номер организации Нидерландов (OIN)
ru.doc: Двадцатизначный номер организации в государственном обмене данными (Digikoppeling) и сертификатах PKIoverheid - восьмизначный префикс реестра-источника, номер из этого реестра и нули.

name: Dutch education number (onderwijsnummer)
doc: Onderwijsnummer, the 9-digit number that the Dienst Uitvoering Onderwijs (DUO) gives to a pupil or student in government-funded education in the Netherlands who has no citizen service number (BSN), for example a pupil from abroad. It starts with 10 and uses the weights of the BSN 11-proef, but the weighted sum leaves a remainder of 5 when divided by 11 instead of 0, which tells the two numbers apart. When the pupil gets a BSN, the BSN replaces it in school records.

examples.description: Synthetic number with a valid check digit
The weighted sum does not leave 5 (python-stdnum reference value)

nl.name: Onderwijsnummer
nl.doc: Negencijferig nummer dat DUO toekent aan een leerling of student zonder burgerservicenummer; begint met 10 en voldoet aan een variant van de elfproef (rest 5).

ru.name: Учебный номер учащегося Нидерландов (onderwijsnummer)
ru.doc: Девятизначный номер, который DUO присваивает учащемуся без BSN; начинается с 10, взвешенная сумма по правилу 11-proef даёт остаток 5.

name: Dutch government organisation identifier (OWMS)
doc: Identifier of a Dutch government organisation in the Overheid.nl Web Metadata Standard (OWMS): the last part of the organisation's URI in the OWMS lists. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as NL-OWMS; with that prefix an identifier reads NL-OWMS-rfmcie.

nl.name: OWMS-identificatie van een overheidsorganisatie
nl.doc: Laatste deel van de URI van een overheidsorganisatie in de waardelijsten van de Overheid.nl Web Metadata Standaard (OWMS).

ru.name: Идентификатор государственной организации Нидерландов (OWMS)
ru.doc: Последняя часть URI государственной организации в списках стандарта метаданных Overheid.nl (OWMS).

name: Dutch passport number
doc: Document number of a Dutch passport; identity cards use the same format. It has nine characters. The first two are letters, the next six are letters or digits, and the last is a digit. The letter O is never used; documents issued since 1 December 2019 also leave out the digit 0. Microsoft Purview looks for nine letters or digits.

examples.description: Number of the RvIG specimen passport and identity card of 2014
Number of the RvIG specimen passport of 2024
The letter O is not used (python-stdnum reference value)
Starts with digits and ends with a letter (python-stdnum reference value)

nl.name: Paspoortnummer
nl.doc: Documentnummer van een Nederlands paspoort of identiteitskaart - twee letters, zes letters of cijfers en een cijfer; de letter O komt niet voor.

ru.name: Номер паспорта Нидерландов
ru.doc: Номер нидерландского паспорта или удостоверения личности - две буквы, шесть букв или цифр и цифра; буква O не используется.

name: Dutch postal code
doc: Postcode in the Netherlands: four digits, the first not 0, a space and two capital letters, from 1000 AA upwards. The letter pairs SA, SD and SS are not used because of their association with Nazi Germany. The letters F, I, O, Q, U and Y were left out at first but are now used. The digits 0000-0999 are kept for the Caribbean Netherlands and are not in use. A full postcode covers a part of a street, so with a house number it identifies an address.

examples.description: Synthetic postcode written without the space
SS is not used (python-stdnum reference value)

nl.name: Postcode
nl.doc: Vier cijfers (de eerste geen 0), een spatie en twee hoofdletters; de combinaties SA, SD en SS worden niet gebruikt.

ru.name: Почтовый индекс Нидерландов
ru.doc: Четыре цифры (первая не 0), пробел и две заглавные буквы; сочетания SA, SD и SS не используются.

name: Dutch province
doc: Name of one of the 12 provinces (provincies) of the Netherlands, such as Noord-Holland, Utrecht or Fryslân, which is also written Friesland. Their codes are the pattern nl_province_code.

examples.description: Fryslân, under its older official name

ru.name: Провинция Нидерландов
ru.doc: Название одной из 12 провинций Нидерландов, например Noord-Holland, Utrecht или Fryslân (Friesland).

patterns.name: Dutch province code (CBS)
patterns.doc: Code of a Dutch province used by Statistics Netherlands (CBS) in its regional tables, PV and two digits from PV20 (Groningen) to PV31 (Limburg). The other provinces are PV21 Fryslân, PV22 Drenthe, PV23 Overijssel, PV24 Flevoland, PV25 Gelderland, PV26 Utrecht, PV27 Noord-Holland, PV28 Zuid-Holland, PV29 Zeeland and PV30 Noord-Brabant. The ISO 3166-2 codes are the pattern nl_province_code.

ru.name: Код провинции Нидерландов (CBS)
ru.doc: Код провинции в таблицах статистического бюро CBS, от PV20 (Гронинген) до PV31 (Лимбург).

name: Dutch province code (ISO 3166-2:NL)
doc: Code of one of the 12 Dutch provinces from ISO 3166-2:NL, two letters after NL-, such as NL-NH (Noord-Holland), NL-FR (Fryslân) or NL-ZH (Zuid-Holland), alone or with the country code. ISO 3166-2:NL also lists Aruba (NL-AW), Curaçao (NL-CW) and Sint Maarten (NL-SX) as countries and Bonaire, Saba and Sint Eustatius (NL-BQ1 to NL-BQ3) as special municipalities; they are not provinces and are not covered. Statistics Netherlands uses its own codes, the pattern nl_cbs_province_code.

examples.description: Bonaire, a special municipality, not a province

ru.name: Код провинции Нидерландов (ISO 3166-2:NL)
ru.doc: Код одной из 12 провинций Нидерландов по ISO 3166-2:NL, например NL-NH (Северная Голландия).

name: Dutch national monument number (rijksmonumentnummer)
doc: Number of a national monument (rijksmonument) in the register of the Cultural Heritage Agency of the Netherlands (Rijksdienst voor het Cultureel Erfgoed, RCE); Wikidata expects one to six digits. The monument register shows a monument at https://monumentenregister.cultureelerfgoed.nl/monumenten/ followed by the number. Complexes of monuments have their own numbers (Wikidata P7135).

ru.name: Номер памятника национального значения Нидерландов (rijksmonument)
ru.doc: Номер памятника в реестре Государственной службы культурного наследия Нидерландов (RCE).

name: Dutch standard industrial classification code (SBI)
doc: Code of the Standaard Bedrijfsindeling (SBI), the classification of economic activities of Statistics Netherlands (CBS), which the Chamber of Commerce (KVK) also uses to record the activities of businesses. Sections are letters; divisions, groups, classes and subclasses have two to five digits, which CBS writes with dots, as in 62.10.0. The first two digits follow the UN ISIC classification and the first four NACE (eu_nace), with a few exceptions; the fifth digit adds Dutch subclasses. SBI 2025 follows NACE Rev. 2.1 and gives four-digit classes without a subclass a fifth digit 0. KVK uses SBI 2025 since 6 September 2025, and CBS moves its statistics to it from 2026; the older SBI 2008 codes stay in many data sets.

name: Dutch vehicle registration number (kenteken)
doc: Registration number (kenteken) of a car or van in the Netherlands, issued by the RDW. It has six letters and digits in three groups separated by hyphens; the order of letter and digit groups is the series (sidecode). Series 4 to 12 are covered: XX-99-XX, XX-XX-99, 99-XX-XX, 99-XXX-9, 9-XXX-99, XX-999-X, X-999-XX, XXX-99-X (cars since June 2024) and X-99-XXX (vans since 2024). Since series 4 the letters are consonants without C and Q, which look too much like a zero; Y appears only in series 4. Some letter combinations, such as SS, SD, NSB and the names of political parties, are never issued. RDW open data writes the number without hyphens. Older series 1 to 3 with vowels, mopeds, trailers and special plates follow other rules and are not covered.

Since 1 January 2020 sole traders have a separate btw-identificatienummer that does not contain their BSN; it is used on invoices and in contacts with other businesses, while the omzetbelastingnummer stays in use with the tax service. python-stdnum validates these newer numbers with ISO 7064 MOD 97-10 over NL and the whole number; the tax service does not publish the check.

name: ArcGIS object ID (OBJECTID)
doc: Row identifier that Esri ArcGIS adds to every geodatabase table and feature class. The default field name is OBJECTID, or OBJECTID_1 when a column of that name already exists, and ArcGIS displays it as OID or ObjectID, and as FID in shapefiles and web feature layers. ArcGIS maintains the values. Each is a non-null integer that is unique only within its table, so the same number names different rows in different layers; Global IDs serve to identify rows across geodatabases. The field is a 32-bit integer by default, up to 2,147,483,647, and ArcGIS Pro can migrate it to a 64-bit object ID limited to 9,007,199,254,740,991. Datasets exported from ArcGIS keep it as an objectid or OBJECTID column, for example on Opendatasoft portals next to geo_point_2d and geo_shape, where it is sometimes stored as a decimal number such as 89.0. It is not the MongoDB ObjectId (mongodbid).

doc: Identifier of a contracting process in the Open Contracting Data Standard (OCDS). It joins a publisher prefix and the publisher's own identifier of the process. The prefix is "ocds-" followed by six random lowercase letters or digits assigned to the publisher; the local part has no fixed format. The ocid is case-sensitive and links all releases about one procurement process.

name: OCLC Control Number
doc: OCLC assigns a unique control number (referred to as an "OCN" for "OCLC Control Number") to each new bibliographic record in the WorldCat. Numbers are assigned serially, and as of mid-2013 over a billion OCNs had been created. In September 2013, the OCLC declared these numbers to be in the public domain, removing a perceived barrier to widespread use of OCNs outside OCLC itself.[42] The control numbers link WorldCat's records to local library system records by providing a common reference key for a record across libraries

name: Tor onion service address (.onion)
doc: Address of a Tor onion service, reachable only through the Tor network. A version 3 address, the only kind that current Tor releases support, is 56 base32 characters followed by .onion. The characters encode the 32-byte ed25519 public key of the service, a 2-byte SHA3-256 checksum and the version byte 3, so the last character is always d. Subdomains may precede it, as in www.<address>.onion. The 16-character version 2 addresses were retired in 2021 and do not match. The regexp checks the form, not the checksum.

name: OpenAI API key
doc: Secret key of the OpenAI API. Keys start with sk-; project, service account and admin keys start with sk-proj-, sk-svcacct- or sk-admin-. Secret scanners recognise them by the fixed marker T3BlbkFJ in the middle of the key. Examples are left out because GitHub push protection rejects token-shaped values, even constructed ones.

name: OpenAlex ID
doc: Identifier of an entity in OpenAlex, the open catalogue of scholarly works: a letter for the entity type and a number. W is a work, A an author, S a source (journal or repository), I an institution, C a concept, T a topic, P a publisher and F a funder; V was used for venues before sources replaced them.

name: OPS procedure code (Operationen- und Prozedurenschlüssel)
doc: Code of a medical procedure in the OPS, the German procedure classification that the Federal Institute for Drugs and Medical Devices (BfArM) publishes every year and that hospitals use for DRG billing. A code has up to six characters, written as a chapter digit (1, 3, 5, 6, 8 or 9), a hyphen, three characters and, after a dot, up to two more, as in 5-314.11. The first three characters are digits; the others can also be lowercase letters, with x for other and y for unspecified procedures. Data files sometimes leave out the hyphen and the dot.

name: Open Researcher and Contributor ID (ORCID)
doc: The ORCID, Open Researcher and Contributor ID) is a nonproprietary alphanumeric code to uniquely identify authors and contributors of scholarly communication as well as ORCIDs website and services to look up authors and their bibliographic output (and other user-supplied pieces of information).

name: Organization identifier (ORG-ID.guide form)
doc: Globally unique identifier of an organization in the form that ORG-ID.guide defines: the code of the list (register) that issued the identifier, a hyphen and the identifier from that list. For example, GB-COH-09506232 is company 09506232 in the Companies House register (list code GB-COH). IATI and 360Giving data write organization identifiers this way. The Open Contracting Data Standard keeps the two parts apart: the list code in identifier.scheme (org_id_scheme) and the identifier in identifier.id. The registry pattern accepts identifiers without spaces; each list code maps to a registry record through mappings.orgid.

name: ORG-ID.guide list code (organization identifier scheme)
doc: Code of an organization identifier list in the ORG-ID.guide register, such as GB-COH for Companies House or XI-LEI for the Global Legal Entity Identifier Index. The code is the ISO 3166-1 country code of the list (or XI, XM, XR or ZZ for international lists), optionally an underscore and a subdivision code, a hyphen and an abbreviation of the register. It is the prefix of an org_id identifier and the value of identifier.scheme in Open Contracting data. The registry maps each list code to a datatype record through mappings.orgid.

doc: Number of a rare disease or group of diseases in the Orphanet nomenclature. It is often written with the prefix ORPHA:, which this format leaves out.

name: OpenStreetMap element ID
doc: Identifier of an OpenStreetMap element, that is a node, a way or a relation. IDs are positive 64-bit integers that are unique only within one element type, so node 100 and way 100 are different objects. Datasets write the ID as a bare number, with a type letter (n, w or r; N, W or R in Nominatim), or as type/number like in OpenStreetMap URLs. osm2pgsql stores relation IDs as negative numbers.

name: OpenStreetMap relation ID
doc: Numeric ID of an OpenStreetMap relation, a group of nodes, ways and other relations with roles. Relations model administrative boundaries, multipolygons and transport routes.

name: OpenStreetMap user ID
doc: Numeric ID of an OpenStreetMap account. Unlike the display name (osm_user) it never changes. The OpenStreetMap API returns it as the uid attribute of each element version, and osm2pgsql writes it to an osm_uid column.

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

name: OpenStreetMap username
doc: Display name of an OpenStreetMap account. In element data it names the user who made the latest version of the object; osm2pgsql writes it to an osm_user column. Users can change their display name, so the numeric user ID (osm_uid) is the stable reference.

name: OpenStreetMap way ID

name: OSV vulnerability ID
doc: Identifier of an entry in the Open Source Vulnerability (OSV) format that OSV.dev aggregates: the prefix of the entry's home database, a hyphen and an id in that database's own format, for example PYSEC-2021-63, RUSTSEC-2021-0003, GO-2022-0969 or GHSA-... Local databases that OSV.dev does not aggregate use the prefix x_. Ids contain only ASCII letters, digits and the characters : _ . -. The regexp lists the database prefixes that the OSV JSON schema defined in November 2026; new databases are added over time. CVE and GHSA identifiers are also OSV ids.

name: Organizationally Unique Identifier (OUI)
doc: 24-bit number that the IEEE Registration Authority assigns to a vendor or other organization (MA-L assignment). It forms the first three octets of MAC addresses and other EUI-48 and EUI-64 identifiers made by that organization, and is also used in World Wide Names and SNAP protocol identifiers. It is written as three hexadecimal octets, separated by hyphens or colons or not at all.

name: Bitcoin P2PKH address
doc: Legacy Bitcoin address of the pay-to-public-key-hash (P2PKH) type. It is the Base58Check encoding of the version byte 0 and the 20-byte RIPEMD-160 hash of the SHA-256 hash of a public key, so it always starts with 1. Most such addresses have 33 or 34 characters; each leading zero byte of the hash adds a 1 and makes the address shorter. Testnet P2PKH addresses start with m or n and are not matched.

name: Bitcoin P2SH address
doc: Bitcoin address of the pay-to-script-hash (P2SH) type, defined by BIP 13 and BIP 16. It is the Base58Check encoding of the version byte 5 and the 20-byte hash of a redeem script (for example a multisignature script or wrapped SegWit), so it has 34 characters and starts with 3. Older Litecoin P2SH addresses use the same version byte and cannot be told apart. Testnet P2SH addresses start with 2 and are not matched.

examples.description: Example address of the Bitcoin Wiki article on invoice addresses

name: Bitcoin P2TR address (Taproot, bc1p)
doc: Taproot address of the pay-to-taproot (P2TR) type: witness version 1 with a 32-byte x-only public key (BIP 341), encoded with Bech32m (BIP 350), not Bech32. Mainnet addresses have the prefix bc1p and 62 characters. Lower or upper case, never mixed. Testnet addresses (tb1p) are not matched.

examples.description: last character changed, the checksum fails

name: Bitcoin P2WPKH address (native SegWit, bc1q)
doc: Native SegWit address of the pay-to-witness-public-key-hash (P2WPKH) type: witness version 0 with a 20-byte public key hash (BIP 141), encoded with Bech32 (BIP 173). Mainnet addresses have the prefix bc1q and 42 characters. They are written in lower case, or in upper case in QR codes, but never in mixed case. Testnet addresses (tb1q) are not matched.

examples.description: The same address in upper case (BIP 173 test vector)

name: Bitcoin P2WSH address (native SegWit, bc1q)
doc: Native SegWit address of the pay-to-witness-script-hash (P2WSH) type: witness version 0 with the 32-byte SHA-256 hash of a witness script (BIP 141), encoded with Bech32 (BIP 173). Mainnet addresses have the prefix bc1q and 62 characters, which tells them apart from 42-character P2WPKH addresses. Lower or upper case, never mixed. Testnet addresses (tb1q) are not matched.

Microsoft Purview expects the first character of a passport number to be C, F, G, H, J or K, and also accepts the check digit and the D (Germany) that follow the number in the machine-readable zone. doc: Brand or network of a payment card, such as Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, JCB or Diners Club. It is the type of the card, not its number; the card number is the datatype bankcard.

name: PCT international application number
doc: Number that the receiving Office gives to an international patent application under the Patent Cooperation Treaty when it first receives it. Since 1 January 2004 it is PCT, a slash, the two-letter WIPO ST.3 code of the receiving Office (IB for the International Bureau), the four-digit year, a slash and a six-digit serial number. Older numbers have a two-digit year and a five-digit serial number. The regexp does not check that the two letters are an assigned ST.3 code.

doc: Four-character identifier of a three-dimensional structure entry in the Protein Data Bank, the archive of protein and nucleic acid structures run by the wwPDB partners (RCSB PDB, PDBe, PDBj, BMRB). It is a digit followed by three letters or digits. The wwPDB has announced an extended 12-character form for future entries, such as pdb_00001abc, which this regexp does not cover.

name: Peruvian region (department)

name: Permanent Equipment Identifier (PEI) of a 5G network
doc: Permanent identifier of the device that accesses a 5G core network (3GPP TS 23.003). The service APIs of the 5G core (3GPP TS 29.571) write it as imei- followed by an IMEI, imeisv- followed by an IMEISV, or, for devices on wireline access, mac- or eui- followed by a MAC address or an EUI-64 in hyphen-separated octets.

name: Public key (PEM)
doc: Public key in the PEM textual encoding: the Base64 of a DER SubjectPublicKeyInfo structure (RFC 5280) between -----BEGIN PUBLIC KEY----- and -----END PUBLIC KEY----- (RFC 7468, section 13). OpenSSL also writes RSA keys in the PKCS #1 form with the label RSA PUBLIC KEY. A public key is not secret; for the private key see x509_private_key.

doc: Accession of a protein family or domain in Pfam, a collection of protein families described by multiple sequence alignments and hidden Markov models, now maintained within InterPro at EMBL-EBI. It is PF and five digits. Pfam clans, which group related families, have CL accessions and are not covered.

name: OpenPGP key fingerprint
doc: Fingerprint of an OpenPGP key: 40 hexadecimal digits (SHA-1) for version 4 keys and 64 hexadecimal digits (SHA-256) for version 6 keys of RFC 9580. GnuPG prints a version 4 fingerprint as ten groups of four digits with a double space in the middle. Without spaces a version 4 fingerprint looks like a plain SHA-1 hash: use the field name or context.

name: OpenPGP key ID
doc: Short identifier of an OpenPGP key, 64 bits written as 16 hexadecimal digits, often after 0x (gpg --keyid-format long): the low-order 64 bits of the fingerprint for version 4 keys and the high-order 64 bits for version 6 keys (RFC 9580). Key IDs can collide; the older 8-digit short key IDs are easy to forge and are not covered.

examples.description: Key ID of the sample version 4 key of RFC 9580 (the issuer in appendix A.2)

name: OpenPGP private key block

name: OpenPGP public key block
doc: OpenPGP public key (certificate) in ASCII armor: Radix-64 text between -----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK----- and -----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK----- (RFC 9580, section 6.2), as exported by gpg --armor --export and published on key servers. It holds no secret material; for the secret key see pgp_private_key_block.
regexp: ^-----BEGIN PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----[\s\S]+-----END PGP PUBLIC KEY BLOCK-----$

It is confidential, is microprinted on the back of the PhilID card and should not be used in everyday transactions, where the PhilSys Card Number is used instead. It is often written in three groups of four digits.

The number is a three-digit area code, a three-digit central office code and a four-digit line number. The area code and the central office code start with a digit from 2 to 9. Common notations are NPA-NXX-XXXX and (NPA) NXX-XXXX, with an optional leading 1 or +1.

The digits start with a country code of one to three digits, which never starts with 0. This compact form is used by SIP, SMS gateways, ENUM and many APIs.

A global number starts with a plus sign and may contain hyphens, dots and parentheses as visual separators; a local number needs a phone-context parameter. Other parameters, such as ext for an extension, follow after semicolons.

Businesses, including sole traders, use it in tax matters; since September 2011 individuals without a business use their PESEL number instead. With the PL prefix it is the EU VAT number. Older documents group the digits with hyphens, 3-3-2-2 for individuals and 3-2-2-3 for companies. The last digit is a weighted modulo 11 check digit.

name: Plus Code (Open Location Code)
doc: Full Plus Code of the Open Location Code system published by Google, which encodes a WGS84 latitude and longitude as a grid cell. It uses 20 symbols (23456789CFGHJMPQRVWX): eight digits, the separator +, and usually two or more digits after it; a ten-digit code is a cell of about 14 by 14 metres. Shorter codes pad the eight positions before the separator with pairs of 0 and end with +. The first digit encodes latitude and the second longitude, which limits them to 2-9 and C, and to 2-9 and C-V. Codes are case-insensitive. Shortened codes that need a reference place are the pattern plus_code_short.

examples.description: Padded code from the reference validity tests
Fifteen-digit code from the reference validity tests

patterns.name: Short Plus Code (Open Location Code)
patterns.doc: Plus Code with leading digits removed, which is decoded relative to a reference location, often a town written after it (WF8Q+WF Praia). Digits are removed in pairs and only while the reference is close enough to recover the full code (plus_code). The specification describes removing two to six digits; the test data of the reference implementations also removes all eight (+2VX). Short codes keep the separator + and cannot contain padding. Short codes with nothing after the separator, such as 22+, are valid but not covered, because they look like ordinary text.

name: Short Plus Code (Open Location Code)
doc: Plus Code with leading digits removed, which is decoded relative to a reference location, often a town written after it (WF8Q+WF Praia). Digits are removed in pairs and only while the reference is close enough to recover the full code (plus_code). The specification describes removing two to six digits; the test data of the reference implementations also removes all eight (+2VX). Short codes keep the separator + and cannot contain padding. Short codes with nothing after the separator, such as 22+, are valid but not covered, because they look like ordinary text.

name: TCP/UDP port number
doc: 16-bit number from 0 to 65535 that identifies an endpoint of a transport protocol such as TCP, UDP or SCTP on a host, for example 80 for HTTP or 443 for HTTPS. RFC 6335 divides the range into system ports 0-1023 and user ports 1024-49151, which IANA assigns to services, and dynamic ports 49152-65535, which are never assigned and serve short-lived client connections. Firewall rules, network flow logs and service inventories store it. Any integer in the range matches the regexp, so the column name is needed to tell a port from another number.

patterns.name: Belgian postal code
patterns.doc: Four-digit postal code used in Belgium since 1969; it never starts with 0. The first digit mostly shows the province, though some ranges are shared: 1xxx covers Brussels, western Flemish Brabant and Walloon Brabant, 3xxx eastern Flemish Brabant and Limburg, 6xxx parts of Hainaut and Luxembourg. The main town of an area has the round number, as in 8000 (Bruges) and 8500 (Kortrijk). Some institutions such as the EU institutions, NATO and the broadcasters have codes of their own. bpost asks not to write a country prefix such as B- before the code.

name: PubChem Compound ID (CID)
doc: Number of a unique chemical structure in the PubChem Compound database of the US National Center for Biotechnology Information. Substance records (SIDs) deposited by data sources are standardized into compounds.

name: PubChem Substance ID (SID)
doc: PubChem is a database of chemical molecules and their activities against biological assays. The system is maintained by the National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), a component of the National Library of Medicine, which is part of the United States National Institutes of Health (NIH).

name: Publisher Item Identifier (PII)
doc: Identifier of an article or chapter, used since 1996 by Elsevier, the American Chemical Society, the American Physical Society, IEEE and other publishers. It has 17 characters: S for a serial or B for a book, the ISSN or ISBN of the publication, for serials two more digits (often the year), a five-digit item number and a check character. In print it is often punctuated as Sxxxx-xxxx(yy)iiiii-d. Elsevier uses the PII as the item part of its DOIs.

name: Persistent Uniform Resource Locator (PURL)
doc: URL on a PURL resolver that redirects to the current location of a resource, so that the published address keeps working when the resource moves. The original resolver at purl.org, now run by the Internet Archive, also answers at purl.net, purl.com and purl.info. Other resolvers use host names that start with purl, such as purl.fdlp.gov. Dublin Core publishes its term URIs as PURLs.

The number of digits equals the level of detail, from 1 to 23, and a tile's key begins with the key of its parent tile. The regexp only checks this shape, so it also matches other numbers made of the digits 0 to 3.

doc: Value of the References header of an email message (RFC 5322, section 3.6.4): the Message-IDs of the earlier messages of the thread, separated by whitespace. A reply copies the References of the message it answers and appends that message's Message-ID, so mail clients can rebuild a thread even when some of its messages are missing.

name: NCBI RefSeq accession
doc: Accession of a record in RefSeq, the curated, non-redundant collection of reference genomic, transcript and protein sequences of the US National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI). Two letters and an underscore give the kind of molecule, for example NM_ for an mRNA, NP_ for a protein and NC_ for a complete genomic molecule, and digits follow. A version such as .6 may be added; it grows when the sequence changes. Genome records of whole-genome shotgun projects start with NZ_ and a letter code. GenBank, ENA and DDBJ accessions without an underscore are a separate datatype (insdc_accession).

name: ResearcherID
doc: ResearcherID is an identifying system for scientific authors. The system was introduced in January 2008 by Thomson Reuters.

name: Structured creditor reference (ISO 11649, RF reference)
doc: Payment reference defined by ISO 11649 that a creditor prints on an invoice so that incoming payments can be matched to it automatically; it was first used in the SEPA rulebook. It is the letters RF, two check digits and a reference of up to 21 letters or digits, 25 characters at most, and is usually printed in groups of four. The check digits work as in an IBAN: RF and the check digits are moved to the end, letters are replaced by numbers, and the result modulo 97 is 1.

The regexp does not cover percentages, an alpha channel or the space-separated syntax of CSS Color Level 4.

doc: Persistent identifier for a research resource such as an antibody, cell line, model organism, plasmid or software tool, cited in scientific papers as RRID:<prefix>_<id> or RRID:<prefix><id>. The prefix names the source database, for example AB for antibodies, CVCL for Cellosaurus cell lines and SCR for software and databases. RRIDs are registered through SciCrunch.

name: Serbian tax identification number (PIB)

name: Dutch legal entity information number (RSIN)
doc: Rechtspersonen en Samenwerkingsverbanden Informatienummer (RSIN), the nine-digit number that a legal entity or partnership gets automatically when it registers with the Netherlands Chamber of Commerce (KVK), next to its KVK number. It is the counterpart of the citizen service number (bsn) for organisations; sole proprietorships (eenmanszaken) get none and use the owner's BSN. Before 2010 the tax service called it the Fi-nummer. The tax service builds the older VAT number (omzetbelastingnummer) and the payroll tax number from it. A company with an RSIN that files its own customs declarations composes its EORI number as NL followed by the RSIN (nl_eori). python-stdnum checks the RSIN part of a btw-nummer with the BSN 11-proef, but no official source publishes a check digit for the RSIN.

nl.doc: Negencijferig informatienummer dat een rechtspersoon of samenwerkingsverband bij inschrijving bij de KVK krijgt; vroeger het fi-nummer.

ru.name: Информационный номер юридического лица Нидерландов (RSIN)
ru.doc: Девятизначный номер, который юридическое лицо или товарищество получает при регистрации в Торговой палате (KVK); до 2010 года назывался Fi-nummer.

name: RTECS number
doc: Identifier of a substance in the Registry of Toxic Effects of Chemical Substances (RTECS), a toxicity database started by the US National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH). It is two uppercase letters followed by seven digits.

ru.name: Номер RTECS
ru.doc: Номер вещества в Реестре токсических эффектов химических веществ (RTECS).

name: Russian age rating of information products
doc: Age category of information products under the Russian Federal Law No. 436-FZ on the protection of children from information harmful to their health and development. The law sets five categories, marked 0+, 6+, 12+, 16+ and 18+. Films, books, events and websites carry the mark.

examples.description: Not a category of the law

ru.name: Возрастная категория информационной продукции
ru.doc: Знак возрастной категории по Федеральному закону № 436-ФЗ «О защите детей от информации, причиняющей вред их здоровью и развитию». Категории 0+, 6+, 12+, 16+ и 18+.

patterns.name: Russian age rating with its explanation
patterns.doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as the mark in guillemets followed by its explanation, such as «12+» для детей старше 12 лет. The register of film distribution certificates of the Russian Ministry of Culture uses this form.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

patterns.name: Russian age rating as a number
patterns.doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as a bare number without the plus sign (0, 6, 12, 16 or 18), as in the age limit field of the Russian film register. Older film records also contain 14, a category of the classification used before the law; it is not covered.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian age rating with its explanation
doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as the mark in guillemets followed by its explanation, such as «12+» для детей старше 12 лет. The register of film distribution certificates of the Russian Ministry of Culture uses this form.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian age rating as a number
doc: Age category of information products under Federal Law No. 436-FZ written as a bare number without the plus sign (0, 6, 12, 16 or 18), as in the age limit field of the Russian film register. Older film records also contain 14, a category of the classification used before the law; it is not covered.

examples.description: Category of the film classification used before Law No. 436-FZ

name: Russian alcohol retail license number
doc: Number of a license for retail sale of alcoholic products issued by a regional authority. It consists of the two-digit region code, three letters and a seven-digit sequence number, for example "37РАО0000001". The letters РПА and РАО are both seen in regional registers on data.gov.ru.

examples.description: License of a company, Ivanovo region register
License of a company, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug register

ru.name: Номер лицензии на розничную продажу алкогольной продукции
ru.doc: Номер лицензии на розничную продажу алкогольной продукции из кода региона, трёх букв и семизначного порядкового номера.

name: Russian construction or commissioning permit number
doc: Number of a permit for construction or for putting a building into operation in Russia. Datasets on data.gov.ru use two forms - region code, "RU" with the municipality code, sequence number and year ("86-RU86311000-1-2021"), and a shorter form of hyphen-separated numbers ending with the year ("86-09-01-2026"). Some regions use their own forms that the regexp does not cover.

examples.description: Construction permit for a hospital building, Uray
Commissioning permit for a workshop, Sovetsky district

ru.name: Номер разрешения на строительство или ввод объекта в эксплуатацию
ru.doc: Номер разрешения на строительство или на ввод объекта в эксплуатацию.

name: Date period (Russian)
doc: Period between two dates, months or years written in Russian notation, for example "с 01.2025 по 12.2025" or "01.01.2025-31.12.2025". Often used for the period covered by an inspection or a project.

ru.name: Период
ru.doc: Период между двумя датами, месяцами или годами в русской записи.

name: Accounting number of a Russian cultural heritage object (EGROKN)
doc: Accounting number (учётный номер) of an object in the open data of the Russian Unified State Register of Cultural Heritage Objects (ЕГРОКН). It is written as the two-digit code of the federal subject, a hyphen and a sequence number, such as 56-142. The region prefix agrees with the region of the record in 99.99% of 110 000 records. It differs from the fifteen-digit registration number.

ru.name: Учётный номер объекта культурного наследия в ЕГРОКН

name: Registration number of a Russian cultural heritage object (EGROKN)
doc: Fifteen-digit registration number of an object in the Unified State Register of Cultural Heritage Objects of the Peoples of the Russian Federation (ЕГРОКН), kept by the Ministry of Culture. The number has the structure СС ГГ В XXXXXX ППП К: the code of the federal subject (two digits), the last two digits of the year the record was entered (two), the kind of object (one: 1 monument, 2 ensemble, 3 landmark site, 4 archaeological heritage object), a sequence number (six), the component of a composite object (three) and the category of historical and cultural significance (one: 4 local, 5 regional, 6 federal; 7 to 9 for objects on the World Heritage List and especially valuable objects). In the open data of the Ministry the kind and category digits agree with the attributes of the record in 99.7% of 110 000 records.

examples.description: Monument of regional significance in Orenburg Oblast, entered in 2015
Ensemble of regional significance in Krasnodar Krai
Landmark site of regional significance in Tomsk Oblast
Chinese Theatre in Tsarskoye Selo, a monument of federal significance (Wikidata example)
Ensemble of federal significance in Moscow, from data.mos.ru
Accounting number of the register, the datatype ru_egrokn_accounting_number

ru.name: Регистрационный номер объекта культурного наследия в ЕГРОКН
ru.doc: Пятнадцатизначный регистрационный номер объекта в Едином государственном реестре объектов культурного наследия (памятников истории и культуры) народов Российской Федерации со структурой СС ГГ В XXXXXX ППП К. Здесь СС — код субъекта РФ, ГГ — год внесения записи, В — вид объекта, XXXXXX — порядковый номер, ППП — пообъектный состав, К — категория историко-культурного значения.

name: Identifier in the Russian Unified Information Space of Culture (EIPSK)
doc: Numeric identifier of a place, an organization or an event in the Unified Information Space in the Sphere of Culture (ЕИПСК). The open data of the Russian Ministry of Culture about theatres, museums, libraries, cinemas and other institutions uses these identifiers, and place records link to their pages on culture.ru. Places and organizations are numbered separately, so the same number may denote different objects. The identifiers are positive integers; in the open data of the Ministry they have up to five digits. Many other identifiers look the same, so the field name matters more than the value.

ru.name: Идентификатор ЕИПСК
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор места, организации или мероприятия в Едином информационном пространстве в сфере культуры (ЕИПСК).

name: Russian control (supervisory) measure number in ЕРКНМ
doc: Registration number of a control (supervisory) measure, such as a planned inspection, in the Russian Unified Register of Control (Supervisory) Measures (ФГИС ЕРКНМ). It is a 20-digit number, so it has the same form as a budget classification code or a bank account number and is identified by the field name, for example "учетный номер КНМ в системе ФГИС ЕРКНМ".

examples.description: Planned inspection of a federal enterprise, Saint Petersburg
Planned external control of an audit company, Chelyabinsk

ru.name: Учётный номер КНМ в ЕРКНМ
ru.doc: Учётный номер контрольного (надзорного) мероприятия в Едином реестре контрольных (надзорных) мероприятий.

name: ESR railway station code
doc: Six-digit code of a railway station or operating point in the Unified Network Marking (ESR) used by the railways of Russia and other former Soviet countries. The last digit is a check digit.

ru.name: Код ЕСР
ru.doc: Шестизначный код станции или раздельного пункта по Единой сетевой разметке железных дорог.

name: Russian film distribution certificate number
doc: Number of a film distribution certificate (прокатное удостоверение), which the Russian Ministry of Culture issues for showing and distributing a film and records in the federal register of certificates. Current numbers have nine digits, the last two being the year of issue (99.8% of 113 621 records in the open data of the Ministry), and begin with 1 or 2. Older certificates have eight digits, and numbers issued in 1998-2003 may end with the letter Д.

examples.description: Number with the letter Д, issued in 2002
Number of a national film certificate, the datatype ru_national_film_certificate

name: Kind of film in the Russian film registers
doc: Kind of film (вид фильма) in the registers of the Russian Ministry of Culture, such as feature (художественный), documentary (документальный), animated (анимационный) or popular science (научно-популярный). The registers write the values inconsistently, with about sixty variants.

name: State Catalogue of Geographical Names ID (Russia)
doc: Seven-digit registration number of a geographical name in the State Catalogue of Geographical Names (GKGN) kept by Rosreestr.

ru.name: Регистрационный номер в ГКГН
ru.doc: Номер географического названия в Государственном каталоге географических названий.

name: Precision of the creation date of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue
doc: Precision with which the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог) records the creation date of a museum object. The open data of the Ministry of Culture uses the values DAY, MONTH, YEAR, CENTURY and EPOCH.

examples.description: The catalogue writes the values in capitals

ru.name: Точность датировки музейного предмета в Госкаталоге

name: Registration number of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue (Goskatalog)
doc: Registration number of a museum object in the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог), which the Ministry of Culture keeps at goskatalog.ru. In the open data of the Ministry it is an integer of seven or eight digits.

examples.description: Teapot from a tea set in a municipal museum
Number in the museum's book of acquisitions, not the catalogue number

ru.name: Регистрационный номер музейного предмета в Госкаталоге

name: Typology of a museum object in the Russian State Catalogue (Goskatalog)
doc: Typology group of a museum object in the State Catalogue of the Museum Fund of the Russian Federation (Госкаталог). The open data of the Ministry of Culture uses fifteen groups, such as graphic art, painting, sculpture, numismatics, documents, photographs and negatives, rare books and archaeology.

examples.value: предметы прикладного искусства, быта и этнографии

name: State Water Register code (Russia)
doc: Code of a water body in the State Water Register of Russia: 23 digits that encode the hydrographic units it belongs to and the water body.

ru.name: Код водного объекта в ГВР
ru.doc: Код водного объекта в Государственном водном реестре России.

name: Historical dating in Russian
doc: Approximate date of creation of a historical or museum object written in Russian, with a century in Roman numerals, a millennium, a decade or a year and qualifiers such as начало, конец or вторая половина. Registers of cultural heritage and museum objects use this free form, so it has no regular expression.

name: Russian license number in the Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ)
doc: Registration number of a license in the Russian Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ), in the format "ЛNNN-NNNNN-NN/NNNNNNNN". Used by different licensing authorities, for example for private security and for technical protection of confidential information. In the licence registers on the Moscow open data portal (data.mos.ru) the first group depends on the licensed activity (Л035 education, Л041 medical, Л042 pharmaceutical, Л017 narcotic drugs, Л028 scrap metal) and the second group on the licensing authority. Some of these datasets write the separators as en dashes, which the regexp also accepts.

examples.description: Private security license of a company
Licence for educational activity issued in Moscow
The same form written with en dashes, as in some data.mos.ru datasets
Series of a licence blank form, not the registration number

ru.name: Номер лицензии в ЕРУЛ
ru.doc: Регистрационный номер лицензии в Едином реестре учёта лицензий в формате «ЛNNN-NNNNN-NN/NNNNNNNN».

name: Russian license number (ЛО- format)
doc: Number of a license for medical or pharmaceutical activity in the format "ЛО-NN-NN-NNNNNN", issued before the Unified Register of Licenses (ЕРУЛ) numbering. In the license registers published on data.gov.ru the first two digits match the region code of the licensing authority (34 for Volgograd region, 66 for Sverdlovsk region); the second group is 01 in medical activity registers and 02 in pharmaceutical activity registers.

examples.description: Pharmaceutical activity license of a company, Volgograd region register
Medical activity license of an organization, Sverdlovsk region register

ru.name: Номер лицензии (формат ЛО-)
ru.doc: Номер лицензии на медицинскую или фармацевтическую деятельность в формате «ЛО-NN-NN-NNNNNN», который применялся до нумерации Единого реестра учёта лицензий.

name: Russian mass media registration number
doc: Number of the registration certificate, or the register entry, of a mass media outlet in Russia (свидетельство о регистрации СМИ), recorded by Roskomnadzor in the register of registered mass media. It gives the form of the outlet, the registering office and a sequence number. The forms are ПИ for a printed periodical, ЭЛ for an online periodical, a TV or a radio channel, and ИА for a news agency. ФС 77 marks the central office, and ТУ with a region code a territorial office. Spacing, the dash and the case of Эл vary. Certificates of the 1990s and early 2000s may use forms that the regexp does not accept.

ru.name: Регистрационный номер СМИ
ru.doc: Номер свидетельства о регистрации средства массовой информации (записи в реестре зарегистрированных СМИ Роскомнадзора): форма СМИ (ПИ, ЭЛ, ИА), регистрирующий орган (ФС 77 или ТУ и код региона) и порядковый номер.

name: Russian Ministry of Culture license number for heritage preservation
doc: Number of a license for activities to preserve cultural heritage objects, which the Russian Ministry of Culture issued before licenses moved to the Unified Register of Licenses. It is written as МКРФ and five digits, such as МКРФ 24056; duplicates of a license use the same form. Licenses issued later have numbers of the type ru_license_erul.

examples.description: Number in the Unified Register of Licenses, the datatype ru_license_erul

ru.name: Номер лицензии Минкультуры России на сохранение объектов культурного наследия

name: Month name (Russian)
doc: Name of a month in Russian in the nominative case, for example "январь" or "Февраль".

ru.name: Название месяца
ru.doc: Название месяца на русском языке в именительном падеже.

name: Moscow open data portal record identifier (global_id)
doc: Numeric identifier of a record in a dataset of the Moscow open data portal data.mos.ru. Every dataset of the portal has it in the field global_id, and rows of nested tables carry their own global_id. The portal assigns the number; it is not derived from the object that the record describes. In the snapshot of November 2026 the values have 7 to 10 digits, and a few have 12.

examples.description: Record of the dataset "Дома культуры и клубы" (houses of culture and clubs)

ru.name: Идентификатор записи на портале открытых данных Москвы (global_id)
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор записи набора данных на портале data.mos.ru. Есть в поле global_id каждого набора данных портала и во вложенных таблицах. Номер присваивает портал, он не зависит от описываемого объекта.

name: Moscow Metro line name
doc: Name of a line of the Moscow Metro, such as Сокольническая линия, Большая кольцевая линия or Московское центральное кольцо. The Moscow open data portal publishes the list of lines, with their numbers and status, as the dataset "Линии Московского метрополитена".

name: Moscow Metro station name
doc: Name of a station of the Moscow Metro, including the stations of the Moscow Central Circle. Datasets of the Moscow open data portal use it to give the nearest station of an object. The portal publishes the list of stations, with their lines, as the dataset "Станции Московского метрополитена".

name: Moscow address register object number (UNOM)
doc: Number of an addressed object (a building or a structure) in the Address register of real estate objects of Moscow. Datasets of the Moscow open data portal publish it in the field UNOM, labelled "Код адреса по АР" or "УНОМ", to link their records to buildings, and the register itself is published there as a dataset. Values are positive integers of up to 7 digits.

examples.description: Cadastral number of a building, not a UNOM

ru.name: Уникальный номер объекта адресации в Адресном реестре Москвы (УНОМ)
ru.doc: Номер объекта адресации (здания, сооружения) в Адресном реестре объектов недвижимости города Москвы. В наборах данных портала data.mos.ru публикуется в поле UNOM и связывает записи со зданиями.

name: Russian national film certificate number
doc: Number of a national film certificate (удостоверение национального фильма), which the Russian Ministry of Culture issues to confirm that a film is a national film. The numbers are sequential integers, such as 37343; in the open data of the Ministry they have up to six digits. Many other numbers look the same, so the field name matters more than the value.

examples.description: Number of a distribution certificate, the datatype ru_film_distribution_certificate

name: Category of historical and cultural significance of a Russian heritage object
doc: Category of historical and cultural significance of a cultural heritage object under Article 4 of Federal Law No. 73-FZ. An object is of federal, regional or local (municipal) significance. The register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН) writes the categories as Федерального значения, Регионального значения and Местного (муниципального) значения.

examples.description: Not a category of Law No. 73-FZ

ru.name: Категория историко-культурного значения объекта культурного наследия

name: Kind of a Russian cultural heritage object
doc: Kind of a cultural heritage object under Article 3 of Federal Law No. 73-FZ on cultural heritage objects. The law distinguishes monuments (памятник), ensembles (ансамбль) and landmark sites (достопримечательное место). The register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН) records the kind of each object.

examples.description: Typology of the object, the datatype ru_okn_typology

name: Typology of a Russian cultural heritage object
doc: General typology (общая видовая принадлежность) of a cultural heritage object in the register of cultural heritage objects (ЕГРОКН), such as a monument of archaeology, of history, of urban planning and architecture, or of monumental art. An object can have several typologies.

ru.name: Общая видовая принадлежность объекта культурного наследия

name: Opening hours (Russian)
doc: Opening hours written in Russian free text, as published in data.gov.ru datasets in columns such as "режим работы", "график работы" and "часы приема".

examples.value: Понедельник-четверг с 8-00 до 17-00; Пятница с 8-00 до 16-00
examples.description: Weekly schedule with a shorter Friday

examples.value: с 8-00 до 17-00 перерыв на обед с 12-00 до 13-00
examples.description: Daily hours with a lunch break

ru.name: Режим работы
ru.doc: Режим или график работы, записанный на русском языке.

name: Organizational unit name (Russian)
doc: Name of a structural unit of an organization in Russian, for example a department of a government body. Published in data.gov.ru datasets in columns such as "отдел", "структурное подразделение" and "dep".

examples.description: Revenue department of a treasury office

ru.name: Структурное подразделение
ru.doc: Наименование структурного подразделения организации на русском языке.

name: Russian auditor registration number (ОРНЗ)
doc: Main registration number of an entry (ОРНЗ) in the Russian register of auditors and audit organizations. It is an 11-digit number; datasets often publish it together with the OGRN as "ОГРН / ОРНЗ". The form overlaps with other 11-digit codes, so the field name is needed to identify it.

examples.description: Audit company in a federal treasury control dataset
Audit and consulting company in a federal treasury control dataset

ru.name: ОРНЗ
ru.doc: Основной регистрационный номер записи в реестре аудиторов и аудиторских организаций.

name: Quarter of the year (Russian)
doc: Calendar quarter written in Russian with an Arabic or Roman number, optionally followed by the year, for example "1 квартал" or "II квартал 2026 года".

ru.name: Квартал
ru.doc: Квартал года в русской записи.

name: Russian subsoil use license number
doc: Number of a license for the use of subsoil in Russia. It consists of a three-letter series, a five- or six-digit number and a two-letter license type, separated by spaces, for example "ВЛГ 90001 ТЭ".

examples.description: Clay exploration and mining license of a company, Volgograd region
Sand mining license of a company, Khanty-Mansi Autonomous Okrug

ru.name: Номер лицензии на пользование недрами
ru.doc: Номер лицензии на пользование недрами из серии (три буквы), номера и вида лицензии (две буквы).

name: Russian vehicle license plate by field name
doc: Russian vehicle license plate by field name

examples.description: Format of a passenger car plate (letter, three digits, two letters, region code)
Format of a trailer plate (two letters, four digits, region code)
Ж is not used on Russian plates

name: Month and year (Russian)
doc: Month written as a Russian month name followed by a year, optionally with "года" or "г.", for example "Февраль 2027 года" or "январь 2013".

ru.name: Месяц и год
ru.doc: Месяц и год в русской записи.

name: RubyGems API key
doc: API key of RubyGems.org, used by the gem CLI to push and manage gems, for example through the GEM_HOST_API_KEY environment variable: rubygems_ followed by 48 hexadecimal digits.

name: Company/business name in Russian
doc: Russian written company/business name

name: Russian driver's license number
doc: Russian driver's license number (Водительское удостоверение). Format: series (2 digits) + number (6 digits), separated by space

ru.name: Водительское удостоверение
ru.doc: Номер водительского удостоверения Российской Федерации

name: State registration number of the issue of equity securities (Russia)
doc: State registration number of the issue of equity securities (Russia) has 9 symbols

ru.name: Государственный регистрационный номер выпуска эмиссионных ценных бумаг
ru.doc: Государственный регистрационный номер - цифровой (буквенный, знаковый) код, идентифицирующий конкретный выпуск эмиссионных ценных бумаг, - состоит из девяти разрядов.

name: Russian FIAS address identifier
doc: Federal Information Address System (FIAS) identifier - unique GUID assigned to each address object in Russia

ru.name: Идентификатор ФИАС
ru.doc: Идентификатор Федеральной информационной адресной системы (ФИАС) - уникальный GUID, присваиваемый каждому адресному объекту в России

name: Russian government customers unique code
doc: Unique code assigned to all government customers in Russian Federation

ru.name: Идентификационный код заказчика
ru.doc: Код присваиваемый государственным заказчикам в Российской Федерации

name: Russian government procurement unique id
doc: Unique id assigned to all government procurement procedures in Russian Federation

ru.name: Идентификационный код закупки
ru.doc: Код присваиваемый государственным закупкам в Российской Федерации

name: Russian internal passport number
doc: Number of Russian internal passport

name: Russian land registry number
doc: Russian land registry number (kadastroviy nomer, cadaster number) assigned to each land, territory, building and other geographic administrative objects by Rosreestr

examples.description: Building in Moscow (cadastral district 77), from the data.mos.ru open data
Land plot in the Moscow region (cadastral district 50)
Number of a cadastral quarter, without the number of the object

ru.name: Кадастровый номер
ru.doc: Кадастровый номер — уникальный номер объекта недвижимости, присваиваемый ему при осуществлении кадастрового и технического учёта.

name: Registration code of medicine (Russian)
doc: Russian medicine registration code

ru.name: Код регистрации лекарственного средства в России
ru.doc: Код регистрации лекарственного средства в России. Реестр Росздравнадзора

name: Medicine trade name (Russian)
doc: Trade name of the medicine in Russian.

ru.name: Торговое наименование лекарственного средства

name: S2 cell token
doc: Token of a cell of the S2 Geometry library, which projects the sphere onto the six faces of a cube and divides each face into a hierarchy of cells along a Hilbert curve. The token is the 64-bit cell id in lowercase hexadecimal with the trailing zeros removed, so larger cells have shorter tokens, up to 16 characters. The top three bits hold the cube face (0 to 5), so a token begins with 0-9, a or b and does not end in 0; the id 0 is written X. The regexp only checks this shape, so it also matches other short hexadecimal strings.

name: Signed certificate timestamp (SCT)
doc: Signed certificate timestamp (SCT) of Certificate Transparency (RFC 6962): a log's signed promise to add a certificate to its public Merkle tree within the maximum merge delay. SCTs are embedded in certificates, sent in a TLS extension or stapled to OCSP responses. In data an SCT is usually the Base64 encoding of its binary form. A version 1 SCT starts with a zero byte, so its Base64 starts with A; the regexp also requires the length of a 32-byte log ID, a timestamp and a signature.

A digit after the letter means every n periods (A5 every five years, W2 every two weeks), an underscore and a digit mean n times per period (M_2 twice a month), OA and OM are occasional annual and monthly, and _O, _U and _Z mean other, unspecified and not applicable.

name: SDMX reporting time period

Periods count from the start of the reporting year, 1 January unless a reporting year start day is given, and the year is the year in which the reporting year begins. The SDMX time period (TIME_PERIOD) may also hold Gregorian values such as 2024, 2024-01 or 2024-01-15, date-times and time ranges; those are the datatypes year, yearmonth, date and datetime.
