name: Code SIRET par nom de champ
doc: FR datatype for 'Code SIRET par nom de champ' (siret) from rules in context 'finances'. The SIRET (Système d'Identification du Répertoire des Établissements) is a unique 14-digit identifier assigned to each business establishment in France. It consists of two parts: the first 9 digits are the SIREN number (identifying the legal entity or company), and the last 5 digits are the NIC (Numéro Interne de Classement), where the first 4 digits identify the specific establishment and the last digit is a check digit calculated using the Luhn algorithm. The SIRET number is used for official identification and registration of business establishments in France.

doc: Slovak personal number (rodné číslo): the date of birth (YYMMDD), an optional slash and three digits; numbers issued since 1954 have a fourth, check digit.

name: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) by known name
doc: SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) by known name identifier

name: Skype username
doc: Person username in Skype

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

name: Sierra Leonean business registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, business name or other entity at the Office of the Administrator and Registrar General of Sierra Leone. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as SL-OARG; with that prefix an identifier reads SL-OARG-CF-218-2018.

name: Slack token
doc: Access token of the Slack API. The prefix names the token type, for example xoxb- for bot tokens and xoxp- for user tokens.

name: Slack incoming webhook URL
doc: URL of a Slack incoming webhook or workflow trigger on hooks.slack.com. Anyone who knows the URL can post messages to the channel, so the URL itself is the secret.

name: San Marino postal code
doc: Postal code in San Marino: five digits from 47890 to 47899. San Marino is part of the Italian postal code system.

name: SMILES chemical notation
doc: Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System (SMILES): a line notation that writes the structure of a molecule as a short ASCII string. Atoms are written by their element symbols, double and triple bonds by = and #, branches in parentheses and ring closures by digits; lowercase letters mark aromatic atoms. One molecule has many valid SMILES strings. Canonical SMILES picks one of them, and isomeric SMILES also records stereochemistry and isotopes. PubChem and Wikidata publish both forms. The record has no regexp: the SMILES character set also matches ordinary words, so a chemistry parser such as RDKit or Open Babel is needed to check a value.

ru.name: Нотация SMILES
ru.doc: Строковая запись структуры молекулы (Simplified Molecular-Input Line-Entry System): атомы, связи, ветви и циклы записываются ASCII-символами.

name: SMPTE timecode
doc: Position in a video or audio recording as hours, minutes, seconds and frames (HH:MM:SS:FF), as defined by the SMPTE 12M standard and used in editing, subtitles and broadcast logs. Drop-frame timecode, used with 29.97 frames per second, puts a semicolon before the frames, as in 01:00:03;18. The highest frame number depends on the frame rate, so the regexp accepts 00 to 59.

ru.name: Тайм-код SMPTE
ru.doc: Позиция в видео- или аудиозаписи в часах, минутах, секундах и кадрах (ЧЧ:ММ:СС:КК) по стандарту SMPTE 12M.

name: Senegalese national identification number of companies and associations (NINEA)
doc: Numéro d'identification national des entreprises et des associations (NINEA), the national identification number of companies and associations in Senegal. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as SN-NINEA; with that prefix an identifier reads SN-NINEA-006478110.

name: Senegal postal code
doc: Postal code in Senegal: five digits.

name: SNOMED CT concept code
doc: Identifier of a concept in SNOMED CT, the clinical terminology of SNOMED International: a number of 6 to 18 digits whose last digit is a Verhoeff check digit.

name: Snowflake ID
doc: 64-bit identifier scheme that Twitter introduced in 2010 and that X, Discord, Instagram, Mastodon and other services use, each with its own epoch and bit layout. In the Twitter form the highest bit is 0, then come 41 bits of milliseconds since the epoch 1288834974657 (4 November 2010), 10 bits of machine ID and a 12-bit sequence number, so IDs sort by creation time. Discord uses the same layout with the epoch 1420070400000 (1 January 2015). Values are written as decimal numbers, today of 18 or 19 digits, and APIs often send them as strings because JavaScript numbers cannot hold 64-bit integers exactly. Any large integer looks the same, so there is no regexp; detect Snowflake IDs by field name.

examples.description: Tweet ID from the Wikipedia article, created 2025-02-10 13:34:39.256 UTC

ru.name: Идентификатор Snowflake
ru.doc: 64-битный идентификатор, введённый Twitter. Он состоит из метки времени в миллисекундах, номера машины и порядкового номера. Его используют X, Discord, Instagram, Mastodon и другие сервисы.

name: Somaliland NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation in the General Register for Non-Governmental Organizations of the Ministry of Planning and National Development of Somaliland. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as SO-MPND; with that prefix an identifier reads SO-MPND-L43135002018MJ.

name: Somalia postal code
doc: Postal code in Somalia: two letters and five digits, optionally separated by a space.

name: Software license by field name
doc: Name or identifier of the license of a software package, usually written as a short SPDX license identifier such as MIT or Apache-2.0. The SPDX License List, maintained by the Linux Foundation's SPDX project, assigns these identifiers to common open source licenses. Package metadata, software bills of materials and code hosting sites use them. Values are recognised by field name and by membership in the SPDX list, not by a regular expression.

examples.description: GNU General Public License v3.0 or later

name: Solana address
doc: Address of a Solana account or program: a 32-byte Ed25519 public key or program derived address, written in Base58 with the Bitcoin alphabet in 32 to 44 characters. It has no checksum and no prefix, so other Base58 values of that length match too: rely on the field name or context.

name: SonarQube token
doc: Token of SonarQube Server used to run an analysis or call the web API instead of a login and password. Current tokens start with one of the prefixes squ_, sqa_ and sqp_, which depend on the token type (user, global analysis or project analysis token), followed by 40 characters. Older tokens without a prefix are not covered by the regexp.

name: Species
doc: Name of a biological species, either its scientific name, such as Panthera leo, or a common name, such as lion. Typical columns are in biodiversity observations, fishery and forestry statistics, and in machine learning datasets such as Iris. The animal record covers common names of animals.

examples.description: class label in the UCI Iris dataset

name: Spotify album ID
doc: Spotify ID of an album or single, as in open.spotify.com/album/<id> and spotify:album:<id>: 22 letters and digits in base 62.

examples.description: The Dark Side of the Moon

name: Spotify artist ID
doc: Spotify ID of an artist, as in open.spotify.com/artist/<id> and spotify:artist:<id>: 22 letters and digits in base 62.

name: Spotify ID
doc: Base-62 identifier of a Spotify resource, such as an artist, album, track, playlist, show or episode: 22 letters and digits. It is the last part of a Spotify URI (spotify_uri) and of an open.spotify.com address. The ID does not tell the kind of resource; the records spotify_artist_id, spotify_album_id and spotify_track_id name one kind.

examples.description: Track ID from the Spotify Web API documentation

name: Spotify track ID
doc: Spotify ID of a track, as in open.spotify.com/track/<id> and spotify:track:<id>: 22 letters and digits in base 62.

examples.description: Example of the Spotify Web API documentation

name: Spotify URI
doc: Resource identifier of the Spotify app and Web API: spotify:, the kind of resource (artist, album, track, playlist, show or episode), a colon and the 22-character Spotify ID (spotify_id). The Spotify app opens such URIs directly.

examples.description: Example of the Spotify Web API documentation
Web address of the same track

name: Square access token
doc: Personal or OAuth access token of the Square APIs. Square does not document the format; secret scanners such as gitleaks recognize it by the prefix EAAA or the older prefix sq0atp- followed by 22 to 60 letters, digits, underscores or hyphens.

name: Square OAuth application secret
doc: Application secret of a Square developer application, which the application uses to exchange OAuth authorization codes for access tokens. It starts with sq0csp- followed by 43 characters. It is a different credential from a Square access token. Examples are left out because GitHub push protection rejects token-shaped values, even constructed ones.

name: Sequence Read Archive accession (SRA, ENA, DDBJ)
doc: Accession of an object in the sequence read archives of NCBI (SRA), EMBL-EBI (ENA) and DDBJ, which store raw data from high-throughput sequencing. The first letter is S, E or D after the archive that issued it, the second is R, and the third gives the kind of object, for example X for an experiment, R for a run and S for a sample. Digits follow. Studies and samples also have BioProject and BioSample accessions, which are separate datatypes.

examples.description: 454 sequencing of a paired-end library of HapMap individual NA18505 (experiment); Bioregistry example
A sequencing run of that experiment
ENA sample accession of BioSample SAMEA2397676
BioSample accession, not a read archive accession

name: Subresource Integrity (SRI) hash
doc: Integrity metadata of W3C Subresource Integrity, as written in the integrity attribute of HTML script and link elements: the hash algorithm (sha256, sha384 or sha512), a hyphen and the Base64 digest of the resource. An integrity attribute may hold several such values separated by spaces; the regexp matches one.

examples.description: Example of the W3C specification: digest of the script alert('Hello, world.');
SHA-256 integrity value of the same script

name: SSDEEP hash
doc: CTPH hash of the file content.

name: SSH key fingerprint
doc: Fingerprint of an SSH public key, as printed by ssh-keygen -l and shown when a client first connects to a host: SHA256: and 43 characters of unpadded Base64 (the default since OpenSSH 6.8), or the legacy MD5 form of 16 colon-separated hexadecimal octets, optionally after MD5:.

examples.description: Fingerprint of the Ed25519 host key of github.com
Fingerprint of the RSA host key of github.com
Legacy MD5 fingerprint of the Ed25519 host key of github.com (ssh-keygen -E md5)
SHA-1 fingerprint of an X.509 certificate (20 octets)

name: SSH public key (OpenSSH format)
doc: Public key in the one-line OpenSSH format of authorized_keys and known_hosts files: the key type (ssh-ed25519, ecdsa-sha2-nistp256, ssh-rsa and others), a space, the Base64 of the RFC 4253 key blob and an optional comment, often user@host. The multi-line RFC 4716 format (---- BEGIN SSH2 PUBLIC KEY ----) and authorized_keys options before the key type are not covered.

examples.description: Ed25519 host key of github.com, published by GitHub
ECDSA host key of github.com, published by GitHub
Fingerprint of the Ed25519 key, not the key

name: US Social Security Number
doc: In the United States, a Social Security number (SSN) is a nine-digit number issued to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents under section 205(c)(2) of the Social Security Act, codified as 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2)

name: Serial shipping container code
doc: Serial Shipping Container Code (SSCC) written as a GS1 element string with Application Identifier (00): '00' followed by the 18 digits of the SSCC. The SSCC identifies one logistic unit, such as a pallet or a parcel, for its whole journey through the supply chain; it is an extension digit, a GS1 Company Prefix, a serial reference and a GS1 check digit. It is usually printed in a GS1-128 barcode on the logistic label or stored in an RFID tag.

examples.description: Synthetic value with the GS1 demonstration prefix 952 and a valid check digit
Synthetic value with the GS1 demonstration prefix 952, extension digit 1
Last digit changed: fails the GS1 check digit

name: Indian state by known name
doc: Indian state by known name identifier

name: Steam application ID (App ID)
doc: Numeric identifier (App ID) of a game, demo, soundtrack, software or other product on the Steam platform of Valve, as in store.steampowered.com/app/<id> and the Steamworks API.

name: German tax identification number (Steuer-ID, IdNr.)
doc: Steuerliche Identifikationsnummer (IdNr., Steuer-ID), the personal tax number that the Federal Central Tax Office (BZSt) assigns once to every person registered in Germany and that stays the same for life. It has 11 digits that are chosen at random and hold no personal data. The first digit is never 0; in the first ten digits one digit occurs twice (since 2016 also three times, never three in a row) and the others at most once. The last digit is an ISO 7064 MOD 11,10 check digit. It is often printed in groups, as in 36 574 261 809. It is not the Steuernummer that a tax office gives.

examples.description: The same number in its printed form
Synthetic number with a valid check digit

ru.name: Налоговый идентификационный номер Германии (Steuer-ID)
ru.doc: Пожизненный личный налоговый номер, который Федеральное центральное налоговое ведомство (BZSt) присваивает каждому зарегистрированному в Германии человеку, - 11 случайных цифр, последняя из которых контрольная (ISO 7064 MOD 11,10).

name: Streebog-256 hash (GOST R 34.11-2012)
doc: Digest of Streebog, the hash function of the Russian standard GOST R 34.11-2012 (also RFC 6986), with a 256-bit output. It is written as 64 hexadecimal digits. The standard and RFC 6986 print digests in reverse byte order, while libraries such as gostcrypto and the Wikipedia article print them in byte order, as the examples here do. Other 256-bit digests (SHA-256, SHA3-256, Keccak-256, BLAKE2b-256 and BLAKE3) have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: Streebog-256 hash of the empty string
Streebog-256 hash of the RFC 6986 Example 1 message (63 digits 0123456789012...), in byte order
one hex digit short (63 instead of 64)

ru.name: Хеш Стрибог-256 (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012)
ru.doc: Значение хеш-функции «Стрибог» по ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012 (RFC 6986) длиной 256 бит, записанное 64 шестнадцатеричными цифрами. Стандарт и RFC 6986 печатают значение в обратном порядке байтов, а библиотеки обычно в прямом.

name: Streebog-512 hash (GOST R 34.11-2012)
doc: Digest of Streebog, the hash function of the Russian standard GOST R 34.11-2012 (also RFC 6986), with a 512-bit output. It is written as 128 hexadecimal digits. The standard and RFC 6986 print digests in reverse byte order, while libraries such as gostcrypto and the Wikipedia article print them in byte order, as the examples here do. Other 512-bit digests (SHA-512, SHA3-512, Keccak-512 and BLAKE2b-512) have the same length, so the value alone does not tell them apart: use the field name or context.

examples.description: Streebog-512 hash of the empty string
Streebog-512 hash of the RFC 6986 Example 1 message (63 digits 0123456789012...), in byte order
one hex digit short (127 instead of 128)

ru.name: Хеш Стрибог-512 (ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012)
ru.doc: Значение хеш-функции «Стрибог» по ГОСТ Р 34.11-2012 (RFC 6986) длиной 512 бит, записанное 128 шестнадцатеричными цифрами. Стандарт и RFC 6986 печатают значение в обратном порядке байтов, а библиотеки обычно в прямом.

name: Street
doc: Name of the street, commonly used in address

patterns.name: Street name (Russian)
patterns.doc: Street name writtern in Russian language

name: Street address line
doc: First line of a postal address: the house or building number and the street name, such as 10 Downing Street or Unter den Linden 77. The full address with the city and postal code is the datatype address, and the street name alone is street.

name: Street suffix (street type)
doc: Word or abbreviation after a street name that tells the type of the street, such as Street (St), Avenue (Ave), Road (Rd) or Boulevard (Blvd). The US Postal Service publishes the standard abbreviations.

name: Stripe secret or restricted API key
doc: Server-side API key of Stripe. Secret keys start with sk_ and restricted keys with rk_, followed by test_ for a sandbox or live_ for live mode. Publishable keys (pk_) are meant to be public and are not covered.

name: Student identifier
doc: Datatype for 'Student identifier' (studentid) from rules in context 'education'.

name: Subscription Permanent Identifier (SUPI) of a 5G network
doc: Permanent identifier of a subscriber in a 5G core network (3GPP TS 23.003). The service APIs of the 5G core (3GPP TS 29.571) write it as a string with a type prefix, imsi- followed by an IMSI or nai- followed by a network access identifier; gci- and gli- mark identifiers of wireline access. In radio signalling the SUPI is sent only in concealed form (SUCI).

examples.description: A bare IMSI without the type prefix

ru.name: Постоянный идентификатор подписки (SUPI) в сети 5G
ru.doc: Постоянный идентификатор абонента в ядре сети 5G (3GPP TS 23.003). В сервисных API ядра 5G (3GPP TS 29.571) записывается строкой с префиксом типа — imsi- и IMSI или nai- и сетевой идентификатор доступа. По радиоканалу передаётся только в скрытом виде (SUCI).

name: Surgical procedure
doc: Name of a surgical operation, for example appendectomy.

name: Salvadoran tax identification number (NIT)
doc: Número de Identificación Tributaria (NIT), the tax identification number of taxpayers in El Salvador. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as SV-NIT; with that prefix an identifier reads SV-NIT-0614-030915-112-5.

name: El Salvador postal code
doc: Postal code in El Salvador: four digits; the first is 1 to 3, the second 1 to 7 and the third 0 to 2.

name: Bank SWIFT code (ISO 9362)
doc: ISO 9362 defines a standard format of Business Identifier Codes (also known as SWIFT-BIC, BIC, SWIFT ID or SWIFT code) approved by the International Organization for Standardization (ISO).

name: Symmetric secret key
doc: Secret key of a symmetric algorithm or a shared access key, usually written in Base64 or hexadecimal, for example a 256-bit key as 43 Base64 characters and an equals sign.

purview: Azure Cosmos DB account access key
Azure Shared Access key / Web Hook token

name: Eswatini company registration number
doc: Registration number of a company or other entity at the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Trade of Eswatini. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as SZ-CIT; with that prefix an identifier reads SZ-CIT-201710132021804.

name: Eswatini postal code
doc: Postal code in Eswatini: a letter (H, L, M or S) and three digits.

name: Tag URI
doc: Unique identifier in the tag URI scheme defined by RFC 4151. It has the form tag:<authority>,<date>:<specific>. The authority is a domain name or an email address that the issuer controlled on the given date. The date is written as YYYY, YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD. Anyone who holds a domain name or email address can mint tags without central registration. YAML uses tag URIs to name its data types.

examples.description: YAML core schema tag for strings

ru.name: Tag URI
ru.doc: Уникальный идентификатор схемы tag (RFC 4151) вида tag:<домен или email>,<дата>:<строка>.

name: Chinese tax ID (统一社会信用代码) by known name
doc: Chinese tax ID (统一社会信用代码) by known name identifier

name: TED notice id
doc: EU datatype for 'TED notice id' (tednoticeid) from rules in context 'government'. The TED (Tenders Electronic Daily) notice ID is a unique identifier assigned to procurement notices published in the Tenders Electronic Daily database, which is the online version of the Supplement to the Official Journal of the European Union. The identifier format consists of a 4-digit year followed by a hyphen and then 1 to 8 digits representing the notice number within that year.

TED notice ID with 4-digit year and 7-digit notice number

name: Telephone number as a tel URI
doc: Telephone number written as a URI of the tel scheme (RFC 3966), as in HTML links, vCards and SIP messages. A global number starts with a plus sign and may contain hyphens, dots and parentheses as visual separators; a local number needs a phone-context parameter. Other parameters, such as ext for an extension, follow after semicolons.

examples.description: Local number with a domain as its context (RFC 3966)
Local number with a number prefix as its context (RFC 3966)
A SIP URI, not a tel URI

ru.name: Номер телефона в виде tel URI
ru.doc: Номер телефона, записанный как URI схемы tel (RFC 3966), например в HTML-ссылках, vCard и сообщениях SIP. Глобальный номер начинается со знака плюс и может содержать дефисы, точки и скобки; для локального номера нужен параметр phone-context.

name: Telegram bot token
doc: Token that authorizes a bot in the Telegram Bot API: the numeric bot ID, a colon and a secret that starts with A. Telegram documents the format only by example, so the regexp accepts the length of the documented samples (34 characters after the colon) and the length that the gitleaks secret scanner checks (35).

name: Temperature
doc: A measured or set temperature, such as an air, water or body temperature reading. Datasets store it as a number in degrees Celsius, degrees Fahrenheit or kelvins, with the unit either in the value or in the column name or metadata. The regular expression recognizes only values that carry a unit symbol. Semantic MediaWiki has a Temperature datatype that accepts K, °C, °F and °R and stores values in kelvins.

name: HashiCorp Terraform Cloud API token
doc: User or organization API token of HashiCorp Terraform Cloud: 14 letters and digits, the marker .atlasv1. and 60 to 70 more letters, digits and the characters _ - =.

name: Togolese NGO registration number

name: Togolese tax identification number (NIF)

name: Thai company registration number (MOA number)
doc: Registration number that the Department of Business Development (DBD) of Thailand gives to a juristic person, also called the Memorandum of Association number; it is also the company's taxpayer identification number. It has 13 digits and always starts with 0 to show that the DBD issued it; the last digit is a check digit computed as for the personal number. It is written grouped as 0-99-4-000-61772-1.

name: Time
doc: Time of the day, like 12:00 or 10PM or 11:05 or 18:01:27

name: Time range
doc: Interval between two points of time, like 8:00-21:00 or 8:00AM-1:00PM.

name: Timespan
doc: The TimeSpan structure represents a length of time (duration of time or elapsed time), and may be expressed as start/end, start/duration, or duration/end. Start, end, and duration are documented using the designated DateTime structures. Examples: start/end 2018-02-22T13:0

patterns.name: Date period (Russian)
patterns.doc: Period between two dates, months or years written in Russian notation, for example "с 01.2025 по 12.2025" or "01.01.2025-31.12.2025". Often used for the period covered by an inspection or a project.

ru.doc: Период между двумя датами, месяцами или годами в русской записи.

name: Time zone
doc: A time zone is an area that observes a uniform standard time for legal, commercial and social purposes

patterns.name: IANA Timezone ID
patterns.doc: Time zone identifier from the IANA time zone database (tz database), in Area/Location form, for example Europe/London.

patterns.name: UTC Timezone offset

name: Tajik taxpayer identification number (INN)
doc: Taxpayer identification number (ИНН) of taxpayers in Tajikistan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as TJ-TIN; with that prefix an identifier reads TJ-TIN-020025789.

name: Tajikistan postal code
doc: Postal code in Tajikistan: six digits.

name: Top level domain (TLD)
doc: Last label of a domain name, the level directly below the DNS root, such as com, org, ru or de. Country-code TLDs have two letters and mostly follow ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes; generic TLDs such as com, info or app are longer. Internationalized TLDs are stored in Punycode form starting with xn--, such as xn--p1ai for .рф. IANA lists the delegated TLDs in the Root Zone Database. Data often writes a TLD with a leading dot, which the regexp allows; the regexp checks the form, not whether the TLD is delegated.

ru.name: Домен верхнего уровня (TLD)
ru.doc: Последняя метка доменного имени, например com, org или ru; национальные домены состоят из двух букв.

name: TLSH hash
doc: tlsh is a hash used by Trend Micro which can be used for similarity comparisons.

name: Turkmenistan postal code
doc: Postal code in Turkmenistan: six digits.

name: TMDB movie ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a film in The Movie Database (TMDB), as in themoviedb.org/movie/<id> and the TMDB API. Films, TV series and people are numbered separately, so the field name matters. The MovieLens datasets give it in the tmdbId column.

name: TMDB TV series ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a television series in The Movie Database (TMDB), as in themoviedb.org/tv/<id> and the TMDB API. TV series are numbered apart from films (tmdb_movie_id), so the field name matters.

name: Tunisian tax identification number (Matricule Fiscal)
doc: Matricule Fiscal, the tax number of taxpayers in Tunisia. The full form has four parts, often separated by slashes: the fiscal identifier (seven digits and a control letter other than I, O and U), the VAT code (A, P, B, D or N), the category code (M, P, C, N or E) and a three-digit number of the secondary establishment, 000 for the main one. Wikidata calls it the GUI number assigned by the Ministry of Economic Affairs, whose business register (findbiz) can be searched by it. doc: String identifier (SID) of a Twilio API key: SK followed by 32 hexadecimal digits. The SID is used together with the API key secret as the user name and password of Twilio API requests, so a SID in code or data usually means that the secret is nearby.

name: Type Allocation Code (TAC) of a mobile device
doc: The first eight digits of an IMEI or IMEISV, which identify the make and model of a mobile device. Reporting bodies approved by the GSMA allocate TACs to manufacturers; the first two digits are the Reporting Body Identifier. Before 2003 this part of the IMEI was a six-digit type approval code followed by a two-digit final assembly code. Device databases keyed by TAC are used to resolve the model of an IMEI.

ru.name: Код типа устройства (TAC)
ru.doc: Первые восемь цифр IMEI или IMEISV, которые определяют производителя и модель мобильного устройства. Коды выделяют производителям уполномоченные GSMA организации; первые две цифры — идентификатор такой организации (Reporting Body Identifier).

name: TypeID (type-prefixed UUIDv7)
doc: Identifier from the TypeID specification of Jetify, a UUIDv7 with a type prefix. It has the form <prefix>_<suffix>. The prefix names the kind of object, such as user, in up to 63 lowercase letters and underscores that start and end with a letter, and it may be left out together with the underscore. The suffix is the 128-bit UUID in 26 characters of lowercase Crockford Base32; its first character is 0 to 7. New TypeIDs carry a UUIDv7, so they sort by creation time.

name: UCUM unit code
doc: Case-sensitive code of a unit in the Unified Code for Units of Measure (UCUM), built from unit atoms, prefixes and operators, for example kg, m/s, Cel or mm[Hg]. HL7 FHIR and LOINC use it for clinical and laboratory results.

name: Universal Decimal Classification (UDC)
doc: The Universal Decimal Classification (UDC) is a bibliographic and library classification representing the systematic arrangement of all branches of human knowledge organized as a coherent system in which knowledge fields are related and inter-linked.

ru.name: Индекс УДК (универсальная десятичная классификация)
ru.doc: Универсальная десятичная классификация — система классификации информации, широко используется во всём мире для систематизации произведений науки, литературы и искусства, периодической печати, различных видов документов и организации картотек.

doc: Registration number of a community-based organisation in Jinja District, Uganda. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-204CBO; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-204CBO-JJA02202000348.

name: Ugandan NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the National Bureau for NGOs of Uganda. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-NGO; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-NGO-INDR160665542NB.

name: Ugandan URSB registration number
doc: Registration number of a company, business name or other entity at the Uganda Registration Services Bureau (URSB). ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UG-RSB; with that prefix an identifier reads UG-RSB-80010001803086.

name: UIC wagon number (European Vehicle Number)
doc: Twelve-digit number of a railway vehicle, such as a freight wagon, coach or locomotive, in the numbering system of the International Union of Railways (UIC), now the European Vehicle Number (EVN). Digits 1-2 give the vehicle type and interoperability, digits 3-4 the country of registration (before 2006, the owning railway), digits 5-8 the type of vehicle and digits 9-11 the serial number. Digit 12 is a check digit computed with the Luhn algorithm. On the vehicle the groups are separated by spaces and the check digit by a hyphen. Not to be confused with the UIC station code (uiccode).

name: UIC station code

name: BNF code
doc: The British National Formulary (BNF) is a reference book containing the standard list of medicines used in UK prescribing. It gives information on the indications, dosages and side effects for over 70,000 medicines.

name: Borough code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK borough code identifying a borough, a type of local government administrative division within the United Kingdom.

name: District code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK district code identifying a district, a level of subnational division used for local government within the United Kingdom.

name: UK driver license number
doc: In the United Kingdom, a driving licence is the official document which authorises its holder to operate motor vehicles on highways and other public roads.

name: Education establishment number (United Kingdom)
doc: UK establishment number, an identifier assigned to schools and other education establishments in the United Kingdom (for example the DfE establishment/URN codes).

name: GSS code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK GSS (Government Statistical Service) code, the nine-character geographic code used by the Office for National Statistics to identify administrative and statistical geographies across the United Kingdom.

name: Local Authority code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK Local Authority (LA) code identifying a local authority, the administrative body responsible for local government within a defined area of the United Kingdom.

name: Middle Layer Super Output Area code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK Middle Layer Super Output Area (MSOA) code, a geography used by the Office for National Statistics for the reporting of small-area statistics.

name: UK NHS Number
doc: NHS numbers are the unique numbers allocated to registered users of the three public health services in England, Wales and the Isle of Man; the three health systems use a shared numbering scheme.

name: UK National Insurance number
doc: The National Insurance number is a number used in the United Kingdom in the administration of the National Insurance or social security system. It is also used for some purposes in the UK tax system.

name: ONS code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK ONS code, a geographic code assigned by the Office for National Statistics under the older ONS coding system for administrative and statistical geographies.

name: Parish code (United Kingdom)
doc: UK parish code identifying a civil parish, the lowest tier of local government in England.

name: UK Postal code
doc: Postal codes used in the United Kingdom, British Overseas Territories and Crown dependencies are known as postcodes (originally, postal codes).

name: UK provider UKPRN

doc: A UTR (unique taxpayer reference) number is a 10-digit number completely unique to each and every UK taxpayer.

name: Ward code (United Kingdom)
doc: Official code of a ward or electoral division in the United Kingdom: the electoral district represented by one or more councillors.

name: Ward name (United Kingdom)
doc: Name of a ward or electoral division in the United Kingdom: the electoral district represented by one or more councillors. The code is ukwardcode.

name: ULID (Universally Unique Lexicographically Sortable Identifier)
doc: 128-bit identifier from the ULID specification. The first 48 bits are the Unix time in milliseconds and the other 80 bits are random, so values sort by creation time. The canonical form is 26 characters of Crockford's Base32 (digits and uppercase letters without I, L, O and U), 10 for the time and 16 for the randomness. The first character is 0 to 7, because 26 characters hold 130 bits and the largest ULID is 7ZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZZ. The specification calls ULIDs case-insensitive; the regexp accepts the canonical uppercase form. A ULID has the same size as a UUID and is often stored in a UUID column.

ru.doc: 128-битный идентификатор из 48 бит времени Unix в миллисекундах и 80 случайных бит. Записывается 26 символами Base32 Крокфорда; значения сортируются по времени создания.

name: UMLS concept unique identifier (CUI)
doc: Identifier of a concept in the Unified Medical Language System Metathesaurus of the US National Library of Medicine: the letter C and seven digits. It links terms from many vocabularies such as SNOMED CT, MeSH and ICD.

name: UN number (dangerous goods)
doc: Four-digit number that the UN Committee of Experts on the Transport of Dangerous Goods assigns to a hazardous substance or article, such as 1203 for petrol. It appears on transport documents and orange hazard plates.

name: UN/ECE Recommendation 20 unit code (UN/CEFACT common code)
doc: Two- or three-character code of a unit of measure from UN/ECE Recommendation 20, used in trade documents such as UN/EDIFACT and UBL invoices, for example KGM for kilogram or H87 for piece. Codes use uppercase letters and digits. Some lists, such as Peppol, add package codes from Recommendation 21 with an X prefix; they have the same shape but are not units.

name: Unique Ingredient Identifier
doc: The Unique Ingredient Identifier (UNII) is an alphanumeric identifier linked to a substance molecular structure or descriptive information and is generated by the Global Substance Registration System (GSRS) of the Food and Drug Administration (FDA). It classifies substances as chemical, protein, nucleic acid, polymer, structurally diverse, or mixture according to the standards outlined by the International Organization for Standardization in ISO 11238 and ISO DTS 19844.

name: UniProtKB accession number
doc: Stable identifier of a protein entry in the UniProt Knowledgebase (UniProtKB), the protein sequence and function database of the UniProt consortium. An accession has 6 or 10 uppercase letters and digits in a fixed layout, which UniProt publishes as a regular expression. An entry keeps its primary accession across releases, and the accessions of entries merged into it remain as secondary accessions. It is not the mnemonic entry name, which has the form NAME_SPECIES.

name: Unit of measurement
doc: Unit in which a quantity in the same row is expressed, written as a name or a symbol, for example kilogram, kg, litre or thousand roubles. Data catalogs often keep it in a separate column next to the value. Coded forms are covered by patterns such as the UN/ECE Recommendation 20 common code and UCUM.

doc: One line of /etc/shadow on Linux and other Unix systems: nine colon-separated fields with the login name, the hashed password (or ! or * for a locked account), and the password ageing and expiry dates, counted in days since 1970-01-01.

name: Digital timestamp (Unix time, Epoch time, Posix time)
doc: Digital timestamp defined as Unix Time. It is a system for describing a point in time. It is the number of seconds that have elapsed since the Unix epoch, excluding leap seconds.

name: UN/LOCODE
doc: N/LOCODE, the United Nations Code for Trade and Transport Locations, is a geographic coding scheme developed and maintained by United Nations Economic Commission for Europe (UNECE). UN/LOCODE assigns codes to locations used in trade and transport with functions such as seaports, rail and road terminals, airports, Postal Exchange Office and border crossing points. The first issue in 1981 contained codes for 8,000 locations. The version from 2011 contained codes for about 82,000 locations.

name: UN M49
doc: UN M49 or the Standard Country or Area Codes for Statistical Use (Series M, No. 49) is a standard for area codes used by the United Nations for statistical purposes, developed and maintained by the United Nations Statistics Division.

name: UN Packaging group
doc: Packaging code according to UN transportation rules

name: United Nations Standard Products and Services Code (UNSPSC)
doc: Code from the UNSPSC taxonomy of products and services used in e-commerce and procurement. It has eight digits: two each for segment, family, class and commodity. Upper levels have their own codes ending in 00. An optional ninth and tenth digit give the business function, such as retail or wholesale.

doc: UPS tracking number by field name identifier

name: Uniform Resource Identifier (URI)
doc: Identifier of a resource in the generic syntax of RFC 3986: a scheme, a colon and a scheme-specific part, optionally followed by ?query and #fragment, such as https://example.com/, mailto:John.Doe@example.com, urn:isbn:0451450523 or tel:+1-816-555-1212. URLs, which locate a resource, and URNs, which name it, are both URIs. The scheme starts with a letter and may contain letters, digits, +, - and .; IANA keeps the registry of schemes. The regexp accepts only the ASCII characters that RFC 3986 allows, with other characters percent-encoded, so IRIs with non-ASCII characters do not match.

examples.description: A time; a scheme starts with a letter

ru.name: Унифицированный идентификатор ресурса (URI)
ru.doc: Идентификатор ресурса в общем синтаксисе RFC 3986: схема, двоеточие и часть, зависящая от схемы.

name: URI scheme
doc: Name of a URI scheme, the part of a URI before the first colon, such as http, https, mailto, urn or data. It starts with a letter followed by letters, digits, +, - or ., and is case-insensitive, with lowercase as the canonical form (RFC 3986, section 3.1). IANA keeps the registry of permanent, provisional and historical schemes (RFC 7595). The record has no regexp: the syntax matches almost any word.

ru.name: Схема URI
ru.doc: Название схемы URI — часть до первого двоеточия, например https, mailto или urn.

name: URI with embedded password
doc: URI whose user information part contains a password, as in scheme://user:password@host/. RFC 3986 deprecates this form, but database and message broker connection URIs still use it. The user name may be empty, as in Redis URIs.

examples.description: Example connection URI from the PostgreSQL documentation

name: Uniform Resource Locator (URL)
doc: Address of a resource on a network that also says how to retrieve it: a scheme such as https, a host, an optional port, a path, a query and a fragment, as in https://www.example.com/docs?page=2#intro. URLs are the most common kind of URI (RFC 3986), and browsers follow the WHATWG URL Standard. The regexp covers http, https and ftp URLs whose host is a dotted domain name, an IPv4 address or an IPv6 address in brackets; other schemes are covered by uri.

examples.description: A URI without a host, not a web address

ru.name: URL (адрес ресурса)
ru.doc: Адрес ресурса в сети со схемой доступа, например https://www.example.com/docs.

name: Uniform Resource Name (URN)
doc: Persistent, location-independent name in the urn URI scheme, defined by RFC 8141. It has the form urn:<NID>:<NSS>. The namespace identifier (NID) is a name registered with IANA, 2 to 32 letters, digits and hyphens long, such as isbn, uuid or ietf. The namespace-specific string (NSS) follows the rules of that namespace. The urn prefix is case-insensitive. A URN names a resource; it does not say where to retrieve it.

examples.description: The namespace identifier must be at least two characters long

ru.name: Унифицированное имя ресурса (URN)
ru.doc: Постоянное имя ресурса в схеме urn (RFC 8141) вида urn:<пространство имён>:<строка>.

name: US core-based statistical area (CBSA) code
doc: Five-digit code of a metropolitan or micropolitan statistical area of the United States, as delineated by the Office of Management and Budget (OMB). Codes run from 10000 to 49999, are assigned in alphabetical order of the area title and do not end in 4; codes ending in 4 belong to metropolitan divisions. Combined statistical areas have separate 3-digit codes.

examples.description: ends in 4, the form of a metropolitan division code

name: US census block group GEOID
doc: Identifier of a census block group, a cluster of census blocks inside one tract, generally with 600 to 3,000 people. The 12-digit GEOID is the 11-digit tract GEOID followed by the block group number, which is the first digit of the block numbers in the group.

examples.description: Block Group 1, Census Tract 2231, Harris County, TX
Block Group 2, Census Tract 104.01, Jersey County, IL

name: US Census Bureau GEOID
doc: Numeric identifier of a geographic area in US Census Bureau data. It joins the codes of the areas it nests in, so its length shows the level - 2 digits for a state, 5 for a county, 7 for a place, 10 for a county subdivision, 11 for a census tract, 12 for a block group and 15 for a block. Some blocks have a one-letter suffix. ZCTA and CBSA codes are also 5 digits. A fully qualified form with a summary level prefix is a separate pattern (us_census_geoid_fq).

examples.description: Block Group 1, Census Tract 2231, Harris County, TX
block in Census Tract 2231, Harris County, TX
six digits is not a GEOID length

patterns.name: US Census Bureau fully qualified GEOID
patterns.doc: GEOID with nine leading characters, as used by data.census.gov and the Census Data API (ucgid) and in the GEOIDFQ field of TIGER/Line files - a 3-character summary level, a 2-character geographic variant, a 2-character geographic component, the letters US and then the GEOID. Older files call it GEO.ID or AFFGEOID. The variant and component can contain letters.

name: US Census Bureau fully qualified GEOID
doc: GEOID with nine leading characters, as used by data.census.gov and the Census Data API (ucgid) and in the GEOIDFQ field of TIGER/Line files - a 3-character summary level, a 2-character geographic variant, a 2-character geographic component, the letters US and then the GEOID. Older files call it GEO.ID or AFFGEOID. The variant and component can contain letters.

name: US census tract
doc: Census tract, a small and fairly permanent statistical subdivision of a US county, usually with 1,200 to 8,000 people. The tract number has a basic number of up to four digits and an optional two-digit suffix, for example 1457.02. Files store it as a 6-digit code with leading zeros and an implied decimal point (TRACTCE, 145702), unique within a county, or as an 11-digit GEOID with the state and county codes in front. Some ranges are reserved for water and special land use areas.

examples.description: Census Tract 2231, Harris County, TX, as a GEOID

name: US Export Control Classification Number (ECCN)
doc: Code of an item on the Commerce Control List of the US Export Administration Regulations. It has five characters: a digit for one of the ten categories, a letter from A to E for the product group, and three digits. The ECCN decides whether exporting the item needs a license. Items that are subject to the regulations but not listed are designated EAR99. Paragraph references such as .a.1 after the ECCN are not covered by the regexp.

examples.description: Category 3 (electronics), product group A (systems, equipment and components)
Item subject to the EAR but not on the Commerce Control List
The product group letter is A to E

name: GNIS Feature ID
doc: Numeric identifier of a named geographic feature in the Geographic Names Information System (GNIS), the official gazetteer of the United States kept by the US Geological Survey for the US Board on Geographic Names. It identifies populated places, administrative areas, streams, summits, structures and other features of the United States and its territories, and since 2024 also of Antarctica. The Census Bureau publishes the same number zero-padded to eight digits, for example STATENS 01779778 for California. Data Commons stores it in the gnisId property.

examples.description: zero-padded Census Bureau form of the same feature ID

name: US Medicare Health Insurance Claim Number (HICN)
doc: Former Medicare number of a beneficiary in the United States: the nine-digit Social Security number of the wage earner on whose record the person is entitled, followed by a one- or two-character beneficiary identification code such as A for the wage earner. Railroad Retirement Board beneficiaries had a differently built number. Medicare cards switched to the Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (us_mbi) from 2018, but the HICN remains in older claims and administrative files.

examples.description: Constructed from 987-65-4320, a number that SSA reserves for advertising
Pseudo HICN example from the CMS code descriptions

name: US Harmonized Tariff Schedule (HTS) number
doc: Number of the Harmonized Tariff Schedule of the United States (HTSUS), published by the US International Trade Commission. The first six digits are the HS subheading (hs_code); digits seven and eight make the eight-digit subheading, written 0101.21.00, and a two-digit statistical suffix makes the ten-digit statistical reporting number, written 0101.21.00.10. US Customs rulings often drop the last dot (6110.20.2079). The regexp requires the dots, because ten digits without them cannot be told from other codes.

examples.description: Statistical reporting number: purebred breeding horses, males
Statistical reporting number 6110.20.20.79 written as in US Customs rulings

name: US Medicare Beneficiary Identifier (MBI)
doc: Medicare Beneficiary Identifier, the 11-character number on the Medicare card that replaced the SSN-based number from 2018. Letters S, L, O, I, B and Z are not used. It is often written with hyphens after the 4th and 7th characters.

examples.description: The letter S is not used

name: MPA film rating (United States)
doc: Rating of a film by the Motion Picture Association of the United States (MPAA until 2019): G (general audiences), PG (parental guidance suggested), PG-13 (parents strongly cautioned), R (restricted: under 17 only with a parent or guardian) and NC-17 (no one 17 and under admitted). The system is voluntary and has been in use since 1968. Films without a rating are often marked NR (not rated) or UR (unrated); these labels are not MPA ratings.

examples.description: Not rated, not an MPA rating

name: US National Drug Code (NDC)
doc: Ten-digit identifier of a drug package listed with the US Food and Drug Administration. It has three segments: the labeler code assigned by the FDA, the product code and the package code, both assigned by the labeler. The official form separates the segments with hyphens in one of the configurations 4-4-2, 5-3-2, 5-4-1, 6-3-2 or 6-4-1. Claims data under HIPAA use an 11-digit form without hyphens that pads the segments with zeros to 5-4-2.

examples.description: The same package in the 11-digit HIPAA form
Labeler and product only; the package code is missing

name: US patent number
doc: Number of a United States patent document with the US country code and, often, the WIPO ST.16 kind code, as the USPTO recommends: for example "US 8,273,349 B2" for a granted patent. Granted utility patents have up to eight digits; prefixes mark reissues (RE), plant patents (PP), design patents (D) and statutory invention registrations (H). Patent application publications have the publication year and a seven-digit number; some sources, PubChem among them, drop the leading zero of that number. PubChem writes the parts with hyphens, as US-8273349-B2. Bare numbers without the US code are not covered.

examples.description: Granted patent, as PubChem writes it
The same patent, as the USPTO recommends
Patent application publication without the leading zero of the number

ru.name: Номер патента США
ru.doc: Номер патентного документа США с кодом страны и, как правило, кодом вида документа по стандарту ВОИС ST.16.

name: US Public Use Microdata Area (PUMA) code
doc: Code of a Public Use Microdata Area, a statistical area for census and American Community Survey microdata with at least 100,000 people that nests within a state. The PUMA code has 5 digits with leading zeros; the 7-digit GEOID puts the 2-digit state code in front.

examples.description: same PUMA as a GEOID with state code 01

name: RxNorm concept unique identifier (RXCUI)
doc: Numeric identifier of a concept in RxNorm, the US National Library of Medicine vocabulary of normalized names for clinical drugs on the US market. Ingredients, brand names and clinical drugs each have their own RXCUI.

examples.description: An RXCUI has no letter prefix

ru.name: Идентификатор понятия RxNorm (RXCUI)
ru.doc: Числовой идентификатор понятия в словаре лекарственных средств RxNorm Национальной медицинской библиотеки США.

name: US Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) code
doc: Six-digit code of the US Standard Occupational Classification, maintained by the Office of Management and Budget and the SOC Policy Committee of the Bureau of Labor Statistics, with a hyphen after the second digit. The 23 major groups are the odd numbers from 11 to 55; the ending of the code shows the level, from major group (xx-0000) to detailed occupation. The format is the same in the 2010 and 2018 editions.

name: TV Parental Guidelines rating (United States)
doc: Rating of a television programme in the United States under the TV Parental Guidelines, which the broadcasters apply themselves and V-chip receivers read. There are six ratings: TV-Y (all children), TV-Y7 (children 7 and older), TV-G (general audience), TV-PG (parental guidance suggested), TV-14 (parents strongly cautioned) and TV-MA (mature audience only). TV-Y7-FV marks fantasy violence. The letters D, L, S and V for the kind of content can follow the rating; the regexp does not accept them.

name: Unique Entity ID (SAM.gov UEI)
doc: Unique Entity ID (UEI), the 12-character identifier of an entity registered in the US System for Award Management (SAM.gov). It replaced the DUNS number as the identifier of federal award recipients in 2022. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as US-SAM; with that prefix an identifier reads US-SAM-YNDUZMUZF8H8.

name: US ZIP Code Tabulation Area (ZCTA)
doc: Five-character code of a ZIP Code Tabulation Area, the Census Bureau's area approximation of a USPS 5-digit ZIP Code built from census blocks. A 2020 ZCTA code is a valid ZIP Code, but not every ZIP Code has a ZCTA, and ZCTAs are not used to deliver mail. Codes can start with zero.

examples.description: ZCTA used in the Census Data API guide

doc: Amazon order ID by field name identifier

name: US Assessor Parcel Number by field name
doc: US Assessor Parcel Number by field name identifier

name: US ATIN (Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number)
doc: An ATIN is an Adoption Taxpayer Identification Number issued by the Internal Revenue Service as a temporary taxpayer identification number for the child in a domestic adoption where the adopting taxpayers do not have and/or are unable to obtain the child's Social Security Number (SSN).

name: Bank account in United States
doc: A bank account in the financial institutuin in United States

ru.doc: Вид банковского счета открываемого в банках США

name: USA DEA Registration (cerficicate) Number
doc: A DEA number (DEA Registration Number) is an identifier assigned to a health care provider (such as a physician, physician assistant, nurse practitioner, optometrist, podiatrist, dentist, or veterinarian) by the United States Drug Enforcement Administration allowing them to write prescriptions for controlled substances.

name: US driver license number
doc: Alphanumeric value of the United States driver license

name: US EIN (Employer Identification Number)
doc: An Employer Identification Number (EIN) is also known as a Federal Tax Identification Number, and is used to identify a business entity. Generally, businesses need an EIN.

name: HTTP User-Agent string
doc: Value of the User-Agent header that a browser, crawler, library or other HTTP client sends to describe itself. RFC 9110 defines it as one or more product identifiers, each a name with an optional /version, followed by comments in parentheses, such as the operating system. Most browsers start it with Mozilla/5.0 for historical compatibility. Web server logs and analytics data store it to tell browsers, devices and bots apart. The record has no regexp: the grammar is too loose to tell a user agent from other text.

examples.value: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64; rv:109.0) Gecko/20100101 Firefox/115.0

ru.doc: Значение HTTP-заголовка User-Agent, которым браузер, робот или другой клиент описывает себя.

doc: A user name and a password written together, for example in a configuration file, a command line or a script.

doc: UUID that identifies a user account, typically in a column such as user_uuid, account_uuid or user_guid. The value has the UUID format (uuid). Metacrafter reports it when the field name points to a user.

name: Federal Award Identification Number (FAIN)
doc: FAIN (Federal Award Identification Number) is the unique identifying number assigned to all federal finance awards. Since October of 2013, the Office of Management and Budget (OMB) has required all Federal Agencies to issue a FAIN to all financial assistance awards or grants.

name: US FIPS property code by field name
doc: US FIPS property code by field name identifier

name: US ITIN (Individual Taxpayer Identification Number)
doc: A Taxpayer Identification Number (TIN) is an identifying number used for tax purposes in the United States and in other countries under the Common Reporting Standard.

name: US National Provider Identifier (NPI)
doc: A National Provider Identifier (NPI) is a unique 10-digit identification number issued to health care providers in the United States by the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS).

doc: The PIID consists of a combination of thirteen to seventeen alpha and/or numeric characters sequenced to convey certain information

name: USPS tracking number by field name
doc: USPS tracking number by field name identifier

name: US PTIN (Preparer Tax Identification Number)
doc: The Preparer Tax Identification Number (PTIN) is an identification number that all paid tax return preparers must use on U.S. federal tax returns or claims for refund submitted to the Internal Revenue Service (IRS).

name: US Social Security Number
doc: In the United States, a Social Security number (SSN) is a nine-digit number issued to U.S. citizens, permanent residents, and temporary (working) residents under section 205(c)(2) of the Social Security Act, codified as 42 U.S.C. § 405(c)(2)

name: US State
doc: Name or code of US State

name: US Postal code
doc: A ZIP Code is a postal code used by the United States Postal Service (USPS). Introduced in 1963, the basic format consisted of five digits. In 1983, an extended ZIP+4 code was introduced; it included the five digits of the ZIP Code, followed by a hyphen and four digits that designated a more specific location.

name: UTC Timezone offset
doc: Difference between Coordinated Universal Time (UTC) and this timezone.

name: Universally unique identifier (UUID)
doc: 128-bit identifier that systems generate without a central registry, defined by RFC 9562 (2024), which replaced RFC 4122. Microsoft calls it a GUID. The text form is 32 hexadecimal digits in five groups of 8, 4, 4, 4 and 12 separated by hyphens, in any letter case. The first digit of the third group is the version (1 to 8, see uuid_v1, uuid_v4 and uuid_v7), and the first digit of the fourth group is 8, 9, a or b for the RFC 9562 variant. The Nil UUID (all zeros) and the Max UUID (all f) are special values. Microsoft tools and the Windows registry write GUIDs in curly braces, a form the regexp also accepts. The regexp does not accept the 32 digits without hyphens, which look like an MD5 hash, or the urn:uuid form (uuid_urn).

examples.description: UUIDv4 test vector of RFC 9562 (Appendix A.3)
Name-based UUIDv3 from the Python uuid module documentation
UUIDv1 test vector of RFC 9562 in the braced GUID form of Microsoft tools

ru.name: Универсальный уникальный идентификатор (UUID)
ru.doc: 128-битный идентификатор по RFC 9562, который системы создают без центрального реестра. В Microsoft его называют GUID. Записывается как 32 шестнадцатеричные цифры в пяти группах (8-4-4-4-12) через дефис; первая цифра третьей группы указывает версию.

patterns.name: UUID as a URN (urn:uuid)
patterns.doc: A UUID written as a URN in the uuid namespace, urn:uuid:<UUID>, as RFC 9562 defines. It is used where an identifier must be a URI, for example as the id of Atom feeds and entries (RFC 4287), in RDF data and as the identifier of EPUB packages. The urn and uuid parts are case-insensitive.

examples.description: Example of the uuid namespace in the Wikipedia article on URNs
Entry id in the example feed of RFC 4287 (Atom)
Bare UUID without the URN prefix, see uuid
Braces are not part of the URN form

name: UUID as a URN (urn:uuid)
doc: A UUID written as a URN in the uuid namespace, urn:uuid:<UUID>, as RFC 9562 defines. It is used where an identifier must be a URI, for example as the id of Atom feeds and entries (RFC 4287), in RDF data and as the identifier of EPUB packages. The urn and uuid parts are case-insensitive.

examples.description: Example of the uuid namespace in the Wikipedia article on URNs

name: Time-based UUID (version 1)
doc: UUID of version 1 under RFC 9562. It holds a 60-bit count of 100-nanosecond intervals since 15 October 1582, a clock sequence and a 48-bit node ID. The node ID is usually the IEEE 802 MAC address of the generating host, so the value reveals when and on which machine it was made. The version digit, the first digit of the third group, is 1. RFC 9562 recommends version 7 instead of versions 1 and 6 where possible.

examples.description: UUIDv1 test vector of RFC 9562 (Appendix A.1)
uuid1() output in the Python uuid module documentation
The same time and node as UUIDv6 (RFC 9562, Appendix A.5)

name: Random UUID (version 4)
doc: UUID of version 4 under RFC 9562. Apart from the version and variant bits, its 122 bits are random, so it carries no time or host information. It is the most common kind of UUID, made by functions such as uuid.uuid4() in Python, crypto.randomUUID() in JavaScript and gen_random_uuid() in PostgreSQL. The version digit, the first digit of the third group, is 4, and the first digit of the fourth group is 8, 9, a or b.

examples.description: UUIDv4 test vector of RFC 9562 (Appendix A.3)
uuid4() output in the Python uuid module documentation
Version 4 digit, but the variant digit c is not the RFC 9562 variant

name: Unix time-ordered UUID (version 7)
doc: UUID of version 7, introduced by RFC 9562 in 2024. The first 48 bits are the Unix time in milliseconds, and the rest, apart from the version and variant bits, is random or a counter. Values sort by creation time, which suits database keys, and RFC 9562 recommends this version over versions 1 and 6. The creation time can be read back from the first 12 hexadecimal digits. The version digit, the first digit of the third group, is 7. PostgreSQL 18 makes it with uuidv7() and Python 3.14 with uuid.uuid7().

examples.description: UUIDv7 test vector of RFC 9562 (Appendix A.6), created 2022-02-22 19:22:22 UTC
UUIDv7 of the valid-uuidv7 test case of the TypeID specification

name: Uruguayan postal code
doc: Postal code (código postal) in Uruguay: five digits. Montevideo codes start with 11 or 12.

name: Uruguayan tax registry number (RUT)
doc: Registro Único Tributario (RUT), the number under which the Uruguayan tax office (DGI) registers legal entities for tax purposes. It has 12 digits, often written as 21-100342-001-7: a two-digit registration number from 01 to 22, a six-digit sequence number, the digits 001 and a modulo 11 check digit. The country prefix UY is sometimes added.

examples.description: Example with the country prefix from the python-stdnum documentation

name: Uzbek KTUT code
doc: KTUT number (the OKPO code) of a legal entity in the United State Register of Enterprises and Organizations kept by the statistics agency of Uzbekistan. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as UZ-KTUT; with that prefix an identifier reads UZ-KTUT-2365119.

name: Uzbekistan postal code
doc: Postal code in Uzbekistan: six digits.

name: Vatican City postal code
doc: Postal code in Vatican City: a single code, 00120. Vatican City is part of the Italian postal code system.

name: EU VAT ID
doc: A value-added tax identification number or VAT identification number (VATIN) is an identifier used in many countries, including the countries of the European Union, for value-added tax purposes.

name: Venezuelan tax information number (RIF)
doc: Registro Único de Información Fiscal (RIF), the tax registration number that the Venezuelan tax administration SENIAT assigns to individuals and legal entities; before 2006 it was called Registro de Información Fiscal. It has ten characters, usually written as J-30468971-3: a letter for the kind of holder (V a Venezuelan person, E a foreign person, J a legal entity, P a passport holder, G a government body, C a communal council), eight digits (for a person, the identity card number) and a modulo 11 check digit. python-stdnum 2.2 does not accept the letter C.

name: VIAF ID

The value is a plain integer and cannot be told apart from other numbers without the field name. Vimeo user and channel names, such as staff or user13301326, are a different identifier.

Testnet keys start with c and are not matched; keys for an uncompressed public key are wifaddruncomp.

name: Windows security identifier (SID)
doc: Identifier of a security principal in Microsoft Windows, such as a user account, group, computer or service. Its text form is S-1- followed by the identifier authority and up to 15 subauthorities, all decimal and separated by hyphens. Domain and local accounts have SIDs starting with S-1-5-21. Well-known SIDs, such as S-1-5-32-544 for the local Administrators group, are the same on all systems.

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

examples.description: Well-known SID of the built-in Administrators group
Well-known SID World, the group of all users
Service SID of the dnscache service

name: Windows Registry key
doc: Registry keys are container objects similar to folders. Registry values are non-container objects similar to files. Keys may contain values and subkeys. Keys are referenced with a syntax similar to Windows path names, using backslashes to indicate levels of hierarchy. Keys must have a case insensitive name without backslashes.

name: WIPO Madrid international trademark registration number
doc: Sequential number that the International Bureau of WIPO gives to a mark registered under the Madrid System; current numbers have seven digits. When part of a registration is assigned to a new holder, that part keeps the number followed by a capital letter. The Gazette prints numbers with spaces, and old registrations have fewer digits; the regexp covers the compact six- and seven-digit forms only, so it is weak without column context.

examples.description: International registration listed in WIPO Gazette No. 39/2010
Part of registration 561534 recorded for a new holder

name: Well-known text (WKT) geometry
doc: Geometry written in the well-known text (WKT) markup of the OGC Simple Features standard (ISO 19125), such as POINT (30 10) or POLYGON ((30 10, 40 40, 20 40, 10 20, 30 10)). PostGIS also writes extended WKT (EWKT), which starts with the spatial reference id, as in SRID=4326;POINT (30 10).

name: WMO station index number
doc: Five-digit index number of a land meteorological station in SYNOP and other WMO code forms: a 2-digit block number for a country or region followed by a 3-digit station number. Leading zeros are significant. WMO publishes the list in WMO-No. 9, Volume A. Numbers that repeat one figure five times or end in 000 or 999 are not assigned; the regexp does not exclude them, so it is weak without column context.

name: PCT international publication number (WO)
doc: Number that the International Bureau of WIPO gives to a published international patent application under the Patent Cooperation Treaty. Since 2004 it is WO, the four-digit year of publication, a slash and a six-digit serial number, such as WO 2004/123456; data often uses a compact form with a kind code A1 to A4, A8 or A9. Older numbers have a two-digit year and a five- or six-digit serial number.

examples.description: Publication number in the format of PCT Administrative Instructions Section 404
The same publication in compact form with its kind code
Older form with a two-digit year, from the WIPO Handbook
A four-digit year needs a six-digit serial number

name: WorldCat Entities ID
doc: Identifier of a person, place, work, event or other entity in WorldCat Entities, the linked data service of OCLC. It is the last segment of the entity URI https://id.oclc.org/worldcat/entity/<id>. OCLC publishes no formal grammar; identifiers seen in practice are 26 letters and digits that start with E39P or E39Q. It succeeds the WorldCat Identities ID.

examples.description: full entity URI, not the bare identifier

name: WorldCat Identities ID
doc: Key of a name page in WorldCat Identities, a retired OCLC research service that summarized the works by and about a person, organization or place. OCLC stopped updating it in July 2022 and replaced it with WorldCat Entities. The key is a prefix and a value - lccn- with a Library of Congress name authority number, viaf- with a VIAF ID, or np-, nc- or ns- with other text. Data Commons still stores it in the worldcatIdentitiesId property, and older datasets keep it.

examples.description: bare Library of Congress name authority number without the lccn- prefix

name: WormBase ID
doc: Identifier of an object in WormBase, the database of Caenorhabditis elegans and other nematodes: WB, a capitalized class name and digits, as in WBGene00000898 for the gene daf-2. Bioregistry also accepts CE and five digits.

examples.description: Gene daf-2; example of Wikidata property P3860
Gene cyk-4; example of Wikidata property P3860

name: WoRMS AphiaID
doc: Number of a taxon name in the World Register of Marine Species (WoRMS), the expert-curated list of names of marine organisms with their synonyms. WoRMS calls this number the AphiaID.

examples.description: Fucus vesiculosus; example of Wikidata property P850
Taxon name instead of its number

name: X.509 certificate (PEM)
doc: Public-key certificate in the PEM textual encoding of RFC 7468: the Base64 of the DER certificate between the lines -----BEGIN CERTIFICATE----- and -----END CERTIFICATE-----. Older tools also write the labels X509 CERTIFICATE or X.509 CERTIFICATE, and OpenSSL writes TRUSTED CERTIFICATE for a certificate with trust settings. A certificate holds a public key and is not secret.

examples.description: Example certificate of RFC 7468, section 5.1 (a GnuTLS test CA)
PEM public key, not a certificate

name: X.509 certificate fingerprint
doc: Hash of the DER encoding of an X.509 certificate, as shown by browsers, certificate stores and openssl x509 -fingerprint: hexadecimal octets separated by colons, 20 octets for SHA-1 and 32 octets for SHA-256. The same value without separators looks like a plain SHA-1 or SHA-256 hash.

examples.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the example certificate of RFC 7468, section 5.1
SHA-1 fingerprint of the same certificate

name: X.509 certificate private key
doc: Private key of an X.509 certificate, usually written as a PEM block that starts with -----BEGIN PRIVATE KEY----- (or RSA PRIVATE KEY, EC PRIVATE KEY) or embedded in a Base64 PKCS #12 file.

name: xid globally unique ID
doc: 96-bit identifier of the Go library rs/xid. It uses the MongoDB ObjectId layout (a 4-byte time in seconds, a 3-byte machine ID, a 2-byte process ID and a 3-byte counter) and writes the 12 bytes as 20 characters of lowercase base32hex (digits and the letters a to v), which keeps the sort order. The last character holds a single bit, so it is 0 or g.

examples.description: The 12 bytes of the MongoDB ObjectId 507f1f77bcf86cd799439011 written as an xid
w is not a base32hex character

name: XRP Ledger address
doc: Classic address of an XRP Ledger account: an account ID with a 4-byte checksum, encoded with the XRP Ledger's own Base58 alphabet (rpshnaf39wBUDNEGHJKLM4PQRST7VWXYZ2bcdeCg65jkm8oFqi1tuvAxyz). It starts with r and has 25 to 35 characters. The alphabet differs from Bitcoin's, so the Bitcoin Base58Check algorithm does not verify it. X-addresses, which also encode a destination tag, are not matched.

examples.description: Genesis account of the XRP Ledger (XRP Ledger documentation)
Output of the address encoding sample of the XRP Ledger documentation

name: Yemeni Ministry of Planning registration number
doc: Registration number of an organisation at the Ministry of Planning and International Cooperation of Yemen. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as YE-MOPIC; with that prefix an identifier reads YE-MOPIC-0036.

name: Yemeni Ministry of Social Affairs registration number
doc: Registration number of an association or foundation at the Ministry of Social Affairs and Labour of Yemen. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as YE-MSAL; with that prefix an identifier reads YE-MSAL-4/M/2012.

name: Year
doc: A calendar year in western notation like 2022 or 1913

name: Year range
doc: Span of calendar years written as two four-digit years joined by a hyphen, such as 2019-2020. It often names a season, an academic or fiscal year, or a reporting period.

examples.description: short form of the second year is not covered

name: Year and month
doc: Defines a part of a date - the year and month. Example YYYY-MM.

patterns.name: Month and year (Russian)
patterns.doc: Month written as a Russian month name followed by a year, optionally with "года" or "г.", for example "Февраль 2027 года" or "январь 2013".

ru.name: Месяц и год
ru.doc: Месяц и год в русской записи.

name: yescrypt password hash
doc: Password hash of yescrypt, the scrypt-based scheme by Openwall that is the default in /etc/shadow on recent releases of Debian, Ubuntu and Fedora, in Modular Crypt Format: $y$, the encoded parameters (j9T for the common defaults), $, the salt, $ and 43 characters of crypt Base64.

examples.description: Hash of the word "example" with the salt examplesalt and the default parameters

name: YouTube channel ID
doc: Identifier of a YouTube channel: UC and 22 characters, as in youtube.com/channel/<id>. Channel handles that start with @ are different identifiers.

categories.name: User accounts in products and services

name: YouTube video ID
doc: Eleven-character identifier of a YouTube video, as in youtube.com/watch?v=<id>, youtu.be/<id> and youtube.com/shorts/<id>: letters, digits, hyphens and underscores. Any eleven-character token of these characters matches the regexp, so the field name matters. Channel IDs (youtube_channel_id) have 24 characters and start with UC.

examples.description: Example of the Wikidata property, starting with a hyphen

ru.name: Идентификатор видео YouTube
ru.doc: Идентификатор видео YouTube из 11 символов (буквы, цифры, дефис и подчёркивание), как в адресе youtube.com/watch?v=<id>.

name: South African company registration number (CIPC)
doc: Registration number of a company at the Companies and Intellectual Property Commission (CIPC) of South Africa: the year of registration, a sequence number and a code for the type of company. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-CIP; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-CIP-6713-713839-07.

name: South African identity number
doc: South African identity number: 13 digits made of the date of birth (YYMMDD), four digits, a citizenship digit, a digit that is usually 8 and a check digit.

name: South African corporate income tax number
doc: Income tax reference number of a company, trust or other body for corporate income tax at the South African Revenue Service. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-CIT; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-CIT-9415005603.

name: South African nonprofit organisation number
doc: Registration number of a nonprofit organisation at the Nonprofit Organisation Directorate of the Department of Social Development of South Africa. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZA-NPO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZA-NPO-181-465.

name: South Africa postal code
doc: Postal code in South Africa: four digits.

name: South African province
doc: Name of one of the nine provinces of South Africa, such as Gauteng, Western Cape or KwaZulu-Natal. The code is the pattern za_province_code.

patterns.name: South African province code
patterns.doc: Code of a South African province from ISO 3166-2:ZA, without the ZA- prefix: EC, FS, GP, KZN, LP, MP, NC, NW or WC. Older data also uses GT for Gauteng, NL for KwaZulu-Natal and NP for Limpopo.

name: South African province code
doc: Code of a South African province from ISO 3166-2:ZA, without the ZA- prefix: EC, FS, GP, KZN, LP, MP, NC, NW or WC. Older data also uses GT for Gauteng, NL for KwaZulu-Natal and NP for Limpopo.

name: ZFIN ID
doc: Identifier of an object in ZFIN, the Zebrafish Information Network model organism database: ZDB-, the kind of object, such as GENE, and two numbers separated by hyphens.

name: Zambian NGO registration number
doc: Registration number of a non-governmental organisation at the Department of the Registrar for NGOs of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-RNGO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-RNGO-1010147.

name: Zambian PACRA registration number
doc: Registration number of a company or business at the Patents and Companies Registration Agency (PACRA) of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-PCR; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-PCR-320170016571.

name: Zambia postal code
doc: Postal code in Zambia: five digits.

name: Zambian society registration number
doc: Registration number of a society at the Registrar of Societies of Zambia. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZM-RS; with that prefix an identifier reads ZM-RS-10235225.

name: Zimbabwean private voluntary organisation number
doc: Registration number of a private voluntary organisation in Zimbabwe. ORG-ID.guide lists the register as ZW-PVO; with that prefix an identifier reads ZW-PVO-15/2003.
